+# B300 campaign with abundant compute
+
+**Precision correction, 24 October:** [The explicit BF16/BF16x9 amendment](PRECISION_AMENDMENT_20261024.md)
+supersedes the strict-FP32 wording in this historical proposal for every new
+R4 cell, including G reference controls and H students. FP32 master/update state
+remains. The team’s active W2 teacher fits are a separate source-bound execution.
+
+**Implementation update, 24 October:** [R4 executable packet](high_compute_r4/README.md)
+implements the conditional B–H stages below, including inner manifests, complete
+configs, receiver commands and three-teacher cache composition. The text below
+preserves the original proposal. R4 freezes H students at 30 epochs and adds 180
+student fit-epochs; receiving-host acceptance and every scientific result remain
+pending. The four historical R3 configs are unchanged.
+
+User steering, 24 October 2026: compute is plentiful. Optimize for the strongest
+transferable teacher and final CPU student, with more informative comparisons
+and replication. The four R3 fits are the first capacity panel, not a campaign
+ceiling. This is a **proposed continuation**, not extra runnable R3 cells or a
+record of launches. R3 source/configs and its four-fit accounting stay frozen.
+
+## Concrete continuation
+
+R3 and G use full outer fitting membership. B–F use all inner-training membership
+after reserving inner component validation from the outer fitting membership;
+this requires new manifests and normalization caches. Every teacher fit uses
+30 epochs over its own declared membership, strict FP32, Muon and fixed-final
+scoring. Equal epoch counts do not mean equal rows or compute. No 10%/30% data proxy. Existing
+outer F0/F2 remain exposed; inner search is development, not pristine evidence.
+Freeze two source-qualified inner cells before search and pair every arm's seed,
+data, masks and endpoint. Count failed attempts as attempted configurations.
+
+| Stage | Comparison | New fits | Exact reuse |
+|---|---|---:|---|
+| A: existing R3 | 630M vs 1.54B; F0/F2 | 4 teachers already planned | None |
+| B: LR | 1.54B; `1e-4`, `3e-4`, `1e-3`; 5% warmup; two inner cells | 6 teachers | None: R3 outer fits cannot substitute for inner-fit controls |
+| C: warmup | Selected LR; 1%, 5%, 10% (about 0.3, 1.5, 3 epochs) | 4 teachers | Two exact 5% endpoints from B |
+| D: forward context | 1024, 2048, 4096 rows; chunk512 / accumulation8 unchanged | 4 teachers | Two selected context1024 endpoints from B/C |
+| E: chunk/horizon recipe | Selected context; chunk512/accumulation8 vs chunk2048/accumulation2 | 2 teachers | Two exact chunk512 endpoints from D or its selected ancestor |
+| F: targeted capacity follow-up | 1.54B vs approximately 3.15B: width2560, depth40, heads40, FF multiplier4 | 2 teachers | Two selected 1.54B endpoints from E or its selected ancestor |
+| G: robustness | Frozen selected recipe vs original 1.54B R3 recipe; 3 paired new seeds on each of F0/F2 | 12 teachers | None; train both arms on complete outer fitting membership |
+| H: student transfer | Fixed raw112 GRU512x2: labels, single-teacher KD, three-teacher mean KD; two outer cells | 6 students | Candidate teacher checkpoints from G; no new teachers |
+
+If every stage is retained and every stated control is reusable, the route is
+**40 fits: 34 teachers and 6 students**, including the original four R3 fits.
+The extension adds 30 teachers and 6 students, not 40 extra fits. Teacher cost is
+1,020 teacher epochs across the whole route (900 additional), not comparable
+wall time across model/context sizes. Student duration and optimizer must be
+frozen in its own packet; student cost is not hidden inside teacher accounting.
+Engineering checks/profiles, exports, replay and failed attempts are additional
+costs, logged separately. A broken exact-reuse contract requires an explicit
+replacement-control allocation, not pretending the old control is matched.
+
+Stages are conditional, not an automatic queue or an instruction to complete
+all 40 regardless of evidence. Initial LR discovery uses six new fits; later
+stages answer separate questions and retain every result. The robustness stage
+is a separately frozen confirmation attempt, not a 12-fit initial screen.
+If the selected configuration is exactly the R3 reference, omit duplicate arm
+training and amend the inventory. Extend a promising family when uncertainty
+and likely endpoint benefit justify it; a zero-crossing interval is not a stop
+rule. Freeze the selected recipe before reading stage G outcomes. Because F0/F2
+are already exposed, G measures robustness, not untouched generalization.
+The sequential LR then warmup search can miss interactions. It is a broad
+coordinate search, not a joint optimum; a later LR-by-warmup factorial would be
+a separately declared follow-up with its own cost, not hidden inside these 40.
+The same limitation applies to selected context/scale ancestors. F is a targeted
+extension of the existing capacity family, not a new 4–6-fit initial screen.
+
+## What extra compute buys
+
+- Search LR and warmup directly, rather than label the current `3e-4 / 5%`
+  optimum. The `1e-3` arm is intentionally aggressive and needs its own peak-LR
+  stress profile; unstable attempts remain in the search history.
+- Separate forward memory from gradient horizon. A 4096-row KV context still has
+  a 512-row backward graph in D. E keeps 4096 new rows per sequence per full
+  update while extending backpropagation; attention context stays fixed.
+  Padding, target denominators and final short windows retain actual weights.
+  E also changes query chunk shape, activation memory and accumulation. Attribute
+  its outcome to that complete recipe, not an isolated gradient-horizon effect.
+- Inspect a larger teacher after a tuned 1.54B reference exists. The same LR at
+  3.15B is a matched transfer of settings, not proof it is optimal at that scale.
+  Add a separately declared larger-model LR follow-up if its curves justify it.
+- Cross three seeds with two folds to distinguish their variation better than
+  the original two confounded cells. Report paired deltas by fold and seed;
+  neither component bootstrap nor six correlated cells guarantees significance.
+- Use a fixed equal mean of all three frozen selected-recipe teacher seeds from G
+  per outer fold for H. The single-teacher arm uses the first seed in G's frozen
+  manifest, selected before seeing any G outer score. Both KD arms use G's same
+  selected-recipe branch. Measure the
+  student's gain against the same student's label-only control. A better teacher
+  or a larger ensemble alone is not a submission improvement.
+  H's F0/F2 student scores are also exposed, directional evidence, not untouched
+  student generalization.
+
+## Compute placement and implementation boundary
+
+The confirmed recipe targets one eight-B300 group. Additional groups and their
+available duration are not yet inventoried. Parallelize independent complete
+fits across actually allocated disjoint groups; do not silently change an
+eight-rank recipe to one/two/four ranks or increase batch to fill memory.
+Different rank counts/global batches require separately profiled configurations.
+Reuse immutable data, normalization and teacher caches only when their complete
+source/split/ancestry identities match. No GPU job is launched by this document.
+
+R3 already implements fit/profile/recovery, the stated optimizer and model
+configuration fields. B–G still need frozen cell manifests/configs and launch
+adapters: R3 `run.sh` deliberately accepts only its original four cell IDs.
+Every changed architecture/context/chunk/LR needs real-shape acceptance and
+resource profiling; do not bypass R3 guards or call these stages launch-ready.
+H additionally needs a provenance-bound three-teacher cache merge, fixed student
+recipe and its own CPU export/serving acceptance. The raw112 student is not the
+native211/TL3 adapter; no compatibility or submission-size claim is made.
+
+Use actual GPU-hours, optimizer/window time, total completed data passes, memory
+and fixed endpoint quality to allocate the next stage. A fit count is not a GPU
+budget or a duration estimate. Preserve some available capacity for exports,
+student training and CPU verification instead of spending everything on teachers.
+Data and causal representation can limit benefit even with abundant compute.
+Keep 30 epochs as requested; any longer-duration comparison is a new arm, never
+an extension selected using outer-fold checkpoints.
+
+## Research basis and evidence
+
+[Muon scaling research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.16982) supports examining
+matrix update scaling and larger models, but its language-model results do not
+establish a speed or quality advantage for this strict-FP32 time-series trainer.
+[Data-constrained scaling research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16264) motivates
+measuring the value of repeated data and excess capacity; its numerical epoch
+conclusions are not imported into this task. These are design motivations.
+
+No new Python/runtime code, tests, training, inference or GPU profiles in this
+amendment. Prior R3 static evidence and GitHub lint belong to their exact source;
+actual B300 acceptance and all teacher/student outcomes remain pending.

+# [Experiment] B300 causal Transformer and distillation runtime
+
+[Executable packet and B300 commands](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/d2e6263af3a0dcb2d35badec8c3fa15da0d91dc6/research/experiment_drafts/b300-transformer-distillation-runtime/README.md) · [Receiving-host acceptance](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/blob/d2e6263af3a0dcb2d35badec8c3fa15da0d91dc6/research/experiment_drafts/b300-transformer-distillation-runtime/REMOTE_ACCEPTANCE.md)
+
+Ruff, formatting, AST parsing and repository structure checks passed locally. No local tests, project imports, training, inference or GPU profiles were run.
+
+1. **Status, lineage and owner.** Implements a CUDA/torchrun teacher → fitting-only
+   cache → GRU/Transformer student → official score path, on research-team
+   `4e0626c8`. E/H-B300-SEQUENCE-RUNTIME-20261020 connects PR28 transfer, PR29
+   representation hints and PR30 streaming students. Implementation and static
+   review only: no local tests, model execution, fits or B300 profiles.
+2. **Why it should work.** A causal attention teacher can expose dependencies
+   absent from a compact recurrent student. Compare label-only with same-model
+   KD; compare aligned versus component-permuted hints to separate correspondence
+   from auxiliary regularization. Teacher quality and student benefit are separate
+   observations; neither is assumed.
+3. **Compute advantage.** Large teachers use DDP over the allocated eight B300s;
+   students start with one GPU per fit. Dimension ladder is 768×24, 1280×32 and
+   1792×40; real parameter counts, FP32 memory and throughput are recorded by the
+   runtime. No advertised hardware throughput or scaling law is treated as measured.
+4. **Frozen comparison.** Explicit amendment: raw112, fitting-only normalization,
+   sliding per-layer KV, fixed chunk256/accumulate4, full sequences, strictFP32,
+   AdamW/cosine, fixed final three epochs. This is not the old anchored4096 or
+   anchored211/Muon recipe. Label/KD are additive weighted squared errors;
+   teacher labels/outputs clip at2, weight is absolute clipped truth. Hints
+   use independent masked normalization. Full details in README/configs.
+5. **Bounded fitting panel.** F0/seed1001 and F2/seed1002. First panel costs six
+   fits including two teachers. Hints costs four new fits with exact transfer
+   control/cache reuse; streaming costs four with the same prerequisites.
+   These are separate panels: fourteen total if all three are admitted. Optional
+   width and scale follow-ups each cost four new fits and are not automatic.
+   Historical CP30 recipes remain unchanged.
+6. **Validation and uncertainty.** Canonical pooled global_wp_clip2_v1 on exact
+   held-out component membership. Report both targets and every paired delta.
+   Two exposed cells confound fold and fitting-seed effects; no significance
+   claim or automatic 30-run expansion. Outer validation never selects checkpoints.
+7. **Leakage and coverage.** Full raw causal rows, first99 warm-up, reset per
+   sequence, component-disjoint canonical manifests. Teacher cache validates the
+   entire same-fold ancestry and source-qualified membership; output exports bind
+   every file and checkpoint hash. Unsupported legacy native211 weights fail
+   explicitly. Existing fold exposure and unknown temporal regimes remain limitations.
+8. **Decision-changing result.** A descriptive mean student gain ≥0.001 with both
+   cells nonnegative is a useful follow-up signal, conditional on compute/serving
+   cost; inconsistent or smaller effects motivate targeted diagnosis. A negative
+   screen narrows this exact recipe. Interval crossing zero alone does not reject
+   the family. Teacher scale alone does not establish transfer.
+9. **How to run.** README provides receiving-host dependencies, data/split binding,
+   real-shape profile, approved-receipt admission, fit, cache, evaluation and score
+   commands. Safe resume is epoch-boundary only with exact world size and identity.
+   No queue manager, GPU rental or job launch is included. B300 acceptance is pending.
+10. **Evidence to return.** Source/config/data/cache identity, hardware/runtime,
+    rank logs, losses, LR, preclip norm, attempted/successful updates, elapsed time/
+    peak memory, final/resume checkpoints, predictions and official grades.

+11. **Results and trace.** No empirical results. Unified ideas index links this

+# Blackwell precision amendment — 24 October 2026
+
+The user confirmed that mandatory strict-FP32 model computation was withdrawn.
+The active four-teacher successor uses **BF16 autocast plus process-wide cuBLAS
+BF16x9 emulation**. R4 now adopts that explicit numerical arm; the earlier
+strict-FP32 R1/R2/R3 artifacts remain historical references, not current launch
+instructions.
+
+## Current team execution and provenance
+
+[PR #40](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/40) implements the
+selected runtime. Its scientific source is
+`f1beeb4c210a9da01735e03b1ff6e27be878b873`; later operator/documentation revisions
+are distinct. [The measured batch amendment](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/32#issuecomment-6377750553)
+records four fresh 30-epoch teachers on F0/F2, two B300s each: 630M at 96/rank
+(global192) and 1.54B at 64/rank (global128). These are the team's active four
+fits, not executions of the conditional R4 B–H campaign. Track evaluated
+endpoints separately from optimizer progress in the
+[live report](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/32#issuecomment-6377032958).
+
+The R4 integration ports the canonical runtime and its prepared tests from that
+scientific source (18 source/test files). It adds a FP32 cast at the GRU recurrent
+state boundary for BF16 streaming, precision-aware ensemble ancestry checks,
+and R4 configuration/admission compatibility. This combined source is new:
+PR40's remote test/profile receipts do not admit it automatically. No active
+host processes, controllers, running source pins or checkpoints are modified.
+
+## Actual arithmetic contract
+
+| Part | Selected contract |
+|---|---|
+| Config | `precision_mode=bf16_bf16x9` |
+| Transformer compute | BF16 forward autocast; exact local-window efficient SDPA |
+| Transformer execution | `compile_blocks=true`, `checkpoint_blocks=false` |
+| GRU compute | BF16 forward autocast; no Transformer compiler/attention flags |
+| Master weights, gradients, loss, optimizer and carried state | FP32 tensors |
+| KD target export and arithmetic ensemble | Finite FP32 arrays and FP32 mean |
+| TF32 / AMP scaler | Disabled |
+| Process environment | `CUBLAS_EMULATE_SINGLE_PRECISION=1`, `CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8` |
+
+BF16x9 is a process-wide cuBLAS request and can affect Muon matrix operations.
+FP32 tensor storage and five FP32 Newton–Schulz iterations do **not** establish
+IEEE-identical FP32 arithmetic. Neither a finite loss nor higher throughput
+establishes quality equivalence. This is mixed-precision research, not submission
+quantization. The generic loader retains its legacy `fp32` default for old
+explicit recipes; every new R4 cell writes its precision explicitly.
+
+## Scope of the R4 continuation
+
+Both candidate and reference in G use the amended precision/backend/compiler
+settings. The historical R3 JSON is copied then explicitly amended, never edited
+in place. Historical FP32 results or the running PR40 W2 results cannot be silently
+reused as new R4 W8 controls. B–H retain 30 epochs, their seeds/splits, Muon or
+student AdamW, 5%-baseline warmup/cosine policy, and their declared hypotheses.
+New configs retain batch2/rank and eight ranks as **unprofiled starting settings**;
+this correction does not transfer measured W2 batches96/64 or their 10% reserve
+to 3.15B/context4096/chunk2048 experiments. R4 still requires its conservative
+20% profile reserve until a separately measured amendment chooses a new batch.
+
+Create a new campaign root at the reviewed successor commit. Source/config
+hashes deliberately reject existing materializations, strict-FP32 receipts and
+checkpoints as resume inputs. Run receiver correctness checks and exact-shape
+one/eight-rank and peak-LR profiles before any fit. Legacy FP32 correctness and
+DDP checks run in separate subprocesses with cuBLAS emulation disabled; BF16
+runtime tests and fresh emulation-enabled profiles cover the new path. Full
+one/eight-rank export parity remains a required measured cache prerequisite.
+
+Local preparation runs only source/AST/JSON/shell/lint checks. Tests, model
+imports, training, inference, GPU profiles, remote jobs and submission actions
+are not executed. See [R4 commands](high_compute_r4/README.md) and its validation
+record for the outstanding receiver checks.

+# B300 Transformer teacher and distillation runtime
+
+**24 October implementation:** [Executable high-compute R4](high_compute_r4/README.md)
+implements the [expanded plan](HIGH_COMPUTE_PLAN_20261024.md): staged LR/warmup,
+context/horizon and 3.15B teacher configs, crossed seed/fold confirmation and
+labels/single-teacher/three-teacher GRU distillation. Up to 40 conditional fits
+including the original four R3 teachers; exact controls are reused. Source
+preparation is complete; B300 checks and all outcomes remain pending.
+
+**24 October precision correction:** [The Blackwell amendment](PRECISION_AMENDMENT_20261024.md)
+supersedes strict-FP32 model compute for new R4 cells with explicit BF16/BF16x9.
+The four active W2 teacher fits and their measured batches belong to
+[PR40](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/40); they run on a separately
+pinned source. This R4 integration does not change them. Its combined runtime
+still needs receiving-host checks/profiles; no local tests, model imports,
+training, inference or GPU profiles were run.
+
+**Historical 23 October recipe:** [Large teacher R3 — Muon / 30 epochs](large_teacher_r3_muon30/README.md)
+records the original strict-FP32 four-fit preparation. Its configs and parameter
+tables remain unchanged as history. Use the current amendment and R4 commands
+for the continuation; do not treat the old R3 source/receipts as BF16 acceptance.
+
+- [PR.md](PR.md): scientific comparisons, limitations and evidence contract.
+- [recipe.json](recipe.json): explicit prospective amendments for PRs 28–30;
+  initial and optional follow-up costs. Historical CP30 recipes remain unchanged.
+- [configs/](configs/): executable trainer JSON, one file per variant and cell.
+  Names contain dimensions, not unmeasured rounded parameter-count claims.
+- [Remote acceptance](REMOTE_ACCEPTANCE.md): checks to run on the receiving host,
+  including unexecuted unit tests and multi-GPU equivalence requirements.
+- Runtime: [trainer](../../../scripts/train_sequence.py),
+  [exporter](../../../scripts/predict_sequence.py),
+  [official scorer](../../../scripts/score_sequence.py).
+  Components live in `src/wnn/training/sequence_*.py`; the legacy trainer is unchanged.
+
+Published [PR #32](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/32) targets `research-team` and is ready for code review.
+The following R1 implementation/history is frozen. The precision amendment above describes the current continuation. R1 executable source
+is frozen at `d2e6263af3a0dcb2d35badec8c3fa15da0d91dc6`; later publication/base-sync commits preserve that
+implementation. [Validation record](VALIDATION.json) records static checks only.
+
+## Historical R1 implementation
+
+Raw112 causal pre-norm Transformer, RoPE, GELU FFN, per-layer sliding KV state,
+math SDPA, activation checkpointing, and canonical `RNNModel` GRU adapters.
+All model/input/state/gradient/optimizer arithmetic is FP32, with autocast and
+TF32 disabled. No quantization, FlashAttention assumption, Muon or output AR.
+The explicit optimizer is AdamW with warmup/cosine and gradient clipping.
+
+Input normalization uses the first 32 source-qualified fitting sequences,
+never outer validation. Every 20,000-row sequence is forwarded from row zero;
+state resets between sequences. Loss/score mask is `is_scored & row>=99`.
+Model/normalizer selection is the fixed final epoch, not outer-fold quality.
+Strict component split validation is reused from `load_campaign_split`.
+
+This **amends** old designs: raw112 and sliding KV are neither the anchored
+4096-row raw112 proposal in PRs 28–30 nor PR31's anchored211/Muon/dynamics
+proposal. Context is 512 rows **per layer** for teachers and 128 for students;
+the input receptive field can span `1 + layers * (context_rows - 1)` rows.
+TBPTT detaches state every 256 rows, while AdamW updates every four chunks
+(the final shorter window uses its true denominator). Carried state across
+updates has the ordinary TBPTT stale-state semantics; it is not full BPTT.
+
+DDP pads a shuffled sequence permutation with zero-weight dummy records, not
+repeated real examples. Label/KD and hint denominators cover all ranks and every
+chunk in each accumulation window. The final shorter batch/window remains part
+of the fit. Loss is `WMSE(clipped labels) + kd_weight*WMSE(clipped teacher)
++ hint_weight*MSE(hints)`; label and KD use `abs(clipped labels)` weights.
+This additive objective is an explicit amendment, not the old alpha=0.9 mixture.
+
+Teacher hints are a frozen seed-1729 projection of the normalized last hidden
+row into 64 dimensions. Student hint projections are learned and removed for
+serving. The negative control rotates fitting components, keeps row position,
+and leaves output KD targets aligned. Components of unequal size reuse donor
+sequences; this control destroys correspondence, not every distributional cue.
+
+Caches bind checkpoint hash, model/context config, source provenance, full
+fit membership, split hash, ancestor chain, and every source-qualified output
+file hash. Warm-up rows remain present. Export uses disjoint rank shards and
+publishes `manifest.json` only on complete coverage. Score streams the canonical
+`GlobalAccumulator`; it never averages rank/sequence correlations.
+Rank logs contain global work/loss sums and rank-local elapsed time: their
+throughput fields are global throughput estimates, not each GPU's local rate.
+
+## Frozen panels and costs
+
+Cells are F0/student seed1001/teacher seed101001 and
+F2/student seed1002/teacher seed101002. These names are **not reservations**.
+Receiving operator must bind the actual canonical split manifests and claim
+the cells before fitting. All existing folds are exposed.
+
+| Panel | New fits | Exact prerequisite reuse | Question |
+|---|---:|---|---|
+| Transfer / PR28 | 2 T768×24 teachers + 2 GRU256 label controls + 2 GRU256 KD = **6** | None | Does this teacher help a matched GRU? |
+| Hints / PR29 | 2 aligned hints + 2 permuted hints = **4** | Two teachers/caches and two KD controls from transfer | Does correct representation alignment help beyond output KD? |
+| Streaming / PR30 | 2 T128×2 label controls + 2 T128×2 KD = **4** | Two teachers and four GRU endpoints from transfer | Does KD help the compact Transformer, and how does it compare with GRU? |
+| Width follow-up | 2 GRU512 labels + 2 GRU512 KD = **4** | Same teachers/caches | Does student capacity change transfer? |
+| Teacher scale follow-up | 2 T1280×32 + 2 T1792×40 teachers = **4** | Two T768×24 teachers | Does teacher quality improve at equal data passes? |
+
+Follow-ups require a separately recorded allocation; none run automatically.
+The scale panel is equal data passes, **not equal FLOPs or optimization tuning**,
+and measures no student benefit until a separately budgeted transfer comparison.
+Running all three initial panels costs 14 new fits, not 4–6 combined.
+Reusing a control requires identical source, config, split, seed and endpoint
+hash; an arbitrary existing 211-input teacher cannot be inserted by filename.
+
+## Receiving-host setup
+
+Run the following **on the allocated B300 host**, from this branch's checkout.
+Use a dedicated disk output root. Do not use RAM-backed scratch. Bind these
+environment variables to actual paths; no dataset download or private host
+identity is invented by this packet.
+
+```bash
+git switch experiment/b300-transformer-distillation-runtime
+git rev-parse HEAD
+uv sync --frozen
+export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src"
+export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
+export CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
+: "${WNN_DATA_ROOT:?datasets and cache directory required}"
+: "${WNN_SPLIT_F0:?canonical F0 split manifest required}"
+: "${WNN_RUN_ROOT:?dedicated physical-disk run directory required}"
+PACKET=research/experiment_drafts/b300-transformer-distillation-runtime
+CONFIG="$PACKET/configs/teacher_t768_l24_f0_s1001.json"
+```
+
+The existing lock selects research Torch/CUDA; record the actually installed
+build, driver, device names, free memory and topology (`nvidia-smi -q`,
+`nvidia-smi topo -m`) before admission. A container/name is not proof of B300
+kernel support. For copied datasets, preserve source identity or use the
+repository's verified `WNN_PORTABLE_DATA_MANIFEST` path; never bypass split checks.
+
+## Profile, fit, export, grade
+
+First complete [remote acceptance](REMOTE_ACCEPTANCE.md). Each architecture,
+batch/world-size and objective/cache configuration needs its own real-shape
+profile; these are engineering updates discarded afterwards, not scored fits.
+
+```bash
+uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=8 \
+  scripts/train_sequence.py --config "$CONFIG" \
+  --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$WNN_SPLIT_F0" \
+  --output "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0_profile" --profile-updates 8
+```
+
+Inspect the emitted profile receipt and diagnostics; record the reviewer,
+actual memory headroom, finite gradients and successful remote checks. Create
+an approved copy with `approved: true`, preserving all identity fields.
+A fresh full fit checks that receipt against its config/data/source/runtime
+and world size. Approval is a recorded B300 engineering decision, not a
+local test result.
+
+```bash
+uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=8 \
+  scripts/train_sequence.py --config "$CONFIG" \
+  --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$WNN_SPLIT_F0" \
+  --output "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0" \
+  --profile-receipt "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0_profile/approved_profile.json"
+
+uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=8 \
+  scripts/predict_sequence.py --checkpoint "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0/model.pt" \
+  --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$WNN_SPLIT_F0" \
+  --membership fit --output "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0_cache"
+
+uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=8 \
+  scripts/predict_sequence.py --checkpoint "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0/model.pt" \
+  --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$WNN_SPLIT_F0" \
+  --membership evaluation --output "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0_eval"
+
+uv run --no-sync python scripts/score_sequence.py \
+  --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$WNN_SPLIT_F0" \
+  --predictions "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0_eval" \
+  --output "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0/score.json"
+```
+
+For students, use the matching `gru256_labels_f0_s1001.json`,
+`gru256_kd_f0_s1001.json`, `gru256_hint_f0_s1001.json`,
+`gru256_permuted_hint_f0_s1001.json`, or `student_t128_*` config.
+One GPU per student is the starting profile candidate:
+`--nproc-per-node=1`. KD/hint profile **and** fit commands additionally require
+`--teacher-cache "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0_cache"`. Label-only controls reject a
+teacher cache. Use a fresh output/profile directory for every arm.
+Repeat the same commands with F2 manifest and `_f2_s1002.json` config; never
+reuse an F0 teacher on F2.
+
+Resume uses the same arguments and output plus
+`--resume "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0/training_state.pt"`; it restores only
+the last completed epoch boundary, including optimizer/scheduler, rank RNG,
+source/data/runtime identity and exact world size. A failed partial epoch is
+replayed from that safe boundary, not claimed as continued mid-sequence.
+Never change precision, world size or recipe under a resume ID.
+
+Final artifacts include `model.pt`, `training_state.pt`, run/progress/terminal
+records, per-sequence prediction files, hash manifests and `score.json`.
+Keep weights and resume files out of Git. Return separate weights/evidence
+archives with SHA256 and private storage location, retaining failures.
+64-dimensional full-row hints need about 5.28 MB per sequence before filesystem
+overhead; provision and measure NVMe capacity/read bandwidth before export.
+Held-out exports retain only the two predictions, not unused hint vectors.
+Use the existing `scripts/research_result_bundle.py` with explicit file lists:
+
+```bash
+uv run --no-sync python scripts/research_result_bundle.py \
+  --root "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0" --output-dir "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/t768_f0_bundle" \
+  --evidence run_metadata.json --evidence metrics.jsonl \
+  --evidence terminal_status.json --evidence score.json \
+  --evidence rank0.jsonl --evidence rank1.jsonl --evidence rank2.jsonl \
+  --evidence rank3.jsonl --evidence rank4.jsonl --evidence rank5.jsonl \
+  --evidence rank6.jsonl --evidence rank7.jsonl \
+  --weight model.pt --weight training_state.pt
+```
+
+For one-rank students include only rank0. Include any preserved interrupted log
+tails explicitly, and keep prediction/cache manifests with their separately
+stored arrays and hashes. The bundler never silently includes the supplied data.
+
+## Limits
+
+No GPU memory/throughput/parity or predictive gain is claimed. Old native211
+checkpoints require a separate reviewed input/output/ancestry adapter.
+This runtime exports FP32 research endpoints, not a competition ZIP.
+CPU one-core runtime, 20 MB package, offline ABI, reset/replay and full-test
+limits remain a separate measured submission acceptance step.
+
+Implementation references: [PyTorch DDP](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel.html),
+[SDPA masks/backends](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention.html),
+and [CUDA precision controls](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/cuda.html).
+These specify API behavior; they are not evidence of our model's B300 performance.

+# Receiving-host acceptance
+
+These checks are prepared, **unrun locally**. Execute on the allocated B300
+host before admitting scientific fits. Record command, source SHA, output,
+versions and actual device identity. A written checklist is not a passed check.
+
+1. Run `PYTHONPATH=src uv run --no-sync pytest -q
+   tests/test_b300_sequence_models.py tests/test_b300_sequence_contracts.py`.
+   These cover causal prefix invariance, chunk/row equivalence, state/reset/
+   detach, canonical GRU equality, checkpointed gradients, padding, objective
+   scaling, cache ancestry and malformed config rejection.
+2. Run the multi-rank synthetic acceptance command documented by
+   `scripts/check_sequence_ddp.py` on two allocated GPUs. Compare the globally
+   normalized accumulated gradient with a single-model reference, including
+   an empty rank and tail window. Save its JSON receipt.
+
+   ```bash
+   PYTHONPATH=src uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=2 \
+     scripts/check_sequence_ddp.py \
+     --output-receipt "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/ddp_acceptance.json"
+   ```
+
+3. On source-qualified real data, profile each intended config/world size with
+   eight updates. Require all updates finite, FP32 model/gradient/AdamW state,
+   TF32/autocast off, correct memory-growth plateau and sufficient device/host
+   headroom. Confirm train/validation component disjointness and source hashes.
+4. Interrupt a bounded disposable fit after one completed epoch; resume on the
+   same topology and compare final tensors/predictions with an uninterrupted
+   equivalent run. Prove config/data/cache/source/world-size mismatch rejection.
+   Do not count this resource-only exercise as a quality replication.
+5. Export one completed disposable endpoint using one and two ranks into
+   separate directories. Compare all arrays and exact membership; partial
+   shard failure must leave no complete manifest. Reset/A–B–A replay and
+   row-vs-chunk outputs must agree within frozen numerical tolerance.
+6. Recompute held-out score from immutable exported arrays with the canonical
+   official scorer. Verify no row duplication, first99 exclusion, clipping,
+   weighting and target order. Outer score is reporting only.
+
+Only then approve the exact production shape receipt. Start the six-fit
+transfer panel first; hints and streaming panels depend on its completed,
+hash-bound teachers/caches. Do not run optional follow-ups by default.
+
+The profile measures actual hardware, not all numerical invariants. An
+`approved` flag without the linked acceptance evidence is not a scientific or
+deployment validation claim.

+# [Experiment] Implement staged B300 teacher search and ensemble distillation
+
+The expanded B300 plan previously described experiments without runnable stage
+configs or ensemble targets. R4 now materializes complete source-bound cells,
+uses component-clean inner selection, reuses exact controls, confirms frozen
+recipes on outer folds and trains matched GRU students against labels, one
+teacher or three-teacher means. It reuses PR32's causal trainer, Muon with FP32
+master/update state, recovery, canonical scoring and R3 admission rather than adding a training loop.
+
+[Precision amendment](../PRECISION_AMENDMENT_20261024.md): new R4 cells explicitly
+use the PR40 BF16/BF16x9 runtime. Historical strict-FP32 packets and the active
+four W2 teacher fits retain their source pins; this is a new combined source.
+
+[Receiving-host commands](README.md)
+and [allocation and complete recipe](recipe.json).
+G reference and candidate share the amended precision/backend/compiler settings.
+The existing four-fit R3 packet remains unchanged. No local tests, model imports,
+training, inference or GPU profiling were run. No jobs were dispatched.
+
+1. **Status and lineage.** E/H-B300-HIGH-COMPUTE-R4-20261024 implements the
+   conditional successor to R3 in the same PR targeting `research-team`.
+   `launch_ready=false`: receiving-host correctness and resource acceptance are
+   still required. Preparation is executable; predictive results do not exist.
+2. **Mechanism and family.** Teacher branches test LR, warmup, forward context,
+   chunk/backward horizon and capacity. G tests robustness of a frozen candidate;
+   H tests the teacher–student connection. Better teacher fit or compute alone
+   does not establish better CPU student predictions. Sequential coordinate
+   search can miss interactions and is not a claim of optimal hyperparameters.
+3. **Compute advantage.** Every new R4 fit uses an eight-B300 DDP group with BF16
+   autocast and process-wide cuBLAS BF16x9 emulation. Master weights, gradients,
+   loss and optimizer state remain FP32; Muon GEMMs are not IEEE-FP32 guaranteed.
+   Teachers use efficient attention and compiled blocks, recomputation off.
+   Additional disjoint groups can execute independent
+   cells with separately allocated RAM and scratch. Models/optimizers are fully
+   replicated. Larger context/capacity and three-seed teacher means consume
+   additional compute; measured GPU-hours and endpoint quality decide whether
+   that cost is useful. No performance estimate is presented as measurement.
+4. **Frozen parameters.** Thirty epochs, final index 29, unprofiled batch 2/rank, clip 1,
+   dropout 0, full fitting-only normalization and causal raw112 input. Teachers
+   use R3 Muon/auxiliary AdamW, LR candidates 1e-4/3e-4/1e-3, warmup 1%/5%/10%,
+   cosine floor .1, contexts 1024/2048/4096, chunk 512/accumulation 8 versus chunk 2048/accumulation 2,
+   and 1792×40×28heads versus 2560×40×40heads. H fixes GRU512×2, AdamW 3e-4,
+   beta (.9,.95), eps 1e-8, WD .01, warmup 5%, cosinefloor .1, chunk 512/accumulation 8,
+   hint dimension 0, KD weight 0/1. All concrete configs include every loader field.
+5. **Allocation.** B6 + C4 + D4 + E2 + F2 + G12 teachers and H6 students: 36 additional
+   fits, or 40 including the original four A/R3 teachers. C–F reuse exact
+   completed controls. If the selected recipe equals the G reference, six
+   duplicate teacher fits are aliases: 34 total including A. Nominal cost is
+   1,020 teacher fit-epochs and 180 student fit-epochs; size and membership differ.
+   Failed attempts and all engineering profiles/exports are recorded separately.
+   Stages require explicit advancement; no automatic queue or blind retry.
+6. **Validation and statistics.** B–F use two frozen inner component holdouts
+   from outer fitting pools. G crosses 3 new seeds with F0/F2 on full outer fitting
+   membership; H uses 2 matched student cells. Canonical pooled clip2 weighted Pearson,
+   per-target results and paired component bootstrap accompany fixed-final
+   endpoint receipts. Exposed outer folds and correlated components/seeds do not
+   become untouched data or guarantee significance through repetition.
+7. **Leakage and lineage.** Inner reservation removes whole connected
+   components, including their train rows, from fit. The loader rederives exact
+   membership and parent/source hashes. Normalizers see only the corresponding
+   fit set. Every reused endpoint binds source/config/split/weights/score and
+   prediction manifest. H parents are fixed G candidate seeds 301001/301002/301003;
+   single KD uses 301001 before viewing scores. No best-seed or outer-checkpoint
+   selection, future-label inputs or reused outer-fit controls for inner search.
+8. **Decision.** Retain all arms, including explicit failures; choose only
+   variants with both required completed fold endpoints and give a reason.
+   Mean WP gain ≥.001 without a fold regression is a useful signal considered
+   with variation/cost, not a mechanical significance criterion. Mixed results
+   motivate narrower diagnosis. Intervals crossing zero do not close the family.
+   G/H comparisons do not automatically change recipes or launch follow-ups.
+9. **Execution and acceptance.** Immutable materialization, explicit per-cell
+   profile-one/eight/peak, admission, fit/resume/evaluate/cache/bundle commands.
+   R4 receiver checks extend R3 CUDA recovery and objective/Muon DDP parity with
+   inner-split, ensemble, staged-campaign and BF16 streaming/backend contracts.
+   Legacy checks disable cuBLAS emulation in separate subprocesses. Exact 12-update profiles,
+   finite gradients, peak-LR stress, 20% GPU reserve and conservative host/disk
+   admission are prerequisites. No local correctness/performance pass is implied.
+10. **Transfer and artifacts.** One/eight-rank full-fit prediction parity binds
+    each completed G teacher before KD. Streaming FP32 mean merge requires
+    three distinct same-recipe seeds, preserves original parent provenance and
+    publishes atomically. It creates a composition identity, not a fake model
+    checkpoint. H compares the same student with labels/singleKD/mean3KD.

+    asserted by raw112 training code.
+11. **Evidence.** Static Ruff/AST/JSON/shell/module-structure checks and independent
+    source review only, recorded in R4 VALIDATION.json. Tests are prepared for
+    B300 and deliberately unexecuted locally. No empirical LR optimum, full
+    memory fit, convergence, teacher gain, student gain or submission result.
+    Unified index and append-only ledgers link this implementation to the
+    earlier plan without rewriting historical allocations.

+# B300 high-compute campaign — BF16/BF16x9 R4 continuation
+
+This implements stages B–H of the [expanded plan](../HIGH_COMPUTE_PLAN_20261024.md)
+in [PR #32](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/32). Each stage
+materializes complete trainer configs and explicit commands. It does not launch
+a queue. **No tests, training, inference or profiles have been run locally. B300
+acceptance and all scientific results are pending.** No hardware has been booked.
+
+**24 October correction:** [Precision amendment](../PRECISION_AMENDMENT_20261024.md).
+New materializations explicitly use `bf16_bf16x9`. Old materializations and
+receiver receipts require a new campaign root at this source revision; they are
+not resumable under the amended configuration. The team’s active four W2 fits
+remain pinned to PR40 source and are not changed by this package.
+
+The four [R3 teachers](../large_teacher_r3_muon30/README.md) remain stage A, with
+their historical configs unchanged. R4 adds up to **30 teacher and six student
+fits**, conditional on the choices below: 40 fits including A, or 34 if the final
+candidate equals the reference and six duplicate G fits are eliminated. These
+are fit counts, not GPU-hour estimates. Every teacher and student trains for
+30 epochs. Profiles, exports, failed attempts and recovery cost extra.
+
+## The implemented comparisons
+
+| Stage | Variant keys | New fits | Evaluation |
+|---|---|---:|---|
+| B | `lr_1e-4`, `lr_3e-4`, `lr_1e-3` | 6 teachers | Inner component holdout |
+| C | `warmup_0.01`, `warmup_0.05`, `warmup_0.10` | 4; reuse two B controls | Same inner holdout |
+| D | `context_1024`, `context_2048`, `context_4096` | 4; reuse two selected controls | Same inner holdout |
+| E | `chunk512_acc8`, `chunk2048_acc2` | 2; reuse two controls | Same inner holdout |
+| F | `teacher_1.54B`, `teacher_3.15B` | 2; reuse two controls | Same inner holdout |
+| G | `reference`, `candidate`; seeds 301001/301002/301003 × F0/F2 | 12, or 6 unique fits if identical | Exposed outer F0/F2 |
+| H | `labels`, `single_kd`, `mean3_kd` | 6 students; reuse G teachers | Exposed outer F0/F2 |
+
+B–F use seeds 201001 on F0 and 201002 on F2. The inner manifests reserve entire
+source-qualified components from each outer fitting pool; every remaining
+fitting sequence is used. Normalization is recomputed only from that inner
+fitting membership. Outer evaluation components never enter either inner pool.
+This is full inner training, not a 10%/30% proxy. G/H return to complete outer
+fitting membership. Inner and outer scores are not interchangeable controls.
+
+All teachers use causal raw112 inputs, BF16 autocast with cuBLAS BF16x9,
+efficient exact-window attention, compiled blocks and no activation recomputation.
+Master weights, gradients, loss, optimizer and carried state remain FP32. Muon
+uses auxiliary AdamW; its FP32 tensor operations may use cuBLAS emulation.
+Every fit runs 30 epochs and uses final checkpoint index 29. Start with the R3 1792×40, 28-head,
+FF×4 model, context1024, chunk512, accumulation8, batch2/rank and eight ranks.
+The larger F teacher is 2560×40 with 40 heads (~3.15B parameters). Muon uses
+momentum .95, five FP32 Newton–Schulz iterations, epsilon1e-7 and independent Q/K/V
+updates in the RMS-matched LR convention. This is not IEEE-FP32 equivalence.
+Auxiliary AdamW beta=(.9,.95), eps1e-8;
+matrix decay .01, vector/bias decay0, clip1, dropout0. B starts at warmup5%; every
+schedule ends at .1×peak. See [R3 parameters](../large_teacher_r3_muon30/PARAMETERS.md)
+for exact scheduler indexing and optimizer groups. These are candidates to
+measure, not empirically optimal settings.
+
+E changes chunk shape, backward horizon and accumulation together. It keeps
+4096 new rows per sequence per full update and the selected forward context;
+do not attribute its result to backward horizon alone. F transfers the selected
+LR to a larger model; it does not establish that size's optimal LR.
+
+H freezes a raw112 GRU512×2 student with BF16/BF16x9 compute and FP32 carried
+state, without Transformer compilation or attention flags: AdamW LR3e-4, beta=(.9,.95), eps1e-8,
+decay.01, clip1, dropout0, 5% warmup/cosine floor.1, chunk512/accumulation8,
+batch2×8 ranks, 30 epochs, all-fit normalization, all post-warmup label rows,
+two outputs and no hints. Seeds are 401001/F0 and 401002/F2. Labels use KD weight0;
+both KD arms use weight1. Single KD always uses G candidate seed301001; mean KD
+uses an equal FP32 mean of all three candidate seeds of that fold, without
+clipping each teacher before averaging. Teacher choice is frozen before reading
+G scores. No student architecture or seed is chosen from H outcomes.
+
+## Receiving-host setup and stage preparation
+
+Use a clean checkout of this PR's reviewed commit on the allocated Linux B300
+host. Run `uv sync --frozen` there. Do not change the locked Torch/precision to
+make a profile pass. Inputs and run artifacts live outside the checkout on real
+disk, not RAM-backed scratch. Paths below are placeholders for existing data and
+canonical F0/F2 manifests; the preparation commands validate their ancestry.
+
+```bash
+export WNN_EXPECTED_COMMIT='<reviewed full PR #32 commit SHA>'
+export WNN_DATA_ROOT='/actual/data/root'
+export WNN_SPLIT_F0='/actual/canonical/f0.json'
+export WNN_SPLIT_F2='/actual/canonical/f2.json'
+export WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT='/actual/nvme/b300-high-compute-r4'
+export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='<exact eight allocated GPU IDs or UUIDs>'
+export WNN_HOST_RAM_BUDGET_GIB='<host RAM allocated to this eight-rank fit>'
+export WNN_REVIEWER='<receiving operator>'
+export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src"
+export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
+export CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
+export CUBLAS_EMULATE_SINGLE_PRECISION=1
+PACKET=research/experiment_drafts/b300-transformer-distillation-runtime/high_compute_r4
+INPUTS='/actual/nvme/b300-high-compute-inputs'
+mkdir -p "$INPUTS"
+
+uv run --no-sync python scripts/prepare_sequence_inner_split.py \
+  --parent-manifest "$WNN_SPLIT_F0" --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" \
+  --seed 41001 --evaluation-fraction 0.2 --output "$INPUTS/inner-f0.json"
+uv run --no-sync python scripts/prepare_sequence_inner_split.py \
+  --parent-manifest "$WNN_SPLIT_F2" --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" \
+  --seed 41002 --evaluation-fraction 0.2 --output "$INPUTS/inner-f2.json"
+
+uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/campaign.py" init \
+  --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" \
+  --outer-f0 "$WNN_SPLIT_F0" --outer-f2 "$WNN_SPLIT_F2" \
+  --inner-f0 "$INPUTS/inner-f0.json" --inner-f2 "$INPUTS/inner-f2.json"
+uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/campaign.py" prepare \
+  --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage B
+
+# Once for this exact source: CPU contract tests, actual CUDA recovery,
+# two-rank objective/Muon parity plus BF16 streaming/backend checks.
+# Legacy checks disable emulation in separate subprocesses. Runs on B300 only.
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" check --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT"
+```
+
+`campaign.json` binds runtime, packet, original R3 configs, data root and both
+split layers. Each stage records every new/reused cell and hashes its complete
+production, one-rank and peak-LR configs. Changes to those inputs fail closed.
+Nothing creates training weights during `init` or `prepare`.
+
+## One cell at a time
+
+```bash
+STAGE=B
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" list --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage "$STAGE"
+CELL='<id of a cell with reused=false from list>'
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" profile-one --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage "$STAGE" --cell "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" profile-eight --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage "$STAGE" --cell "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" profile-peak --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage "$STAGE" --cell "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" admit --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage "$STAGE" --cell "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" fit --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage "$STAGE" --cell "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" evaluate --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage "$STAGE" --cell "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" bundle --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage "$STAGE" --cell "$CELL"
+```
+
+Each profile performs twelve real optimizer updates. One-rank differs only by
+world size; peak stress differs only by warmup0. Admission reuses R3 checks for
+exact source/data/runtime, finite gradients, near-peak LR, 20% GPU headroom,
+conservative host resume memory and disk capacity. It does not prove full-run
+stability. Repeat this sequence for each **new** allocated cell, including H. These W8 batch2 settings are unprofiled starting points; PR40’s
+W2 batches96/64 and measured memory headroom do not transfer to these shapes.
+Reused controls retain their original paths and cannot be relaunched as new fits.
+Disjoint eight-GPU groups can run independent cells concurrently with per-fit
+host budgets; do not change the rank count or global batch to fill idle devices.
+
+For a genuine interrupted fit use `resume` with the same arguments. It restores
+the last completed epoch and replays a partial epoch under the existing strict
+source/config/device contract. Do not delete failure evidence, overwrite a
+profile/export directory or splice checkpoints from different cells. Failed
+receiver checks can use a new `--check-id attempt2` before an acceptance pointer
+has been published. Failed profiles/exports need a separately retained attempt
+root and explicit reallocation; no automatic retry is hidden here.
+
+## Finish and freeze each stage
+
+After every B–F arm has a fixed-final score or a recorded failure, explicitly
+select a completed variant. Both of its fold cells must succeed. Selection
+records the reason and all comparison evidence; later stages revalidate it.
+Instability is retained as a failure, not replaced with an earlier good epoch.
+
+```bash
+# Example syntax only: choose from the observed B results, not this example.
+uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/campaign.py" select \
+  --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage B --variant lr_3e-4 \
+  --reason '<decision from all B scores, variation and compute cost>'
+uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/campaign.py" prepare \
+  --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage C
+
+# A failed arm needs a written reason and actual preserved evidence.
+uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/campaign.py" record-failure \
+  --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage B --cell '<failed cell id>' \
+  --phase fit \
+  --reason '<numerical failure or infrastructure diagnosis; do not conflate them>' \
+  --evidence '<absolute path to preserved terminal status or command log>'
+```
+
+Continue `select C → prepare D`, then D→E, E→F, F→G. Inspect each stage before
+allocating its new fits. G freezes both recipes before any new outer scores and
+does not require another choice. `compare --stage G` reports paired results
+without selecting a seed or a checkpoint. H uses the already frozen G candidate,
+even if the reference scores better; deciding not to spend on H is an operator
+decision, not an automatic rewrite of teacher ancestry.
+
+```bash
+uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/campaign.py" compare \
+  --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage G
+uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/campaign.py" prepare \
+  --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage H
+```
+
+## Export the frozen teachers, then distill
+
+For each of the six G candidate endpoints (three seeds per fold), use its
+original **new** cell ID from `list --stage G`. If candidate/reference recipes
+were identical, use the new reference cell behind the candidate alias.
+
+```bash
+CELL='<original new G candidate cell id>'
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" cache --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage G --cell "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" cache-parity --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage G --cell "$CELL"
+
+# Once per fold, after all three G parents pass export parity:
+CELL='<H mean3_kd cell id for this fold>'
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" merge-cache --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage H --cell "$CELL"
+```
+
+`cache-parity` exports the complete fitting membership on one GPU, checks it
+against the eight-GPU export with rtol1e-5/atol1e-6 and publishes a hash-bound
+receipt. All arrays must be finite FP32, 20,000×2, with identical membership and
+producer. Keep both exports and receipts while this campaign depends on them.
+The merge streams one sequence at a time, requires three distinct seeds and
+checkpoints of the same recipe/split/source, preserves full parent provenance,
+and publishes only a completed directory. It does not invent a checkpoint hash
+for an arithmetic ensemble. Before H profiles/fits, dispatch verifies exactly
+the selected parents, their completed endpoints, parity receipts and merged
+composition. Cache manifests and payload hashes remain checked by the trainer.
+
+Run the profile/admit/fit/evaluate/bundle commands above for all six H cells.
+Finally use `campaign.py compare --campaign-root "$WNN_CAMPAIGN_ROOT" --stage H`.
+The result compares each KD student against its matched label-only student,
+not teacher quality as a proxy for student improvement.
+
+## Evidence and limits
+
+Return all stage manifests, selections/failures, canonical score files,
+predictions, paired component intervals, profile/check/admission receipts and
+logs. Preserve every attempted arm. `bundle` separates fit evidence and weights;
+retain sibling profile/check/cache directories separately in private storage.
+Training source is identical across staged cells; a source fix requires new
+checks/profiles and a newly declared campaign, not silent reuse of old controls.
+
+F0/F2 are exposed. Inner search is development; G's six paired fold/seed cells
+and H's two paired cells are robustness evidence. Neither correlated repeats nor
+a component bootstrap establishes independent statistical significance or a
+public score. A mean WP gain of .001 with no fold regression is a useful
+predeclared signal, considered with uncertainty and cost; an interval crossing
+zero does not close a model family. Sequential tuning can miss LR–warmup and
+other interactions; those require separately allocated follow-ups.
+
+Large teachers are research assets. The raw112 GRU student still needs measured
+Python3.11/offline/one-core CPU inference, 16GB RAM, 60-minute runtime and 20MB ZIP
+acceptance before submission. Native211/TL3 is a separate adapter. Quantization
+and submission packaging are separate from these mixed-precision experiments.
+
+G reference controls inherit R3 architecture/optimization settings with the same
+BF16/backend/compiler amendment as candidate cells; R3 FP32 endpoints are not
+matched controls. All new source/config identities require fresh admission.
+
+The [recipe](recipe.json), [scientific contract](PR.md) and
+[static validation record](VALIDATION.json) define the current implementation
+and the checks that remain unexecuted.
+
+Implementation map: `campaign.py` exposes preparation and selection;
+`campaign_io.py`, `source_bindings.py` and `split_inputs.py` bind immutable inputs;
+`catalog.py` and `templates/student_gru512.json` define complete trainer recipes;
+`cell_materialize.py`, `stage_inner.py`, `stage_outer.py`, `stage_support.py` and
+`materialize.py` write and revalidate stages. `endpoints.py`, `failure_receipts.py`,
+`results.py`, `comparisons.py` and `paired_metrics.py` retain fixed outcomes and
+reasoned choices. `run.sh`/`dispatch.py` execute explicit receiver actions;
+`runner_checks.py`, `admit.py` and `cache_parity.py` enforce their prerequisites.
+`parent_cache_config.py` binds single and ensemble KD inputs to the declared G
+producer configs. The shared inner-split and cache-merge entrypoints live in `scripts/` and reuse
+`wnn.splits` and the existing sequence trainer's teacher-cache interface.

+"""Extend the frozen R3 receiver admission with R4 component checks."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from catalog import normalized_runtime_config
+
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+R3 = PACKET.parent / "large_teacher_r3_muon30"
+sys.path.insert(0, str(R3))
+import admission as base  # noqa: E402 - reuse the frozen R3 admission implementation
+
+NEW_TESTS = (
+    "test_sequence_inner_splits",
+    "test_sequence_cache_ensemble",
+    "test_high_compute_campaign",
+    "test_high_compute_runner",
+    "test_sequence_precision",
+    "test_sequence_attention_backends",
+    "test_sequence_compile",
+    "test_sequence_precision_cuda",
+)
+PRECISION_MODE = "bf16_bf16x9"
+# Config and receipt objects are heterogeneous JSON values at this admission boundary.
+PRECISION_IDENTITY = {
+    "mode": PRECISION_MODE,
+    "cublas_emulate_single_precision": "1",
+    "parameter_dtype": "float32",
+    "gradient_dtype": "float32",
+    "optimizer_state_dtype": "float32",
+    "activation_cache_dtype": "float32",
+    "amp_scaler": False,
+    "model_compute": "BF16 autocast plus process-wide cuBLAS single-precision emulation",
+    "model_forward": "FP32 tensor interface with BF16 autocast and cuBLAS emulation",
+    "loss": "FP32 after prediction and hint casts",
+    "optimizer": "process-wide cuBLAS emulation may affect Muon operations",
+}
+
+
+def _require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
+    """Fail closed when a profile does not match the frozen R4 runtime contract."""
+    if not condition:
+        raise ValueError(message)
+
+
+def _check_config_contract(config: dict[str, Any], *, require_eight_ranks: bool = True) -> str:
+    """Return the required attention backend for an admitted R4 cell config."""
+    model = config.get("model")
+    _require(isinstance(model, dict), "R4 profile config lacks a model object")
+    _require(config.get("precision_mode") == PRECISION_MODE, "R4 requires bf16_bf16x9")
+    _require(config.get("batch_size") == 2, "R4 freezes batch_size=2 on every rank")
+    if require_eight_ranks:
+        _require(
+            config.get("required_world_size") == 8, "R4 production profiles require eight ranks"
+        )
+    else:
+        _require(config.get("required_world_size") in (1, 8), "invalid R4 profile world size")
+    architecture = model.get("architecture")
+    if architecture == "transformer":
+        _require(
+            model.get("attention_backend") == "efficient", "R4 teachers require efficient attention"
+        )
+        _require(model.get("compile_blocks") is True, "R4 teachers require compiled blocks")
+        _require(model.get("checkpoint_blocks") is False, "R4 teachers disable block checkpointing")
+        return "efficient"
+    if architecture == "gru":
+        _require(model.get("attention_backend") == "math", "R4 GRU uses the math attention setting")
+        _require(model.get("compile_blocks") is False, "R4 GRU must not compile Transformer blocks")
+        return "math"
+    raise ValueError("R4 supports only Transformer teachers and GRU students")
+
+
+def _check_runtime_contract(config: dict[str, Any], identity: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Bind explicit precision, attention, and compiler provenance for one profile."""
+    backend = _check_config_contract(config, require_eight_ranks=False)
+    runtime = identity.get("runtime")
+    _require(isinstance(runtime, dict), "profile lacks runtime identity")
+    precision = dict(PRECISION_IDENTITY) | {"attention_backend": backend}
+    _require(runtime.get("precision") == precision, "profile precision identity differs from R4")
+    _require(
+        runtime.get("attention_backend") == backend, "profile attention backend differs from R4"
+    )
+    compiled = config["model"]["architecture"] == "transformer"
+    compiler = {
+        "enabled": compiled,
+        "backend": "inductor" if compiled else None,
+        "mode": "default" if compiled else None,
+        "fullgraph": False,
+        "dynamic": None,
+        "recompile_limit": 64 if compiled else None,
+    }
+    _require(runtime.get("compiler") == compiler, "profile compiler identity differs from R4")
+    _require(runtime.get("matmul_precision") == "highest", "R4 requires FP32 matmul controls")
+    _require(runtime.get("matmul_tf32") is False, "R4 requires TF32 matmul to remain disabled")
+    _require(runtime.get("cudnn_tf32") is False, "R4 requires cuDNN TF32 to remain disabled")
+    _require(runtime.get("autocast") is False, "R4 expects autocast disabled outside model forward")
+    _require(runtime.get("amp_scaler") is False, "R4 does not use an AMP gradient scaler")
+    _require(
+        runtime.get("cublas_workspace_config") == ":4096:8",
+        "R4 requires CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8",
+    )
+
+
+def _check_profile_runtime(path: Path, config: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Validate the exact precision and compiler identity recorded by a profile."""
+    profile = base.read(path)
+    identity = profile.get("identity")
+    _require(isinstance(identity, dict), f"profile lacks an identity: {path}")
+    _check_runtime_contract(config, identity)
+
+
+def accept_checks(directory: Path) -> None:
+    """Require execution of every R4 module before extending the R3 receipt."""
+    cases = list(ET.parse(directory / "pytest.xml").getroot().iter("testcase"))
+    for name in NEW_TESTS:
+        if not any(name in case.get("classname", "").split(".") for case in cases):
+            raise ValueError(f"R4 receiver checks did not execute {name}")
+    base.accept_checks(directory)
+    receipt = base.read(directory / "acceptance.json")
+    paths = [base.ROOT / "tests" / f"{name}.py" for name in NEW_TESTS]
+    paths += [
+        base.ROOT / "scripts" / name
+        for name in ("prepare_sequence_inner_split.py", "merge_sequence_teacher_caches.py")
+    ]
+    paths += [p for p in PACKET.rglob("*") if p.suffix in {".py", ".sh", ".json"}]
+    paths += [p for p in R3.iterdir() if p.suffix in {".py", ".sh"}]
+    receipt["files"].update({str(path.resolve()): base.file_hash(path) for path in paths})
+    receipt["extension"] = "wnn.high-compute-checks.v1"
+    receipt["limits"] = "Receiver correctness checks only; no fit, quality or resource approval."
+    base.write_new(directory / "r4_acceptance.json", receipt)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run explicit correctness or per-cell profile admission on the receiver."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
+    checks = sub.add_parser("checks")
+    checks.add_argument("--directory", type=Path, required=True)
+    profile = sub.add_parser("profile")
+    for name in ("directory", "checks", "config"):
+        profile.add_argument(f"--{name}", type=Path, required=True)
+    profile.add_argument("--reviewer", required=True)
+    profile.add_argument("--host-ram-gib", type=float, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.action == "checks":
+        accept_checks(args.directory)
+    else:
+        if base.read(args.checks).get("extension") != "wnn.high-compute-checks.v1":
+            raise ValueError("R4 requires its complete receiver acceptance receipt")
+        raw_config = base.read(args.config)
+        backend = _check_config_contract(raw_config)
+        normalized_config = normalized_runtime_config(raw_config)
+        _require(
+            normalized_config["model"].get("attention_backend") == backend,
+            "normalized profile config changes the R4 attention backend",
+        )
+        one_config = normalized_config | {"required_world_size": 1}
+        peak_config = normalized_config | {"warmup_fraction": 0.0}
+        _check_profile_runtime(args.directory / "profile-one/profile_receipt.json", one_config)
+        _check_profile_runtime(
+            args.directory / "profile-eight/profile_receipt.json", normalized_config
+        )
+        _check_profile_runtime(args.directory / "profile-peak/profile_receipt.json", peak_config)
+        normalized_path = args.directory / "admission-normalized-config.json"
+        binding_path = args.directory / "r4_admission_binding.json"
+        if any(
+            path.exists()
+            for path in (normalized_path, args.directory / "approved_profile.json", binding_path)
+        ):
+            raise FileExistsError(
+                "R4 admission evidence is immutable; begin a new attempt to retry"
+            )
+        with normalized_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            json.dump(normalized_config, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+            stream.write("\n")
+        normalized_args = argparse.Namespace(**(vars(args) | {"config": normalized_path}))
+        base.admit(normalized_args)
+        binding = {
+            "schema": "wnn.high-compute-r4-admission-binding.v1",
+            "raw_config_path": str(args.config.resolve()),
+            "raw_config_sha256": base.file_hash(args.config),
+            "normalized_config_path": str(normalized_path.resolve()),
+            "normalized_config_sha256": base.file_hash(normalized_path),
+            "approved_profile_path": str((args.directory / "approved_profile.json").resolve()),
+            "approved_profile_sha256": base.file_hash(args.directory / "approved_profile.json"),
+        }
+        base.write_new(binding_path, binding)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Whole-cache single-rank versus eight-rank export acceptance on the receiver."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from wnn.splits import file_sha256, load_campaign_split
+from wnn.training.sequence_cache import TeacherCache
+
+
+def compare_caches(
+    one: Path, eight: Path, data_root: Path, split_manifest: Path, output: Path
+) -> None:
+    """Compare every fitting row from the same checkpoint and bind both manifests."""
+    split = load_campaign_split(split_manifest, data_root)
+    members = [("train", g) for g in split.train_groups] + [
+        ("valid", g) for g in split.valid_groups
+    ]
+    left, right = TeacherCache(one, split, members), TeacherCache(eight, split, members)
+    if left.metadata["producer"] != right.metadata["producer"]:
+        raise ValueError("cache parity requires the same complete checkpoint ancestry")
+    if left.metadata["world_size"] != 1 or right.metadata["world_size"] != 8:
+        raise ValueError("cache parity requires actual one- and eight-rank exports")
+    if left.metadata["hint_dim"] != 0 or right.metadata["hint_dim"] != 0:
+        raise ValueError("R4 output-distillation caches must have no hidden hints")
+    manifests = {
+        "one": file_sha256(one / "manifest.json"),
+        "eight": file_sha256(eight / "manifest.json"),
+    }
+    maximum = 0.0
+    for member in members:
+        first = np.load(one / left.entries[member]["file"], mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+        second = np.load(eight / right.entries[member]["file"], mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+        if any(
+            value.dtype != np.float32 or value.shape != (20_000, 2) for value in (first, second)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("invalid parity array shape or dtype")
+        if not np.isfinite(first).all() or not np.isfinite(second).all():
+            raise ValueError("nonfinite parity arrays")
+        maximum = max(maximum, float(np.max(np.abs(first - second))))
+        if not np.allclose(first, second, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6):
+            raise ValueError(f"one/eight-rank export parity failed at {member}")
+        for root, cache in ((one, left), (eight, right)):
+            entry = cache.entries[member]
+            if file_sha256(root / entry["file"]) != entry["sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError("cache payload changed during parity verification")
+    if manifests != {
+        "one": file_sha256(one / "manifest.json"),
+        "eight": file_sha256(eight / "manifest.json"),
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("cache manifest changed during parity verification")
+    receipt = {
+        "schema": "wnn.sequence-cache-parity.v1",
+        "passed": True,
+        "split_sha256": split.sha256,
+        "checkpoint_sha256": left.metadata["producer"]["checkpoint_sha256"],
+        "manifest_sha256": manifests,
+        "sequences": len(members),
+        "max_abs_error": maximum,
+        "rtol": 1e-5,
+        "atol": 1e-6,
+    }
+    with output.open("x") as stream:
+        json.dump(receipt, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Dispatch whole-cache acceptance without running a model."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    for name in ("one", "eight", "data-root", "split-manifest", "output"):
+        parser.add_argument(f"--{name}", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    compare_caches(args.one, args.eight, args.data_root, args.split_manifest, args.output)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Initialize, materialize, compare, and manually select R4 campaign cells."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from campaign_io import REPO_ROOT, create_campaign, load_campaign, require
+from comparisons import compare_stage
+from failure_receipts import record_failure
+from materialize import SELECTABLE_STAGES, STAGES, get_cell, prepare_stage
+from results import select_variant
+
+
+def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    """Build the staged campaign CLI without importing training code."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    initialize = subparsers.add_parser(
+        "init", help="bind immutable runtime, recipe, and split inputs"
+    )
+    initialize.add_argument("--campaign-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    initialize.add_argument("--outer-f0", type=Path, required=True)
+    initialize.add_argument("--outer-f2", type=Path, required=True)
+    initialize.add_argument("--inner-f0", type=Path, required=True)
+    initialize.add_argument("--inner-f2", type=Path, required=True)
+    initialize.add_argument("--data-root", type=Path, default=REPO_ROOT)
+
+    prepare = subparsers.add_parser(
+        "prepare", help="materialize one conditional stage; never runs fits"
+    )
+    prepare.add_argument("--campaign-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    prepare.add_argument("--stage", choices=STAGES, required=True)
+
+    selection = subparsers.add_parser("select", help="record a manual B-F recipe choice")
+    selection.add_argument("--campaign-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    selection.add_argument("--stage", choices=SELECTABLE_STAGES, required=True)
+    selection.add_argument("--variant", required=True)
+    selection.add_argument("--reason", required=True)
+
+    compare = subparsers.add_parser(
+        "compare", help="compare fixed endpoints without choosing a winner"
+    )
+    compare.add_argument("--campaign-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    compare.add_argument("--stage", choices=STAGES, required=True)
+
+    failed = subparsers.add_parser(
+        "record-failure", help="bind one terminal failed attempt to logs and source"
+    )
+    failed.add_argument("--campaign-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    failed.add_argument("--stage", choices=STAGES, required=True)
+    failed.add_argument("--cell", required=True)
+    failed.add_argument("--reason", required=True)
+    failed.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, action="append", required=True)
+    failed.add_argument(
+        "--phase",
+        choices=(
+            "profile_one",
+            "profile_eight",
+            "profile_peak",
+            "admission",
+            "fit",
+            "evaluate",
+        ),
+        default="fit",
+    )
+    return parser
+
+
+def _run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Execute one metadata-only campaign operation."""
+    if args.command == "init":
+        create_campaign(
+            args.campaign_root,
+            args.data_root,
+            {0: args.outer_f0, 2: args.outer_f2},
+            {0: args.inner_f0, 2: args.inner_f2},
+        )
+        campaign = load_campaign(args.campaign_root)
+        return {
+            "campaign_root": str(args.campaign_root.expanduser().resolve()),
+            "campaign_sha256": campaign["campaign_sha256"],
+            "runtime_source_sha256": campaign["runtime_source_sha256"],
+            "automatic_fit": False,
+        }
+    if args.command == "prepare":
+        return prepare_stage(args.campaign_root, args.stage)
+    if args.command == "select":
+        return select_variant(args.campaign_root, args.stage, args.variant, args.reason)
+    if args.command == "compare":
+        return compare_stage(args.campaign_root, args.stage)
+    if args.command == "record-failure":
+        campaign = load_campaign(args.campaign_root)
+        cell = get_cell(args.campaign_root, args.stage, args.cell)
+        require(
+            not cell.get("reused"), "cannot record a new attempt against an exact reused endpoint"
+        )
+        return record_failure(
+            args.campaign_root, campaign, cell, args.reason, args.evidence, args.phase
+        )
+    raise ValueError(f"unsupported command: {args.command}")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run one safe metadata operation and report validation errors cleanly."""
+    parser = _parser()
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        result = _run(args)
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
+        parser.error(str(error))
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
