+"""Validate frozen outer splits and deterministic component-disjoint inner wrappers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from campaign_io import read_object, require, sha256_file
+
+INNER_SCHEMA = "wnn.sequence-inner-split.v1"
+
+
+def _group_map(manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[tuple[str, int], int]:
+    """Map each split/row-group identity to its connected-component ID."""
+    sequences = manifest.get("sequences")
+    require(isinstance(sequences, dict), "split sequences must be an object")
+    result: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}
+    for split, records in sequences.items():
+        require(
+            split in ("train", "valid") and isinstance(records, list),
+            "bad split sequence section",
+        )
+        for record in records:
+            require(isinstance(record, dict), "split sequence record must be an object")
+            key = (split, int(record["row_group"]))
+            require(key not in result, f"duplicate split sequence: {key}")
+            result[key] = int(record["component"])
+    return result
+
+
+def _group_list(mapping: dict[str, Any], section: str, split: str) -> set[int]:
+    """Read one nonempty, unique row-group membership list."""
+    values = mapping.get(section, {}).get(split)
+    require(isinstance(values, list) and values, f"{section}.{split} must be nonempty")
+    result = {int(value) for value in values}
+    require(len(result) == len(values), f"duplicate group in {section}.{split}")
+    require(min(result) >= 0, f"negative group in {section}.{split}")
+    return result
+
+
+def validate_outer_inner_pair(
+    outer_path: Path,
+    outer: dict[str, Any],
+    inner_path: Path,
+    inner: dict[str, Any],
+    fold: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Bind the wrapper to its outer parent and validate deterministic partitioning."""
+    del inner_path
+    outer_hash = sha256_file(outer_path)
+    parent = inner.get("parent")
+    require(
+        inner.get("schema") == INNER_SCHEMA and inner.get("version") == 1,
+        "unsupported inner split schema",
+    )
+    require(isinstance(parent, dict), "inner split parent binding must be an object")
+    require(
+        Path(parent.get("path", "")).resolve() == outer_path.resolve(),
+        "inner split names a different outer parent",
+    )
+    require(
+        parent.get("sha256") == outer_hash,
+        "inner split parent hash differs from supplied outer split",
+    )
+    require(
+        int(outer.get("fold", -1)) == fold and int(inner.get("fold", -1)) == fold,
+        "split fold mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        int(inner.get("n_folds", -1)) == int(outer.get("n_folds", -2)),
+        "inner split fold count mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        inner.get("sources") == outer.get("sources"),
+        "inner split source identities differ from outer split",
+    )
+    require(
+        inner.get("sequences") == outer.get("sequences"),
+        "inner split component map differs from outer split",
+    )
+    selection = inner.get("selection")
+    require(isinstance(selection, dict), "inner split selection metadata is missing")
+    require(
+        selection.get("algorithm") == "sha256-component-order-v1",
+        "unsupported inner selection algorithm",
+    )
+    require(
+        type(selection.get("seed")) is int and selection["seed"] >= 0,
+        "invalid inner selection seed",
+    )
+    fraction = selection.get("evaluation_fraction")
+    require(
+        isinstance(fraction, (int, float)) and not isinstance(fraction, bool) and 0 < fraction < 1,
+        "invalid inner evaluation fraction",
+    )
+
+    components = _group_map(outer)
+    outer_train = _group_list(outer, "fit", "train")
+    outer_valid = _group_list(outer, "fit", "valid")
+    fit_train = _group_list(inner, "fit", "train")
+    fit_valid = _group_list(inner, "fit", "valid")
+    eval_valid = _group_list(inner, "evaluation", "valid")
+    outer_eval = _group_list(outer, "evaluation", "valid")
+    require(not outer_eval.intersection(outer_valid), "outer fit/evaluation membership overlaps")
+    outer_eval_components = {components[("valid", group)] for group in outer_eval}
+    outer_fit_components = {components[("train", group)] for group in outer_train} | {
+        components[("valid", group)] for group in outer_valid
+    }
+    require(
+        outer_eval_components.isdisjoint(outer_fit_components),
+        "outer fit/evaluation components overlap",
+    )
+    require(
+        fit_train <= outer_train and fit_valid <= outer_valid,
+        "inner fit exceeds outer fitting membership",
+    )
+    require(eval_valid <= outer_valid, "inner evaluation exceeds outer fitting membership")
+    eval_components = {components[("valid", group)] for group in eval_valid}
+    require(
+        eval_components.isdisjoint(components[("train", group)] for group in fit_train)
+        and eval_components.isdisjoint(components[("valid", group)] for group in fit_valid),
+        "inner fit/evaluation components overlap",
+    )
+
+    valid_by_component: dict[int, set[int]] = {}
+    train_by_component: dict[int, set[int]] = {}
+    for group in outer_valid:
+        valid_by_component.setdefault(components[("valid", group)], set()).add(group)
+    for group in outer_train:
+        train_by_component.setdefault(components[("train", group)], set()).add(group)
+    candidates = sorted(
+        valid_by_component,
+        key=lambda component: (
+            hashlib.sha256(
+                f"wnn.sequence-inner.v1:{selection['seed']}:{fold}:{component}".encode()
+            ).hexdigest(),
+            component,
+        ),
+    )
+    target = max(1, math.ceil(float(fraction) * len(outer_valid)))
+    chosen_components: set[int] = set()
+    chosen_valid_count = 0
+    chosen_train_count = 0
+    for component in candidates:
+        valid_count = len(valid_by_component[component])
+        train_count = len(train_by_component.get(component, set()))
+        if chosen_valid_count + valid_count >= len(outer_valid):
+            continue
+        if chosen_train_count + train_count >= len(outer_train):
+            continue
+        chosen_components.add(component)
+        chosen_valid_count += valid_count
+        chosen_train_count += train_count
+        if chosen_valid_count >= target:
+            break
+    expected_eval = {
+        group for group in outer_valid if components[("valid", group)] in chosen_components
+    }
+    require(
+        eval_valid == expected_eval, "inner evaluation differs from its frozen component-order seed"
+    )
+    expected_train = {
+        group for group in outer_train if components[("train", group)] not in chosen_components
+    }
+    expected_valid = {
+        group for group in outer_valid if components[("valid", group)] not in chosen_components
+    }
+    require(
+        fit_train == expected_train, "inner training membership omits or adds eligible components"
+    )
+    require(
+        fit_valid == expected_valid,
+        "inner validation-fit membership omits or adds eligible components",
+    )
+
+
+def validate_role_pair(
+    role_name: str,
+    role: dict[str, Any],
+    expected_fold: int,
+    expected_schema: str,
+    outer: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    outer_path: Path | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Re-read one source split and verify its campaign role and parent bindings."""
+    source_path = Path(role["source_path"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    require(sha256_file(source_path) == role["sha256"], f"source split changed: {source_path}")
+    value = read_object(source_path)
+    if expected_schema == INNER_SCHEMA:
+        require(
+            outer is not None and outer_path is not None, "inner split has no supplied outer parent"
+        )
+        validate_outer_inner_pair(outer_path, outer, source_path, value, expected_fold)
+    else:
+        require(
+            value.get("version") == 1 and int(value.get("fold", -1)) == expected_fold,
+            f"invalid outer split: {role_name}",
+        )
+    require(
+        role["fold"] == expected_fold and role["schema"] == expected_schema,
+        f"campaign split role changed: {role_name}",
+    )
+    return value

+"""Materialize conditional B-F inner component-validation recipes."""

+def _prepare_b(

+    """Materialize the six inner-fold learning-rate discovery teachers."""

+                    variant,
+                    fold,
+                    int(config["seed"]),
+                    "teacher",

+        "new_teacher_fits": 4,
+        "reused_teacher_fits": 2,

+"""Materialize G robustness teachers and H student-transfer cells."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from campaign_io import read_object, require
+from catalog import r3_reference_pair_equal, student_base, teacher_base

+
+def _validate_selected_pair_same_recipe(
+    selected: dict[int, dict[str, Any]], campaign_root: Path
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Require F0/F2 selected configs to differ only in fold and seed identity."""
+    configs = {
+        fold: read_object(_cell_path(campaign_root, record["config"]))
+        for fold, record in selected.items()
+    }
+    left, right = configs[0].copy(), configs[2].copy()
+    left.pop("expected_fold")
+    right.pop("expected_fold")
+    left.pop("seed")
+    right.pop("seed")
+    require(left == right, "selected F0/F2 recipe differs beyond fold and seed")
+    return configs[0]
+
+
+def _prepare_g(
+    campaign_root: Path, campaign: dict[str, Any], selected: dict[int, dict[str, Any]]
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Materialize three paired outer-fold robustness seeds for both recipe arms."""
+    selected_base = _validate_selected_pair_same_recipe(selected, campaign_root)
+    alias = all(r3_reference_pair_equal(selected_base, fold, 301001) for fold in (0, 2))
+    records = []
+    reference_records: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for fold in (0, 2):
+        for seed in (301001, 301002, 301003):
+            reference = teacher_base(fold, seed)
+            reference_id = f"G_reference_f{fold}_s{seed}"
+            ref_record = _new_cell(
+                campaign_root,
+                campaign,
+                reference_id,
+                "reference",
+                fold,
+                seed,
+                "teacher",
+                reference,
+                inner_split=False,
+            )
+            records.append(ref_record)
+            reference_records[(fold, seed)] = ref_record
+    if alias:
+        for fold in (0, 2):
+            for seed in (301001, 301002, 301003):
+                records.append(
+                    _reused_cell(reference_records[(fold, seed)], "candidate", "G-reference-alias")
+                )
+        new_count = 6
+    else:
+        for fold in (0, 2):
+            for seed in (301001, 301002, 301003):
+                candidate = selected_base.copy()
+                candidate["model"] = selected_base["model"].copy()
+                candidate["expected_fold"] = fold
+                candidate["seed"] = seed
+                cell_id = f"G_candidate_f{fold}_s{seed}"
+                records.append(
+                    _new_cell(
+                        campaign_root,
+                        campaign,
+                        cell_id,
+                        "candidate",
+                        fold,
+                        seed,
+                        "teacher",
+                        candidate,
+                        inner_split=False,
+                    )
+                )
+        new_count = 12
+    return records, {
+        "new_teacher_fits": new_count,
+        "reused_teacher_fits": 12 - new_count,
+        "new_student_fits": 0,
+        "candidate_aliases_reference": alias,

+def _prepare_h(

+        )
+        require(
+            [cell["seed"] for cell in fold_candidates] == [301001, 301002, 301003],
+            "G candidate cache set is incomplete",
+        )

+                producers = [_cache_producer(fold_candidates[0], fold, 301001)]

+            inputs = [item["path"] for item in producers]
+            config = student_base(fold, seed, weight)
+            cell_id = f"H_{variant}_f{fold}"
+            records.append(
+                _new_cell(
+                    campaign_root,
+                    campaign,
+                    cell_id,
+                    variant,

+                    cache_producers=producers,
+                    teacher_cache=merged_cache,
+                )
+            )
+    return records, {"new_teacher_fits": 0, "reused_teacher_fits": 0, "new_student_fits": 6}

+"""Load frozen parent selections and bind downstream stage dependencies."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from campaign_io import load_campaign, read_object, require, sha256_file
+from cell_materialize import _relative
+
+
+def _stage_manifest(campaign_root: Path, stage: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read a stage manifest after validating its raw-byte hash sidecar."""
+    path = campaign_root / "stages" / stage / "stage.json"
+    value = read_object(path)
+    require(
+        path.with_suffix(".sha256").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() == sha256_file(path),
+        f"stage manifest hash mismatch: {stage}",
+    )
+    return value
+
+
+def _read_selection(campaign_root: Path, stage: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str, str]:
+    """Return a parent selection plus both its file and parent-stage hashes."""
+    selection_path = campaign_root / "stages" / stage / "selection.json"
+    selection = read_object(selection_path)
+    return selection, _relative(campaign_root, selection_path), sha256_file(selection_path)
+
+
+def _selected_cells(
+    campaign_root: Path, stage: str
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[int, dict[str, Any]]]:
+    """Validate the parent selection and resolve its explicit two-fold pair."""
+    from results import validate_selection_receipt
+
+    campaign = load_campaign(campaign_root)
+    selection, _, _ = _read_selection(campaign_root, stage)
+    validate_selection_receipt(campaign_root, campaign, selection)
+    parent_stage = _stage_manifest(campaign_root, stage)
+    selected: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for item in selection["selected_pair"]:
+        fold = int(item["fold"])
+        require(
+            fold in (0, 2) and fold not in selected,
+            "parent selection must name one cell per outer fold",
+        )
+        record = next(
+            cell
+            for cell in parent_stage["cells"]
+            if cell["id"] == item["id"] and cell["variant"] == selection["variant"]
+        )
+        selected[fold] = record
+    require(set(selected) == {0, 2}, "parent selection is missing an F0/F2 endpoint")
+    return selection, selected
+
+
+def _dependencies(campaign_root: Path, parent_stage: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Bind a child stage to its selected parent stage and endpoint evidence."""
+    parent_manifest = campaign_root / "stages" / parent_stage / "stage.json"
+    selection, selection_path, selection_hash = _read_selection(campaign_root, parent_stage)
+    return {
+        "parent_stage": parent_stage,
+        "stage_manifest": {
+            "path": _relative(campaign_root, parent_manifest),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(parent_manifest),
+        },
+        "selection": {"path": selection_path, "sha256": selection_hash},
+        "selected_variant": selection["variant"],
+    }
+
+
+def _load_selected_parent(
+    campaign_root: Path, stage: str
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[int, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load one selected recipe and its dependency hashes for a downstream stage."""
+    previous = {"C": "B", "D": "C", "E": "D", "F": "E", "G": "F", "H": "F"}[stage]
+    selection, cells = _selected_cells(campaign_root, previous)
+    return selection, cells, _dependencies(campaign_root, previous)

+# [Experiment] Prepare 630M versus 1.54B causal teachers for eight B300s
+
+The previous sequence runtime rejected canonical training files without
+`is_scored` and estimated normalization from only 32 fitting sequences. This
+amendment fixes the training mask, adds source-bound full-fit normalization and
+prepares a four-fit large-teacher panel with explicit receiver checks and commands.
+
+[R2 packet and launch stages](research/experiment_drafts/b300-transformer-distillation-runtime/large_teacher_r2/README.md)
+extend the existing causal Transformer/distillation runtime in draft PR #32.
+No local tests, model imports, training, inference or GPU profiles were run.
+
+1. **Status, lineage and owner.** E/H-B300-LARGE-TEACHER-R2-20261023, implemented
+   preparation on current research-team plus PR32. All four endpoints initialize
+   from scratch. Receiving operator/hardware/data paths are unbound. B300 acceptance
+   and scientific results remain pending; `launch_ready=false`.
+2. **Mechanism and expected observation.** More causal-attention capacity may
+   learn dependencies a smaller teacher misses. Compare 1280×32 (~630M) against
+   1792×40 (~1.54B), both with 64-wide heads and the same raw112 row representation.
+   Expect a reproducible teacher-WP gain if capacity is limiting. This changes
+   width and depth together; it is not an isolated width/depth mechanism test.
+3. **Compute advantage.** One fit uses eight allocated B300s through replicated
+   DDP, strict FP32, activation checkpointing and bounded math attention. Full
+   optimizer state resides on every rank. Twelve-update profiles at one and
+   eight GPUs establish actual resource use; no speedup, memory fit or training
+   wall time is inferred from advertised hardware specifications.
+4. **Frozen recipe.** Six complete epochs, fixed final epoch index 5; context1024,
+   chunk512/detach, two chunks/update, two sequences/rank, eight ranks. AdamW
+   LR1e-4, weight decay .01, clip1, warmup5% then cosine-to-zero, dropout0. Training
+   uses all labeled rows after warmup; official evaluation remains scored rows.
+   Full-fit-only moments are cached and hash-bound. State resets per sequence;
+   KV carries across updates with explicit stale-state TBPTT semantics. No target
+   teacher forcing, quantization, numerical-tokenizer or optimizer change.
+5. **Allocation.** Two widths × F0/101001 and F2/101002 = four new teacher fits,
+   zero new students, no control reuse. Engineering checks/profiles are separate
+   discarded work. R1 three-epoch/512-context panels are preserved, not silently
+   redefined. No automatic continuation or 30-fit expansion.
+6. **Validation and uncertainty.** Fixed final weights, canonical pooled
+   `global_wp_clip2_v1`, per-target grades and matched large-minus-small deltas.
+   `compare.py` reuses canonical paired component bootstrap, 2,000 replicates,
+   seeds1729/1731, using stable centered moments written while the official scorer
+   verifies prediction arrays. It rejects inconsistent endpoint grades.
+   The folds are exposed; fold and seed vary together. Conditional component
+   intervals do not estimate seed variability or establish public-transfer significance.
+7. **Leakage and coverage.** Canonical source-qualified component split manifests
+   exclude evaluation membership from every fit and normalization pass. Fold,
+   GPU model and world size are enforced before model construction. No pretrained
+   ancestor. The canonical source contract supplies ordered 20,000-row sequences
+   and row99 warmup semantics. New tests cover missing train scoring masks,
+   fit-only moments, cache tampering, causality and interrupted recovery. Tests are
+   prepared source, not passed GPU evidence.
+8. **Decision-changing result.** Mean teacher delta ≥.001 with both cells
+   nonnegative is a useful signal for a separately allocated transfer panel,
+   conditional on GPU cost. Lower or inconsistent gains motivate LR/context/input
+   diagnosis; negative results narrow this exact recipe. An interval crossing
+   zero does not close the family. Teacher quality alone proves no student gain.
+9. **Execution.** `run.sh` provides check → one-GPU profile → eight-GPU profile →
+   reviewed admission → fit → evaluation/cache → separate bundles for each cell.
+   The profile gate checks source/config/data/runtime identity, all-rank GPU
+   memory reserve and conservative CPU-resume/scratch estimates. Safe resume
+   restores epoch-boundary model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG. One/eight-rank export
+   parity is a further receiving gate before distillation. No jobs are launched.
+10. **Evidence and inference handoff.** Return all four fixed scores, component
+    intervals, source/config/split/moments identities, logs, actual peaks/timings,
+    checkpoints and manifests in separate weights/evidence archives. Teacher
+    caches contain two FP32 outputs without hidden hints. They work with PR32's

+# Large causal Transformer teacher, R2
+
+Implemented for [draft PR #32](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/32),
+targeting `research-team`. **No fit, inference, GPU profile or test has been run for
+this packet. Receiving-host acceptance is pending.** This is a new, explicit
+four-fit amendment; the historical R1 configs/panels remain unchanged.
+
+## The exact four fits
+
+| Cell | Width × depth | Heads | Parameters, source formula | Fold / seed |
+|---|---|---:|---:|---|
+| `t1280_f0` | 1280 × 32 | 20 | 629,827,842 | F0 / 101001 |
+| `t1792_f0` | 1792 × 40 | 28 | 1,542,548,226 | F0 / 101001 |
+| `t1280_f2` | 1280 × 32 | 20 | 629,827,842 | F2 / 101002 |
+| `t1792_f2` | 1792 × 40 | 28 | 1,542,548,226 | F2 / 101002 |
+
+The 1.54B model is the primary capacity candidate, the 630M model its matched
+reference. Both train from scratch on the complete clean fitting membership for
+**six epochs**, selecting final epoch index 5. No checkpoint is selected from
+outer-fold quality. Both widths share a cell's seed, data and update budget; this
+does not make their initialization tensors identical. Four new teacher fits,
+zero reused endpoints, zero student fits; profiles/recovery checks are discarded
+engineering work and have separate cost. The two folds have been exposed before.
+
+Each row is one raw112 token, with full-fitting-membership normalization,
+pre-LayerNorm, RoPE, 64-dimensional attention heads, GELU FFN expansion 4 and a
+two-target linear head. Per-layer rolling attention context is 1024 rows, using
+FP32 math SDPA and activation checkpointing. This is bounded attention through
+stacked layers, not global attention to all 20,000 rows at each layer. State is
+reset per sequence; rows 0–98 warm the model. Detached KV memory is carried after
+each 512-row chunk and across optimizer updates: gradient horizon is 512 rows,
+with ordinary stale-state TBPTT semantics.
+
+All eight GPUs hold complete model/optimizer replicas. Per-rank batch is two
+sequences; two chunks accumulate before an update, giving 16 sequences and up to
+16,384 new rows per global update. Final windows/batches retain their actual
+weight. AdamW LR 1e-4, weight decay .01, clip norm 1, 5% warmup then cosine to zero,
+dropout zero. Full FP32 includes optimizer states and attention; autocast and
+TF32 are off. This panel holds optimization fixed across scale and measures equal
+data passes, **not equal FLOPs or scale-specific optimal tuning**. Six epochs is
+a declared starting budget, not a demonstrated scaling law or optimal duration.
+
+Training WMSE uses all labeled post-warmup rows, including training files without
+`is_scored`; evaluation still uses official `is_scored & row>=99`, with clip2 and
+pooled weighted Pearson. This relies on canonical source-validated, ordered
+20,000-row sequences. Future labels are never used as inputs. Normalization sees
+only fitting components, caches FP32 moments under the data root and binds them
+to split/source/membership/algorithm identity. Its initial float64 scan is
+preprocessing, not mixed-precision model training. The one-GPU profile creates
+this small cache; subsequent shapes/ranks reuse it. Nonfinite source features
+remain an explicit error; no silent imputation is introduced.
+
+## Files
+
+- `recipe.json`: allocation, cells, fixed endpoints and decision contract.
+- `configs/`: four production configs and four separate one-GPU engineering
+  configs. The latter can never admit an eight-GPU fit.
+- `run.sh`: explicit check/profile/admit/fit/resume/evaluate/cache/bundle stages
+  for one cell; never automatically advances to another fit.
+- `admission.py`: source-bound acceptance evidence, exact profile identities,
+  GPU memory reserve, conservative host resume/scratch estimates and warmed
+  update timing. It imports no training code.
+- `compare.py`: checks all four fixed endpoints and computes matched official
+  deltas with component bootstrap intervals using the canonical evaluator.
+- `PR.md`: eleven-section scientific contract.
+- `VALIDATION.json`: local static checks and unexecuted remote work.
+
+## Receiving-host commands
+
+Use the allocated Linux B300 node and a clean checkout of this PR's reviewed
+commit. `uv sync --frozen` prepares its locked environment **on that host**.
+Do not silently substitute a nightly Torch, precision, device or recipe if
+acceptance fails. Inspect the captured driver/topology and the failed stage.
+
+```bash
+export WNN_EXPECTED_COMMIT='<reviewed full commit SHA from PR #32>'
+export WNN_DATA_ROOT='/actual/data/root'
+export WNN_SPLIT_F0='/actual/canonical/f0.json'
+export WNN_SPLIT_F2='/actual/canonical/f2.json'
+export WNN_RUN_ROOT='/actual/nvme/large-teacher-r2'
+export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='<exact eight allocated IDs or GPU UUIDs>'
+export WNN_HOST_RAM_BUDGET_GIB='<actual allocated aggregate host RAM>'
+export WNN_REVIEWER='<receiving operator>'
+PACKET=research/experiment_drafts/b300-transformer-distillation-runtime/large_teacher_r2
+
+# Once for this source/runtime: causality, contracts, data guards, actual CUDA
+# interrupted/resumed recovery, then two-GPU accumulated-gradient parity.
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" check t1280_f0
+
+# One explicit cell; replace CELL with each table entry when allocating its fit.
+CELL=t1280_f0
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" profile-one "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" profile-eight "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" admit "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" fit "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" evaluate "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" cache "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" bundle "$CELL"
+
+# After all four cells have completed evaluation, on the receiver:
+PYTHONPATH=src uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/compare.py" --run-root "$WNN_RUN_ROOT"
+```
+
+Run the pair on F0, then the pair on F2; only one eight-GPU fit occupies the node
+at a time. No auto-launch loop is included. Actual F0/F2 manifests, data, storage,
+hardware allocation and operator identity remain receiver inputs. Metadata
+alone is not evidence that they currently exist on a host available to us.
+
+For an interrupted fit, use `resume CELL` instead of `fit CELL`. This restores
+the last completed epoch, model/AdamW/scheduler/rank RNG and safe log offsets;
+partial epochs replay. Same source/config/data/world size/device identity is
+required. Source updates invalidate prior profiles and exact resumes. Preserved
+failed directories are never automatically deleted or retried. After a failed
+profile/check/export, use a new attempt root and keep the original evidence;
+do not overwrite or splice a partial prediction directory.
+
+## Memory, performance and admission
+
+Each cell gets twelve actual updates first on one B300, then on eight B300s. The
+eight-rank profile must match its exact data/config/source/runtime. Admission
+requires the prepared pytest cases to run without skips, DDP cases to pass and
+20% free GPU memory relative to measured peak reservation. Inspect the rank logs
+for stable memory after KV fill; measured profile acceptance still does not prove
+full-run stability. `approved_profile.json` records the named receiver review.
+
+The normalizer's first disk scan occurs before profile timing. The report drops
+the first two optimizer windows and extrapolates the slowest rank's warmed median
+over the exact planned update count. That number excludes scans, saves, recovery,
+evaluation and cache export: **it is not an end-to-end ETA**. Do not assume eight
+GPUs are faster from model dimensions or compare one/eight timings as strong
+scaling: per-rank batch stays two, so global batch changes.
+
+Model+grad+two Adam moments alone require roughly `16 × parameters` bytes per
+GPU (about 23 GiB for 1.54B); activations, DDP buckets, allocator reserve and
+temporaries add to this. CPU resume can stage `12 × parameters` bytes on each
+rank, so host RAM is checked against eight such copies plus measured process RSS
+and 20% headroom. This is a conservative staging allowance, not a measured large
+checkpoint/recovery peak. Do not use RAM-backed output storage. Scratch admission
+reserves `32 × parameters` plus two-float predictions for fit+evaluation rows,
+covering native weights/resume and a separate weights archive for that cell.
+Retaining several cells requires their combined storage and extra failed-attempt
+space. No weight-size estimate is a competition submission-size claim.
+
+The receiver must additionally compare one- and eight-rank prediction exports
+of an accepted endpoint before consuming its teacher cache for distillation.
+Use the same `predict_sequence.py` command with `--nproc-per-node=1` in a separate
+directory and compare source-qualified membership, manifest hashes and arrays
+within the agreed FP32 numerical tolerance. This export parity remains a separate
+unexecuted gate; the synthetic gradient/recovery tests do not establish it.
+
+## What to return and how to decide
+
+Return all four `score.json` files, per-target WP, matched large-minus-small deltas,
+each fit's terminal status/source/config/split/moments hashes, peak memory,
+successful updates, LR and gradient logs. Keep the raw profile/check/admission
+evidence and prediction/cache manifests with their arrays. `bundle` produces
+separate evidence and weights archives for the fit; archive the sibling
+`acceptance`, `profile-one`, `profile-eight` and approval files separately, and
+keep caches in private artifact storage with hashes. Do not put weights in Git.
+
+The useful teacher signal is mean paired WP gain at least .001 with both cells
+nonnegative, considered alongside GPU-hours. Report component-paired bootstrap
+intervals from the saved aligned predictions; those describe evaluation-unit
+uncertainty conditional on these fits, not training-seed or public-transfer
+uncertainty. Two fold/seed cells cannot establish significance. A mixed or small
+result motivates LR/context/input-encoding diagnosis; an interval crossing zero
+does not close the Transformer direction. No local delta is a public-score claim.
+
+Next transfer panel, separately allocated: pick and freeze one teacher family,
+then run matched raw112 GRU256 label-only versus output-KD on the same two folds
+(four new student fits, zero new teachers with exact cache reuse). These caches
+have **two FP32 outputs and no hidden hints**, avoiding the old 64-hint storage
+cost. They feed the PR32 sequence runtime; native211/TL3 training requires its
+explicit cache/input adapter and is not claimed plug-compatible. The large
+Transformer is a research teacher. One-core CPU/20 MB submission acceptance is
+performed on a distilled student later; quantization is outside this panel.
+
+API references checked during preparation:
+[DDP](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel.html),
+[SDPA mask/backend behavior](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention.html),
+[CUDA precision](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/cuda.html).
+These support API semantics, not performance or quality claims for this model.

+"""Receiving-host admission from actual check/profile evidence; no model imports."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import shutil
+import statistics
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+
+
+def digest(value: object) -> str:
+    """Match the runtime's canonical JSON identity."""
+    return hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(
+            value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False
+        ).encode()
+    ).hexdigest()
+
+
+def file_hash(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Stream evidence hashes without reading model files into memory."""
+    value = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            value.update(block)
+    return value.hexdigest()
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read a bounded receipt object."""
+    if path.stat().st_size > 32_000_000:
+        raise ValueError(f"Oversized receipt: {path}")
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Receipt must be an object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
+    """Fail admission without assertions that optimization could disable."""
+    if not condition:
+        raise ValueError(reason)
+
+
+def source_hash() -> str:
+    """Match train_sequence's source identity without importing training code."""
+    paths = sorted((ROOT / "src").rglob("*.py")) + [ROOT / "scripts/train_sequence.py"]
+    return digest({p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): file_hash(p) for p in paths})
+
+
+def write_new(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Never replace an existing admission or its failure evidence."""
+    with path.open("x") as stream:
+        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+
+
+def accept_checks(directory: Path) -> None:
+    """Require actual completed pytest and two-rank objective receipts."""
+    xml = ET.parse(directory / "pytest.xml").getroot()
+    cases = list(xml.iter("testcase"))
+    require(bool(cases), "No pytest cases were executed")
+    require(
+        any(
+            case.get("name") == "test_transformer_epoch_checkpoint_resume_matches_uninterrupted_fit"
+            for case in cases
+        ),
+        "CUDA recovery case was not executed",
+    )
+    require(
+        not any(list(xml.iter(tag)) for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped")),
+        "Receiver checks failed or were skipped (CUDA recovery must execute)",
+    )
+    ddp = read(directory / "ddp.json")
+    require(ddp.get("passed") is True and ddp.get("world_size") == 2, "DDP check failed")
+    require(
+        bool(ddp.get("cases")) and all(case.get("passed") is True for case in ddp["cases"]),
+        "DDP cases are incomplete",
+    )
+    paths = [
+        directory / name
+        for name in (
+            "pytest.xml",
+            "pytest.log",
+            "ddp.json",
+            "ddp.log",
+            "nvidia-smi.txt",
+            "topology.txt",
+        )
+    ]
+    paths += [
+        ROOT / "tests" / name
+        for name in (
+            "test_b300_sequence_models.py",
+            "test_b300_sequence_contracts.py",
+            "test_large_teacher_runtime_guards.py",
+            "test_sequence_full_fit_data.py",
+            "test_sequence_recovery_cuda.py",
+        )
+    ]
+    paths.append(ROOT / "scripts/check_sequence_ddp.py")
+    write_new(
+        directory / "acceptance.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "wnn.large-teacher-checks.v1",
+            "status": "passed",
+            "source_sha256": source_hash(),
+            "files": {str(p.resolve()): file_hash(p) for p in paths},
+            "pytest_cases": len(cases),
+            "torch": ddp["torch"],
+            "cuda_runtime": ddp["cuda_runtime"],
+            "limits": "Synthetic correctness/recovery checks; no predictive or full-shape performance result.",
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def checked_profile(path: Path, config: dict[str, Any], world: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check that a complete bounded profile belongs to this exact source/config."""
+    value = read(path)
+    identity = value["identity"]
+    require(
+        value.get("status") == "profile_complete" and value.get("updates") == 12,
+        "Need twelve completed engineering updates",
+    )
+    require(value.get("errors") == [] and value.get("error_count") == 0, "Profile has errors")
+    require(value.get("scientific_checkpoint_written") is False, "Profile wrote scientific weights")
+    require(identity["source_sha256"] == source_hash(), "Profile source differs from checkout")
+    require(
+        identity["config_sha256"] == digest(config), "Profile config differs from frozen recipe"
+    )
+    require(identity["world_size"] == world, "Wrong profile world size")
+    require(identity["data"]["fold"] == config["expected_fold"], "Wrong profile fold")
+    require(all(math.isfinite(x) and x >= 0 for x in value["losses"].values()), "Nonfinite losses")
+    memory = value["memory_by_rank"]
+    require([item["rank"] for item in memory] == list(range(world)), "Missing rank memory records")
+    for item in memory:
+        require(
+            0
+            < item["peak_allocated_bytes"]
+            <= item["peak_reserved_bytes"]
+            <= 0.8 * item["device_total_memory_bytes"],
+            "Less than 20% GPU memory headroom",
+        )
+    return value
+
+
+def timing_summary(
+    directory: Path, config: dict[str, Any], profile: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Report warmed optimizer windows, explicitly excluding startup/checkpoint/export time."""
+    medians = []
+    files = {}
+    for rank in range(8):
+        path = directory / "profile-eight" / f"rank{rank}.jsonl"
+        records = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
+        require([row["step"] for row in records] == list(range(1, 13)), "Incomplete rank progress")
+        require(
+            all(
+                row["rank"] == rank and math.isfinite(row["gradient_norm_preclip"])
+                for row in records
+            ),
+            "Invalid rank gradients",
+        )
+        times = [row["window_seconds"] for row in records[2:]]
+        require(all(math.isfinite(t) and t > 0 for t in times), "Invalid timing")
+        medians.append(statistics.median(times))
+        files[str(path.resolve())] = file_hash(path)
+    count = len(profile["identity"]["data"]["fit_members"])
+    steps = config["epochs"] * math.ceil(math.ceil(count / 8) / config["batch_size"])
+    steps *= math.ceil(math.ceil(20_000 / config["chunk_rows"]) / config["accumulate_chunks"])
+    return {
+        "planned_updates": steps,
+        "warmed_median_seconds_by_rank": medians,
+        "optimizer_time_extrapolation_hours": max(medians) * steps / 3600,
+        "exclusions": "Startup, data scans, saves, recovery, validation and exports; not an ETA.",
+        "rank_logs_sha256": files,
+    }
+
+
+def admit(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    """Publish a reviewed, source-bound eight-rank profile only after all checks pass."""
+    config = read(args.config)
+    require(bool(args.reviewer.strip()), "A receiving reviewer is required")
+    require(math.isfinite(args.host_ram_gib) and args.host_ram_gib > 0, "Invalid host RAM budget")
+    checks = read(args.checks)
+    require(
+        checks.get("status") == "passed" and checks["source_sha256"] == source_hash(),
+        "Missing checks for current runtime",
+    )
+    for name, expected in checks["files"].items():
+        require(file_hash(Path(name)) == expected, f"Acceptance evidence changed: {name}")
+    one_path = args.directory / "profile-one/profile_receipt.json"
+    eight_path = args.directory / "profile-eight/profile_receipt.json"
+    one = checked_profile(one_path, config | {"required_world_size": 1}, 1)
+    eight = checked_profile(eight_path, config, 8)
+    require(
+        one["identity"]["data_sha256"] == eight["identity"]["data_sha256"],
+        "One- and eight-GPU data/preprocessing differ",
+    )
+    runtime = eight["identity"]["runtime"]
+    require(
+        runtime["torch"] == checks["torch"] and runtime["cuda_runtime"] == checks["cuda_runtime"],
+        "Check and fit runtimes differ",
+    )
+    require(all("B300" in item["name"] for item in runtime["devices"]), "B300 hardware required")
+    parameters = eight["model_parameters"]["total"]
+    # Resume currently materializes model + two Adam moments on every host rank.
+    host_floor = (
+        sum(row["host_peak_rss_bytes"] for row in eight["memory_by_rank"]) + 12 * parameters * 8
+    )
+    require(
+        host_floor <= 0.8 * args.host_ram_gib * 2**30,
+        "Host budget cannot cover conservative all-rank resume staging plus 20% headroom",
+    )
+    data = eight["identity"]["data"]
+    disk_floor = 32 * parameters + 160_000 * (
+        len(data["fit_members"]) + len(data["evaluation_members"])
+    )
+    require(
+        shutil.disk_usage(args.directory).free >= disk_floor,
+        "Insufficient scratch for checkpoints, separate archive and prediction/cache arrays",
+    )
+    eight.update(
+        approved=True,
+        admission={
+            "reviewer": args.reviewer,
+            "checks_sha256": file_hash(args.checks),
+            "raw_profile_sha256": file_hash(eight_path),
+            "one_gpu_profile_sha256": file_hash(one_path),
+            "host_ram_budget_gib": args.host_ram_gib,
+            "resume_host_floor_bytes": host_floor,
+            "cell_scratch_floor_bytes": disk_floor,
+            "timing": timing_summary(args.directory, config, eight),
+            "limits": "Resource estimates exclude other jobs and non-tensor overhead. No quality approval.",
+        },
+    )
+    write_new(args.directory / "approved_profile.json", eight)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Dispatch explicit receiving-host evidence stages."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="stage", required=True)
+    checks = sub.add_parser("checks")
+    checks.add_argument("--directory", type=Path, required=True)
+    profile = sub.add_parser("profile")
+    for name in ("directory", "checks", "config"):
+        profile.add_argument(f"--{name}", type=Path, required=True)
+    profile.add_argument("--reviewer", required=True)
+    profile.add_argument("--host-ram-gib", required=True, type=float)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.stage == "checks":
+        accept_checks(args.directory)
+    else:
+        admit(args)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Compare the four fixed large-teacher endpoints on the receiving host."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+from admission import digest, file_hash, read, require, source_hash, write_new
+
+from wnn.evaluation import paired_component_bootstrap
+
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def endpoint(root: Path, cell: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Bind an official grade to the frozen config, final weights and prediction manifest."""
+    directory = root / cell
+    status = read(directory / "fit/terminal_status.json")
+    config = read(PACKET / "configs" / f"{cell}.json")
+    require(
+        status["status"] == "completed" and status["completed_epochs"] == 6,
+        f"Incomplete fixed endpoint: {cell}",
+    )
+    require(status["identity"]["config_sha256"] == digest(config), f"Wrong config: {cell}")
+    require(status["identity"]["source_sha256"] == source_hash(), f"Wrong source: {cell}")
+    checkpoint_hash = file_hash(directory / "fit/model.pt")
+    require(checkpoint_hash == status["model_sha256"], f"Weights changed: {cell}")
+    score = read(directory / "fit/score.json")
+    require(score["producer"]["checkpoint_sha256"] == checkpoint_hash, f"Wrong grade model: {cell}")
+    require(
+        score["predictions_manifest_sha256"] == file_hash(directory / "evaluation/manifest.json"),
+        f"Prediction manifest changed: {cell}",
+    )
+    require(
+        score["split_sha256"] == status["identity"]["data"]["split_sha256"], f"Wrong split: {cell}"
+    )
+    require(score["score"]["metric_id"] == "global_wp_clip2_v1", f"Wrong metric: {cell}")
+    return score
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Compute paired component intervals without selecting a different endpoint."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--run-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    cells = {}
+    deltas = []
+    receipts = {}
+    for fold in (0, 2):
+        small_name, large_name = f"t1280_f{fold}", f"t1792_f{fold}"
+        small, large = endpoint(args.run_root, small_name), endpoint(args.run_root, large_name)
+        require(small["split_sha256"] == large["split_sha256"], "Pair has different splits")
+        require(
+            small["score"]["selected_rows"] == large["score"]["selected_rows"], "Row count drift"
+        )
+        groups = sorted(small["component_centered_moments"], key=int)
+        require(
+            groups == sorted(large["component_centered_moments"], key=int),
+            "Component membership drift",
+        )
+        reference = np.asarray(
+            [small["component_centered_moments"][g] for g in groups], dtype=np.float64
+        )
+        candidate = np.asarray(
+            [large["component_centered_moments"][g] for g in groups], dtype=np.float64
+        )
+        require(
+            np.allclose(
+                candidate[:, :, [0, 1, 3]], reference[:, :, [0, 1, 3]], rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-8
+            ),
+            "Different labels/weights inside pair",
+        )
+        interval = paired_component_bootstrap(
+            candidate, reference, np.array(groups), n_boot=2000, seed=1729 + fold, centered=True
+        )
+        delta = large["score"]["wp"] - small["score"]["wp"]
+        require(
+            abs(interval["mean_diff"] - delta) < 2e-7,
+            "Centered-moment and official grades disagree",
+        )
+        deltas.append(delta)
+        cells[f"F{fold}"] = {
+            "small": small["score"],
+            "large": large["score"],
+            "large_minus_small": delta,
+            "component_bootstrap": interval,
+        }
+        for name in (small_name, large_name):
+            path = args.run_root / name / "fit/score.json"
+            receipts[name] = file_hash(path)
+    mean = float(np.mean(deltas))
+    write_new(
+        args.run_root / "comparison.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "wnn.large-teacher-comparison.v2",
+            "cells": cells,
+            "mean_paired_delta": mean,
+            "useful_followup_signal": mean >= 0.001 and min(deltas) >= 0,
+            "score_sha256": receipts,
+            "source_sha256": source_hash(),
+            "limits": "Exposed folds; intervals condition on fixed fits. No seed/public significance or student-transfer claim.",
+            "moment_representation": "Stable centered moments merged within each component, then paired bootstrap.",
+        },
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# One explicit stage of one cell. No queue, background process, or automatic fit.
+stage=${1:?stage: check, profile-one, profile-eight, admit, fit, resume, evaluate, cache, bundle}
+cell=${2:?cell: t1280_f0, t1792_f0, t1280_f2, t1792_f2}
+case "$cell" in t1280_f0|t1792_f0|t1280_f2|t1792_f2) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
+packet=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
+cd -- "$packet/../../../.."
+: "${WNN_EXPECTED_COMMIT:?pin the reviewed PR head SHA}"
+: "${WNN_RUN_ROOT:?dedicated physical disk run root}"
+: "${WNN_DATA_ROOT:?canonical data root}"
+: "${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:?the exact eight allocated GPU IDs or UUIDs}"
+IFS=, read -r -a devices <<< "$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
+[[ ${#devices[@]} == 8 ]] || { echo 'Bind exactly eight allocated GPUs' >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ $(uname -s) == Linux ]] || { echo 'Receiving Linux GPU host only' >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ $(git rev-parse HEAD) == "$WNN_EXPECTED_COMMIT" ]] || { echo 'Source commit mismatch' >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ -z $(git status --porcelain -- src scripts tests "$packet" pyproject.toml uv.lock) ]] || {
+  echo 'Runtime, checks, packet or dependency files are dirty' >&2; exit 2;
+}
+case "$cell" in
+  *_f0) split=${WNN_SPLIT_F0:?canonical F0 manifest} ;;
+  *_f2) split=${WNN_SPLIT_F2:?canonical F2 manifest} ;;
+esac
+export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src"
+export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
+export CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
+run="$WNN_RUN_ROOT/$cell"
+config="$packet/configs/$cell.json"
+mkdir -p -- "$run"
+train=(scripts/train_sequence.py --config "$config" --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$split")
+predict=(scripts/predict_sequence.py --checkpoint "$run/fit/model.pt" --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$split")
+eight=(uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=8)
+case "$stage" in
+  check)
+    checks="$WNN_RUN_ROOT/acceptance"
+    mkdir -- "$checks"
+    nvidia-smi -q > "$checks/nvidia-smi.txt"
+    nvidia-smi topo -m > "$checks/topology.txt"
+    PYTEST_ADDOPTS='' uv run --no-sync python -m pytest -q \
+      tests/test_b300_sequence_models.py tests/test_b300_sequence_contracts.py \
+      tests/test_large_teacher_runtime_guards.py tests/test_sequence_full_fit_data.py \
+      tests/test_sequence_recovery_cuda.py --junitxml="$checks/pytest.xml" \
+      2>&1 | tee "$checks/pytest.log"
+    uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=2 \
+      scripts/check_sequence_ddp.py --output-receipt "$checks/ddp.json" \
+      2>&1 | tee "$checks/ddp.log"
+    uv run --no-sync python "$packet/admission.py" checks --directory "$checks"
+    ;;
+  profile-one)
+    uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=1 \
+      scripts/train_sequence.py --config "$packet/configs/${cell}_profile_one.json" \
+      --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$split" \
+      --output "$run/profile-one" --profile-updates 12
+    ;;
+  profile-eight)
+    [[ -f "$run/profile-one/profile_receipt.json" ]]
+    "${eight[@]}" "${train[@]}" --output "$run/profile-eight" --profile-updates 12
+    ;;
+  admit)
+    : "${WNN_REVIEWER:?name of receiving operator reviewing profiles}"
+    : "${WNN_HOST_RAM_BUDGET_GIB:?actual allocated host RAM, including all eight ranks}"
+    uv run --no-sync python "$packet/admission.py" profile --directory "$run" \
+      --checks "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/acceptance/acceptance.json" --config "$config" \
+      --reviewer "$WNN_REVIEWER" --host-ram-gib "$WNN_HOST_RAM_BUDGET_GIB"
+    ;;
+  fit)
+    "${eight[@]}" "${train[@]}" --output "$run/fit" --profile-receipt "$run/approved_profile.json"
+    ;;
+  resume)
+    "${eight[@]}" "${train[@]}" --output "$run/fit" --profile-receipt "$run/approved_profile.json" \
+      --resume "$run/fit/training_state.pt"
+    ;;
+  evaluate)
+    "${eight[@]}" "${predict[@]}" --membership evaluation --output "$run/evaluation"
+    uv run --no-sync python scripts/score_sequence.py --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" \
+      --split-manifest "$split" --predictions "$run/evaluation" --output "$run/fit/score.json"
+    ;;
+  cache)
+    "${eight[@]}" "${predict[@]}" --membership fit --output "$run/teacher-cache"
+    ;;
+  bundle)
+    args=()
+    for rank in {0..7}; do args+=(--evidence "rank$rank.jsonl"); done
+    uv run --no-sync python scripts/research_result_bundle.py --root "$run/fit" \
+      --output-dir "$run/bundle" --evidence run_metadata.json --evidence metrics.jsonl \
+      --evidence terminal_status.json --evidence score.json "${args[@]}" \
+      --weight model.pt --weight training_state.pt
+    ;;
+  *) echo 'Unknown stage' >&2; exit 2 ;;
+esac

+# Complete selected parameters — Muon / 30 epochs
+
+**Engineering starting recipe, not a measured optimum.** User amendment on
+2026-10-23 requests 30 epochs and Muon. No model, test, fit or profile was run
+locally. R3 replaces the four unlaunched R2 cells; R2 remains historical at
+`54b8fe6e`. No extra hyperparameter-search fits are implicitly allocated.
+
+## Architecture
+
+| Setting | Reference | Main candidate |
+|---|---:|---:|
+| Parameter count, source formula | 629,827,842 | 1,542,548,226 |
+| Hidden width | 1280 | 1792 |
+| Transformer blocks | 32 | 40 |
+| Attention heads | 20 | 28 |
+| Dimensions per head | 64 | 64 |
+| Feed-forward width | 5120 | 7168 |
+
+Both use the following complete architecture contract:
+
+| Setting | Value |
+|---|---|
+| Inputs / tokenization | 112 raw features; one ordered row = one token |
+| Normalization | Mean/std from all fitting components only; frozen FP32 buffers; std floor .001 |
+| Position encoding | RoPE, base 10000, no learned position table |
+| Per-layer attention window | 1024 causal rows including current row |
+| Attention kernel | PyTorch math SDPA, 256 query rows per internal attention tile |
+| Residual structure | Pre-LayerNorm, epsilon 1e-5; final LayerNorm |
+| FFN | GELU, expansion 4; two dense projections |
+| Dense biases | Enabled, as existing model source |
+| Initialization | Cold start; existing PyTorch Linear/LayerNorm initialization, no pretrained ancestor |
+| Outputs | Linear two-target head; no target feedback into inputs |
+| Dropout | 0, including attention and residual branches |
+| Activation checkpointing | Enabled per Transformer block |
+| Gradient horizon | 512 rows; detach after each chunk |
+| KV state | At most 1023 preceding rows/layer; reset at independent sequence boundary |
+| Hidden hints / KD while fitting teacher | Disabled: dimension 0, hint weight 0, KD weight 0 |
+
+Stacked sliding attention is not full 20,000-row attention at every layer.
+Accumulation does not extend the 512-row backward graph. Cached states across
+optimizer steps have the existing, explicit stale-state TBPTT approximation.
+
+## Optimizer and schedule
+
+| Setting | Selected value |
+|---|---|
+| Optimizer | Repository MuonAdamW with opt-in strict-FP32 Newton–Schulz |
+| Muon parameters | Q, K and V separately; attention output; FFN input/output matrices |
+| Auxiliary AdamW parameters | Input projection, output head, norms and biases |
+| Peak LR, all groups | 0.0003 |
+| Muon LR convention | AdamW-matched RMS: multiply orthogonalized update by `0.2 * sqrt(max(rows, cols))` |
+| Muon momentum | .95, Nesterov-style update; constant through training |
+| Newton–Schulz | 5 iterations; coefficients (3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315); epsilon 1e-7 |
+| Auxiliary AdamW betas / epsilon | (.9, .95) / 1e-8 |
+| Decoupled weight decay | .01 on matrices; 0 on norms and biases |
+| Gradient clipping | Global L2 norm 1.0 after complete accumulation and DDP synchronization |
+| Warmup | Linear, first 5% of planned updates, approximately 1.5 epochs |
+| Decay | Cosine over remaining updates; no plateau/validation-triggered schedule |
+| Final LR | .00003 (10% of peak), reached on final actual update |
+| Precision | Parameters, gradients, state, attention, NS intermediates FP32; TF32/autocast off |
+| Quantization / EMA / SWA | None |
+
+Let `N` be the number of fitting sequences, and `B = ceil(ceil(N/8)/2)`
+the equalized rank batches per epoch. There are `ceil(20000/512)=40` chunks,
+five accumulation windows per sequence batch, and `T=30*B*5` total updates.
+`W=ceil(.05*T)` is computed separately from each cell's actual fitting membership.
+At zero-based actual update `s`:
+
+```text
+if s < W:
+    lr(s) = 3e-4 * (s + 1) / W
+else:
+    u = clamp((s - W) / (T - 1 - W), 0, 1)
+    lr(s) = 3e-4 * [0.1 + 0.9 * (1 + cos(pi*u)) / 2]
+```
+
+The scheduler advances once after each successful optimizer update, never after
+each chunk or epoch. Its position and all optimizer groups are checkpointed.
+There is no additional momentum warmup, restart or automatic LR multiplication
+by the number of GPUs. Initial and final LR indexing have prepared remote checks.
+
+## Data, batch and evaluation
+
+| Setting | Value |
+|---|---|
+| Full-data epochs | 30 per fit; 120 teacher epochs across four fits |
+| Cells | F0/101001 and F2/101002 for both model sizes |
+| Devices / parallelism | Eight B300s, one process per GPU, replicated DDP |
+| Batch per GPU | Two independent complete sequences |
+| Chunk rows / accumulated chunks | 512 / 8 |
+| Global sequence slots | 16; no claim of 128 independent sequences from accumulation |
+| New rows per full update | 65,536, before excluding warmup/padding |
+| Final window rows | 3,616 per real sequence; normalize by its actual target-weight mass |
+| Training objective | WMSE weighted by absolute clipped target; targets clipped to [-2,2], predictions unclipped in training loss |
+| Training eligibility | Labeled rows >=99 from fitting components only |
+| Evaluation eligibility | Official is_scored and row>=99; pooled `global_wp_clip2_v1` |
+| Normalization/cache ancestry | Exact fitting membership, source and split hashes; no evaluation components |
+| Primary endpoint | Fixed last epoch, index 29; no outer-fold best-checkpoint selection |
+| Recovery | Whole-epoch checkpoints; partial epoch replay; same exact source/config/data/runtime |
+| Quality evidence | Both paired teacher deltas and component bootstrap intervals; folds already exposed |
+
+## Why these choices, and what remains unknown
+
+The author recommends hidden-matrix Muon plus auxiliary AdamW and separate Q/K/V
+orthogonalization ([Muon README](https://github.com/KellerJordan/Muon),
+[author discussion](https://kellerjordan.github.io/posts/muon/)). Five NS rounds
+and momentum .95 are published defaults, not results from this dataset.
+The LR scale above follows the explicit
+[AdamW-matched convention](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.optim.Muon.html),
+not the original `lr=.02` convention. Using .02 with the chosen RMS convention
+would be a different, much larger step. The base LR 3e-4 and beta2 .95 are
+intentional new engineering starting values, not transferred tuned R2 values.
+
+Five-percent warmup gives the random deep model roughly 1.5 passes before peak
+LR. The .1 floor keeps all late updates active during the requested 30 passes;
+it has not been shown better than a zero floor. Clipping and zero norm/bias decay
+are explicit safeguards; gradient norms, clipping frequency and named group LRs
+must be read from the actual run, not assumed healthy from these constants.
+
+Accumulation8 amortizes expensive strict-FP32 Muon steps. Source-shape arithmetic
+for the 1.54B model is approximately 69.1 TFLOP of NS GEMMs per local update,
+versus roughly 101 TFLOP of dense model work with eight chunks and activation
+recomputation, excluding attention and many overheads. These are arithmetic
+estimates, not timings. Compared with accumulation2, updates per pass fall4x;
+gradient averaging and noise also change, and adjacent rows are correlated.
+Both model sizes use the same explicit R3 recipe. No optimizer sharding,
+distributed NS acceleration, linear speedup or quality advantage is claimed.
+
+Before any fit, the receiver runs synthetic correctness/recovery checks and
+12-update exact-shape one/eight-GPU profiles, plus a separate eight-GPU peak-LR
+cold-start stress profile. The latter has warmup=0 only for engineering work;
+its weights are discarded and cannot initialize a scientific endpoint. Log
+optimizer CUDA-event time separately to see whether accumulation is sufficient.
+Neither these short profiles nor source arithmetic select the best quality LR.
+
+If tuning is needed after actual learning curves arrive, freeze a separate
+allocation with fitting-only inner component splits and a matched LR/batch or
+cooldown comparison. Report the cost and every tried setting; do not silently
+expand the four-fit panel or select the final checkpoint on outer F0/F2.

+# Large causal Transformer teacher, R3 — Muon / 30 epochs
+
+Implemented for [PR #32](https://github.com/VladKochetov007/WunderFunder/pull/32),
+targeting `research-team`. **No fit, inference, GPU profile or test has been run for
+this packet. Receiving-host acceptance is pending.** This is a new, explicit

+
+The [24 October high-compute continuation](../HIGH_COMPUTE_PLAN_20261024.md) is now
+implemented in a separate [R4 packet](../high_compute_r4/README.md): staged search,
+seed/fold confirmation and a frozen GRU512×2 labels/single/mean3 transfer panel.
+It does not change this historical four-fit recipe. R4's receiver acceptance
+and all scientific results remain pending.
+
+## The exact four fits
+
+| Cell | Width × depth | Heads | Parameters, source formula | Fold / seed |
+|---|---|---:|---:|---|
+| `t1280_f0` | 1280 × 32 | 20 | 629,827,842 | F0 / 101001 |
+| `t1792_f0` | 1792 × 40 | 28 | 1,542,548,226 | F0 / 101001 |
+| `t1280_f2` | 1280 × 32 | 20 | 629,827,842 | F2 / 101002 |
+| `t1792_f2` | 1792 × 40 | 28 | 1,542,548,226 | F2 / 101002 |
+
+The 1.54B model is the primary capacity candidate, the 630M model its matched
+reference. Both train from scratch on the complete clean fitting membership for
+**30 epochs**, selecting final epoch index 29. No checkpoint is selected from
+outer-fold quality. Both widths share a cell's seed, data and update budget; this
+does not make their initialization tensors identical. Four new teacher fits,
+zero reused endpoints, zero student fits; profiles/recovery checks are discarded
+engineering work and have separate cost. The two folds have been exposed before.
+
+Each row is one raw112 token, with full-fitting-membership normalization,
+pre-LayerNorm, RoPE, 64-dimensional attention heads, GELU FFN expansion 4 and a
+two-target linear head. Per-layer rolling attention context is 1024 rows, using
+FP32 math SDPA and activation checkpointing. This is bounded attention through
+stacked layers, not global attention to all 20,000 rows at each layer. State is
+reset per sequence; rows 0–98 warm the model. Detached KV memory is carried after
+each 512-row chunk and across optimizer updates: gradient horizon is 512 rows,
+with ordinary stale-state TBPTT semantics.
+
+All eight GPUs hold complete model/optimizer replicas. Per-rank batch is two
+sequences; eight chunks accumulate before an update, giving 16 sequences and up to
+65,536 new rows per global update. Final windows/batches retain their actual
+weight. The last window has 3,616 rows per real sequence. Muon uses the existing
+AdamW-matched update-RMS convention, with shared peak LR 3e-4, momentum .95,
+five FP32 Newton–Schulz rounds, matrix weight decay .01, clip norm 1 and no dropout.
+Input/output matrices, norms and biases use auxiliary AdamW, beta=(.9,.95),
+with no decay on vectors/biases. Q/K/V are orthogonalized independently.
+
+Warmup is 5% of actual optimizer updates (approximately 1.5 epochs), followed by
+cosine decay to 10% of peak, 3e-5, on the final actual update. Every group follows
+the same factor. The precise step indexing, all parameters and why these values
+were chosen are in [PARAMETERS.md](PARAMETERS.md). Full FP32 includes Muon matrix
+intermediates; autocast/TF32 remain off. No model or optimizer state is sharded.
+
+This is an explicit replacement of four **unlaunched** R2 fits, not four extra
+fits. Compared with R2, data passes grow 5x and accumulation 2→8 reduces update
+count per pass 4x, so total updates grow 1.25x for equal fitting membership.
+Muon adds substantial work per update: no 1.25x or 5x wall-time claim follows.
+The LR, auxiliary beta2, decay grouping and LR floor also change explicitly.
+This compares capacity under one new recipe, not the isolated effect of Muon.
+Neither starting hyperparameters nor training duration are empirically optimal;
+no LR sweep, extra scientific fits or automatic tuning jobs are allocated.
+
+
+Training WMSE uses all labeled post-warmup rows, including training files without
+`is_scored`; evaluation still uses official `is_scored & row>=99`, with clip2 and
+pooled weighted Pearson. This relies on canonical source-validated, ordered
+20,000-row sequences. Future labels are never used as inputs. Normalization sees
+only fitting components, caches FP32 moments under the data root and binds them
+to split/source/membership/algorithm identity. Its initial float64 scan is
+preprocessing, not mixed-precision model training. The one-GPU profile creates

+- `PARAMETERS.md`: complete settings, exact warmup/cosine formula, rationale and tuning limits.
+- `profile_analysis.py`: separate optimizer/window timing and actual schedule counts.
+- `recipe.json`: allocation, cells, fixed endpoints and decision contract.
+- `configs/`: four production configs, four one-GPU and four peak-LR engineering
+  configs. The latter can never admit an eight-GPU fit.
+- `run.sh`: explicit check/profile/admit/fit/resume/evaluate/cache/bundle stages
+  for one cell; never automatically advances to another fit.
+- `admission.py`: source-bound acceptance evidence, exact profile identities,
+  GPU memory reserve, conservative host resume/scratch estimates and warmed
+  update timing. It imports no training code.
+- `compare.py`: checks all four fixed endpoints and computes matched official
+  deltas with component bootstrap intervals using the canonical evaluator.
+- `PR.md`: eleven-section scientific contract.
+- `VALIDATION.json`: local static checks and unexecuted remote work.
+
+## Receiving-host commands
+
+Use the allocated Linux B300 node and a clean checkout of this PR's reviewed
+commit. `uv sync --frozen` prepares its locked environment **on that host**.
+Do not silently substitute a nightly Torch, precision, device or recipe if
+acceptance fails. Inspect the captured driver/topology and the failed stage.
+
+```bash
+export WNN_EXPECTED_COMMIT='<reviewed full commit SHA from PR #32>'
+export WNN_DATA_ROOT='/actual/data/root'
+export WNN_SPLIT_F0='/actual/canonical/f0.json'
+export WNN_SPLIT_F2='/actual/canonical/f2.json'
+export WNN_RUN_ROOT='/actual/nvme/large-teacher-r3-muon30'
+export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='<exact eight allocated IDs or GPU UUIDs>'
+export WNN_HOST_RAM_BUDGET_GIB='<actual allocated aggregate host RAM>'
+export WNN_REVIEWER='<receiving operator>'
+PACKET=research/experiment_drafts/b300-transformer-distillation-runtime/large_teacher_r3_muon30
+
+# Once for this source/runtime: causality, contracts, data guards, actual CUDA
+# interrupted/resumed recovery, then two-GPU accumulated-gradient parity.
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" check t1280_f0
+
+# One explicit cell; replace CELL with each table entry when allocating its fit.
+CELL=t1280_f0
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" profile-one "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" profile-eight "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" profile-peak "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" admit "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" fit "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" evaluate "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" cache "$CELL"
+bash "$PACKET/run.sh" bundle "$CELL"
+
+# After all four cells have completed evaluation, on the receiver:
+PYTHONPATH=src uv run --no-sync python "$PACKET/compare.py" --run-root "$WNN_RUN_ROOT"
+```
+
+Run the pair on F0, then the pair on F2; only one eight-GPU fit occupies the node
+at a time. No auto-launch loop is included. Actual F0/F2 manifests, data, storage,
+hardware allocation and operator identity remain receiver inputs. Metadata
+alone is not evidence that they currently exist on a host available to us.
+
+For an interrupted fit, use `resume CELL` instead of `fit CELL`. This restores
+the last completed epoch, model/Muon-and-AdamW/scheduler/rank RNG and safe log offsets;
+partial epochs replay. Same source/config/data/world size/device identity is
+required. Source updates invalidate prior profiles and exact resumes. Preserved
+failed directories are never automatically deleted or retried. After a failed
+profile/check/export, use a new attempt root and keep the original evidence;
+do not overwrite or splice a partial prediction directory.
+
+## Memory, performance and admission
+
+Each cell gets twelve actual updates on one B300, then eight B300s, followed by
+a separate twelve-update eight-B300 peak-LR stress profile. The latter disables
+warmup only in its engineering config, starts from scratch, and discards weights.
+It verifies early peak-rate numerics, not convergence or the post-warmup state. The
+eight-rank profile must match its exact data/config/source/runtime. Admission
+requires prepared pytest cases (both optimizer recovery paths) without skips,
+objective and Muon-update DDP cases to pass, all three profiles to agree, and
+20% free GPU memory relative to measured peak reservation. Inspect the rank logs
+for stable memory after KV fill; measured profile acceptance still does not prove
+full-run stability. `approved_profile.json` records the named receiver review. Per-update logs include actual named group
+LRs, preclip norm, clipping flag and CUDA-event `optimizer_seconds`; event timing
+is read after the existing finite-parameter synchronization, without extra
+per-step `synchronize()` calls. It isolates the optimizer stream interval from forward/backward (including launch gaps).
+
+The normalizer's first disk scan occurs before profile timing. The report drops
+the first two optimizer windows and extrapolates the slowest rank's warmed median
+over the exact planned update count. That number excludes scans, saves, recovery,
+evaluation and cache export: **it is not an end-to-end ETA**. Do not assume eight
+GPUs are faster from model dimensions or compare one/eight timings as strong
+scaling: per-rank batch stays two, so global batch changes.
+
+Model+gradient+optimizer tensors require `12 * P_muon + 16 * P_adamw` bytes
+before additional allocations (about 17.2 GiB for this 1.54B model). Muon keeps
+one momentum slot and auxiliary AdamW keeps two. Activations, DDP buckets, KV,
+allocator reserve and NS temporaries add to this tensor-accounting floor.
+CPU resume conservatively budgets `12 * total_parameters` bytes on each
+rank, so host RAM is checked against eight such copies plus measured process RSS
+and 20% headroom. This is a conservative staging allowance, not a measured large
+checkpoint/recovery peak. Do not use RAM-backed output storage. Scratch admission
+reserves `32 × parameters` plus two-float predictions for fit+evaluation rows,
+covering native weights/resume and a separate weights archive for that cell.
+Retaining several cells requires their combined storage and extra failed-attempt
+space. No weight-size estimate is a competition submission-size claim.
+
+The receiver must additionally compare one- and eight-rank prediction exports
+of an accepted endpoint before consuming its teacher cache for distillation.
+Use the same `predict_sequence.py` command with `--nproc-per-node=1` in a separate
+directory and compare source-qualified membership, manifest hashes and arrays
+within the agreed FP32 numerical tolerance. This export parity remains a separate
+unexecuted gate; the synthetic gradient/recovery tests do not establish it.
+
+## What to return and how to decide
+
+Return all four `score.json` files, per-target WP, matched large-minus-small deltas,
+each fit's terminal status/source/config/split/moments hashes, peak memory,
+successful updates, LR and gradient logs. Keep the raw profile/check/admission
+evidence and prediction/cache manifests with their arrays. `bundle` produces
+separate evidence and weights archives for the fit; archive the sibling
+`acceptance`, `profile-one`, `profile-eight`, `profile-peak` and approval files separately, and
+keep caches in private artifact storage with hashes. Do not put weights in Git.
+
+The useful teacher signal is mean paired WP gain at least .001 with both cells
+nonnegative, considered alongside GPU-hours. Report component-paired bootstrap
+intervals from the saved aligned predictions; those describe evaluation-unit
+uncertainty conditional on these fits, not training-seed or public-transfer
+uncertainty. Two fold/seed cells cannot establish significance. A mixed or small
+result motivates LR/context/input-encoding diagnosis; an interval crossing zero
+does not close the Transformer direction. No local delta is a public-score claim.
+
+Next transfer panel, separately allocated: pick and freeze one teacher family,
+then run matched raw112 GRU256 label-only versus output-KD on the same two folds
+(four new student fits, zero new teachers with exact cache reuse). These caches
+have **two FP32 outputs and no hidden hints**, avoiding the old 64-hint storage
+cost. They feed the PR32 sequence runtime; native211/TL3 training requires its
+explicit cache/input adapter and is not claimed plug-compatible. The large
+Transformer is a research teacher. One-core CPU/20 MB submission acceptance is
+performed on a distilled student later; quantization is outside this panel.
+
+API references checked during preparation:
+[DDP](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel.html),
+[SDPA mask/backend behavior](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention.html),
+[CUDA precision](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/notes/cuda.html),
+[Muon LR conventions](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.14/generated/torch.optim.Muon.html),
+[Muon author implementation and parameter guidance](https://github.com/KellerJordan/Muon).
+These support API semantics, not performance or quality claims for this model.

+"""Validate the exact receiving-host Muon parity receipt contract."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def validate_muon_receipt(value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Reject partial or inconsistent parity records before binding their hashes."""
+    expected = {
+        "passed": True,
+        "world_size": 2,
+        "explicit_updates": 2,
+        "schedule_total_updates": 4,
+        "precision": "strict_fp32_no_tf32_no_autocast",
+        "tolerance": {"atol": 1e-5, "rtol": 1e-4, "denominator_atol": 1e-5},
+    }
+    if any(value.get(key) != item for key, item in expected.items()):
+        raise ValueError("Muon DDP receipt has incorrect update/precision/tolerance metadata")
+    cases = value.get("cases", [])
+    if len(cases) != 2:
+        raise ValueError("Muon DDP receipt must contain both declared cases")
+    checks = {
+        "gradients",
+        "parameters",
+        "optimizer_state",
+        "scheduler",
+        "semantic_groups",
+        "reference_groups",
+    }
+    roles = {"muon_qkv", "muon_hidden", "adamw_matrix", "adamw_no_decay"}
+    errors = {"denominator", "gradients", "parameters", "optimizer_state"}
+    for update, (case, scenario) in enumerate(zip(cases, ("uneven", "empty_rank"), strict=True), 1):
+        if case.get("scenario") != scenario or case.get("update") != update:
+            raise ValueError("Muon DDP receipt has incorrect case identities")
+        ranks = case.get("ranks", [])
+        if case.get("passed") is not True or [row.get("rank") for row in ranks] != [0, 1]:
+            raise ValueError("Muon DDP case lacks passing results from both ranks")
+        for rank, row in enumerate(ranks):
+            expected_rows = 8 if rank == 0 else (2 if scenario == "uneven" else 0)
+            actual_checks = row.get("checks", {})
+            actual_errors = row.get("errors", {})
+            if (
+                row.get("passed") is not True
+                or row.get("valid_rows") != expected_rows
+                or set(row.get("semantic_roles", [])) != roles
+                or set(actual_checks) != checks
+                or any(item is not True for item in actual_checks.values())
+                or set(actual_errors) != errors
+                or not all(math.isfinite(item) and item >= 0 for item in actual_errors.values())
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Muon DDP rank lacks complete passing comparisons")
