+"""Receiving-host admission from actual check/profile evidence; no model imports."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import shutil
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from acceptance_receipts import validate_muon_receipt
+from profile_analysis import timing_summary
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+
+
+def digest(value: object) -> str:
+    """Match the runtime's canonical JSON identity."""
+    return hashlib.sha256(
+        json.dumps(
+            value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False
+        ).encode()
+    ).hexdigest()
+
+
+def file_hash(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Stream evidence hashes without reading model files into memory."""
+    value = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            value.update(block)
+    return value.hexdigest()
+
+
+def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read a bounded receipt object."""
+    if path.stat().st_size > 32_000_000:
+        raise ValueError(f"Oversized receipt: {path}")
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"Receipt must be an object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, reason: str) -> None:
+    """Fail admission without assertions that optimization could disable."""
+    if not condition:
+        raise ValueError(reason)
+
+
+def source_hash() -> str:
+    """Match train_sequence's source identity without importing training code."""
+    paths = sorted((ROOT / "src").rglob("*.py")) + [ROOT / "scripts/train_sequence.py"]
+    return digest({p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): file_hash(p) for p in paths})
+
+
+def write_new(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Never replace an existing admission or its failure evidence."""
+    with path.open("x") as stream:
+        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+
+
+def accept_checks(directory: Path) -> None:
+    """Require actual completed pytest and two-rank objective receipts."""
+    xml = ET.parse(directory / "pytest.xml").getroot()
+    cases = list(xml.iter("testcase"))
+    require(bool(cases), "No pytest cases were executed")
+    required = {
+        "test_transformer_epoch_checkpoint_resume_matches_uninterrupted_fit[adamw]",
+        "test_transformer_epoch_checkpoint_resume_matches_uninterrupted_fit[muon]",
+    }
+    require(required <= {case.get("name") for case in cases}, "Both CUDA recovery paths must run")
+    require(
+        not any(list(xml.iter(tag)) for tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped")),
+        "Receiver checks failed or were skipped (CUDA recovery must execute)",
+    )
+    ddp = read(directory / "ddp.json")
+    require(ddp.get("passed") is True and ddp.get("world_size") == 2, "DDP check failed")
+    require(
+        bool(ddp.get("cases")) and all(case.get("passed") is True for case in ddp["cases"]),
+        "DDP cases are incomplete",
+    )
+    muon = read(directory / "muon-ddp.json")
+    validate_muon_receipt(muon)
+    require(
+        (muon["torch"], muon["cuda_runtime"]) == (ddp["torch"], ddp["cuda_runtime"]),
+        "Check software identities differ",
+    )
+    paths = [
+        directory / name
+        for name in (
+            "pytest.xml",
+            "pytest.log",
+            "ddp.json",
+            "ddp.log",
+            "muon-ddp.json",
+            "muon-ddp.log",
+            "nvidia-smi.txt",
+            "topology.txt",
+        )
+    ]
+    paths += [
+        ROOT / "tests" / name
+        for name in (
+            "test_b300_sequence_models.py",
+            "test_b300_sequence_contracts.py",
+            "test_large_teacher_runtime_guards.py",
+            "test_sequence_full_fit_data.py",
+            "test_sequence_recovery_cuda.py",
+            "test_sequence_muon.py",
+        )
+    ]
+    paths += [
+        ROOT / "scripts" / name for name in ("check_sequence_ddp.py", "check_sequence_muon_ddp.py")
+    ]
+    write_new(
+        directory / "acceptance.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "wnn.large-teacher-checks.v1",
+            "status": "passed",
+            "source_sha256": source_hash(),
+            "files": {str(p.resolve()): file_hash(p) for p in paths},
+            "pytest_cases": len(cases),
+            "torch": ddp["torch"],
+            "cuda_runtime": ddp["cuda_runtime"],
+            "limits": "Synthetic correctness/recovery checks; no predictive or full-shape performance result.",
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def checked_profile(path: Path, config: dict[str, Any], world: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Check that a complete bounded profile belongs to this exact source/config."""
+    value = read(path)
+    identity = value["identity"]
+    require(
+        value.get("status") == "profile_complete" and value.get("updates") == 12,
+        "Need twelve completed engineering updates",
+    )
+    require(value.get("errors") == [] and value.get("error_count") == 0, "Profile has errors")
+    require(value.get("scientific_checkpoint_written") is False, "Profile wrote scientific weights")
+    require(identity["source_sha256"] == source_hash(), "Profile source differs from checkout")
+    require(
+        identity["config_sha256"] == digest(config), "Profile config differs from frozen recipe"
+    )
+    require(identity["world_size"] == world, "Wrong profile world size")
+    require(identity["data"]["fold"] == config["expected_fold"], "Wrong profile fold")
+    require(all(math.isfinite(x) and x >= 0 for x in value["losses"].values()), "Nonfinite losses")
+    memory = value["memory_by_rank"]
+    require([item["rank"] for item in memory] == list(range(world)), "Missing rank memory records")
+    for item in memory:
+        require(
+            0
+            < item["peak_allocated_bytes"]
+            <= item["peak_reserved_bytes"]
+            <= 0.8 * item["device_total_memory_bytes"],
+            "Less than 20% GPU memory headroom",
+        )
+    return value
+
+
+def admit(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    """Publish a reviewed, source-bound eight-rank profile only after all checks pass."""
+    config = read(args.config)
+    require(bool(args.reviewer.strip()), "A receiving reviewer is required")
+    require(math.isfinite(args.host_ram_gib) and args.host_ram_gib > 0, "Invalid host RAM budget")
+    checks = read(args.checks)
+    require(
+        checks.get("status") == "passed" and checks["source_sha256"] == source_hash(),
+        "Missing checks for current runtime",
+    )
+    for name, expected in checks["files"].items():
+        require(file_hash(Path(name)) == expected, f"Acceptance evidence changed: {name}")
+    one_path = args.directory / "profile-one/profile_receipt.json"
+    eight_path = args.directory / "profile-eight/profile_receipt.json"
+    one = checked_profile(one_path, config | {"required_world_size": 1}, 1)
+    eight = checked_profile(eight_path, config, 8)
+    peak_path = args.directory / "profile-peak/profile_receipt.json"
+    peak = checked_profile(peak_path, config | {"warmup_fraction": 0.0}, 8)
+    require(
+        peak["identity"]["data_sha256"] == eight["identity"]["data_sha256"],
+        "Peak stress and production data differ",
+    )
+    require(
+        peak["identity"]["runtime"] == eight["identity"]["runtime"],
+        "Peak stress and production hardware/software differ",
+    )
+    for rank in range(8):
+        records = [
+            json.loads(line)
+            for line in (args.directory / "profile-peak" / f"rank{rank}.jsonl")
+            .read_text()
+            .splitlines()
+        ]
+        require([row["step"] for row in records] == list(range(1, 13)), "Incomplete peak stress")
+        require(
+            math.isclose(records[0]["learning_rate"], config["lr"], rel_tol=1e-10),
+            "Peak stress did not start at peak LR",
+        )
+        require(
+            all(
+                math.isfinite(row["gradient_norm_preclip"])
+                and row["learning_rate"] >= 0.95 * config["lr"]
+                for row in records
+            ),
+            "Peak stress has invalid gradients or non-peak learning rate",
+        )
+    require(
+        one["identity"]["data_sha256"] == eight["identity"]["data_sha256"],
+        "One- and eight-GPU data/preprocessing differ",
+    )
+    runtime = eight["identity"]["runtime"]
+    require(
+        runtime["torch"] == checks["torch"] and runtime["cuda_runtime"] == checks["cuda_runtime"],
+        "Check and fit runtimes differ",
+    )
+    require(all("B300" in item["name"] for item in runtime["devices"]), "B300 hardware required")
+    parameters = eight["model_parameters"]["total"]
+    # Conservative upper bound: model + up to two FP32 optimizer slots per host rank.
+    host_floor = (
+        sum(row["host_peak_rss_bytes"] for row in eight["memory_by_rank"]) + 12 * parameters * 8
+    )
+    require(
+        host_floor <= 0.8 * args.host_ram_gib * 2**30,
+        "Host budget cannot cover conservative all-rank resume staging plus 20% headroom",
+    )
+    data = eight["identity"]["data"]
+    disk_floor = 32 * parameters + 160_000 * (
+        len(data["fit_members"]) + len(data["evaluation_members"])
+    )
+    require(
+        shutil.disk_usage(args.directory).free >= disk_floor,
+        "Insufficient scratch for checkpoints, separate archive and prediction/cache arrays",
+    )
+    eight.update(
+        approved=True,
+        admission={
+            "reviewer": args.reviewer,
+            "checks_sha256": file_hash(args.checks),
+            "raw_profile_sha256": file_hash(eight_path),
+            "one_gpu_profile_sha256": file_hash(one_path),
+            "peak_stress_profile_sha256": file_hash(peak_path),
+            "peak_rank_logs_sha256": {
+                f"rank{rank}": file_hash(args.directory / "profile-peak" / f"rank{rank}.jsonl")
+                for rank in range(8)
+            },
+            "host_ram_budget_gib": args.host_ram_gib,
+            "resume_host_floor_bytes": host_floor,
+            "cell_scratch_floor_bytes": disk_floor,
+            "timing": timing_summary(args.directory, config, eight),
+            "limits": "Resource estimates exclude other jobs and non-tensor overhead. No quality approval.",
+        },
+    )
+    write_new(args.directory / "approved_profile.json", eight)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Dispatch explicit receiving-host evidence stages."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="stage", required=True)
+    checks = sub.add_parser("checks")
+    checks.add_argument("--directory", type=Path, required=True)
+    profile = sub.add_parser("profile")
+    for name in ("directory", "checks", "config"):
+        profile.add_argument(f"--{name}", type=Path, required=True)
+    profile.add_argument("--reviewer", required=True)
+    profile.add_argument("--host-ram-gib", required=True, type=float)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.stage == "checks":
+        accept_checks(args.directory)
+    else:
+        admit(args)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Compare the four fixed large-teacher endpoints on the receiving host."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+from admission import digest, file_hash, read, require, source_hash, write_new
+
+from wnn.evaluation import paired_component_bootstrap
+
+PACKET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def endpoint(root: Path, cell: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Bind an official grade to the frozen config, final weights and prediction manifest."""
+    directory = root / cell
+    status = read(directory / "fit/terminal_status.json")
+    config = read(PACKET / "configs" / f"{cell}.json")
+    require(
+        status["status"] == "completed" and status["completed_epochs"] == config["epochs"],
+        f"Incomplete fixed endpoint: {cell}",
+    )
+    require(status["identity"]["config_sha256"] == digest(config), f"Wrong config: {cell}")
+    require(status["identity"]["source_sha256"] == source_hash(), f"Wrong source: {cell}")
+    checkpoint_hash = file_hash(directory / "fit/model.pt")
+    require(checkpoint_hash == status["model_sha256"], f"Weights changed: {cell}")
+    score = read(directory / "fit/score.json")
+    require(score["producer"]["checkpoint_sha256"] == checkpoint_hash, f"Wrong grade model: {cell}")
+    require(
+        score["predictions_manifest_sha256"] == file_hash(directory / "evaluation/manifest.json"),
+        f"Prediction manifest changed: {cell}",
+    )
+    require(
+        score["split_sha256"] == status["identity"]["data"]["split_sha256"], f"Wrong split: {cell}"
+    )
+    require(score["score"]["metric_id"] == "global_wp_clip2_v1", f"Wrong metric: {cell}")
+    return score
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Compute paired component intervals without selecting a different endpoint."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--run-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    cells = {}
+    deltas = []
+    receipts = {}
+    for fold in (0, 2):
+        small_name, large_name = f"t1280_f{fold}", f"t1792_f{fold}"
+        small, large = endpoint(args.run_root, small_name), endpoint(args.run_root, large_name)
+        require(small["split_sha256"] == large["split_sha256"], "Pair has different splits")
+        require(
+            small["score"]["selected_rows"] == large["score"]["selected_rows"], "Row count drift"
+        )
+        groups = sorted(small["component_centered_moments"], key=int)
+        require(
+            groups == sorted(large["component_centered_moments"], key=int),
+            "Component membership drift",
+        )
+        reference = np.asarray(
+            [small["component_centered_moments"][g] for g in groups], dtype=np.float64
+        )
+        candidate = np.asarray(
+            [large["component_centered_moments"][g] for g in groups], dtype=np.float64
+        )
+        require(
+            np.allclose(
+                candidate[:, :, [0, 1, 3]], reference[:, :, [0, 1, 3]], rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-8
+            ),
+            "Different labels/weights inside pair",
+        )
+        interval = paired_component_bootstrap(
+            candidate, reference, np.array(groups), n_boot=2000, seed=1729 + fold, centered=True
+        )
+        delta = large["score"]["wp"] - small["score"]["wp"]
+        require(
+            abs(interval["mean_diff"] - delta) < 2e-7,
+            "Centered-moment and official grades disagree",
+        )
+        deltas.append(delta)
+        cells[f"F{fold}"] = {
+            "small": small["score"],
+            "large": large["score"],
+            "large_minus_small": delta,
+            "component_bootstrap": interval,
+        }
+        for name in (small_name, large_name):
+            path = args.run_root / name / "fit/score.json"
+            receipts[name] = file_hash(path)
+    mean = float(np.mean(deltas))
+    write_new(
+        args.run_root / "comparison.json",
+        {
+            "schema": "wnn.large-teacher-comparison.v2",
+            "cells": cells,
+            "mean_paired_delta": mean,
+            "useful_followup_signal": mean >= 0.001 and min(deltas) >= 0,
+            "score_sha256": receipts,
+            "source_sha256": source_hash(),
+            "limits": "Exposed folds; intervals condition on fixed fits. No seed/public significance or student-transfer claim.",
+            "moment_representation": "Stable centered moments merged within each component, then paired bootstrap.",
+        },
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Separate optimizer-phase and complete-window timing on the receiving host."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import statistics
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def timing_summary(
+    directory: Path, config: dict[str, Any], profile: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Summarize heterogeneous JSON receipts without importing model code."""
+    windows, optimizers, files = [], [], {}
+    for rank in range(8):
+        path = directory / "profile-eight" / f"rank{rank}.jsonl"
+        if path.stat().st_size > 32_000_000:
+            raise ValueError("Oversized engineering rank log")
+        records = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
+        if [row["step"] for row in records] != list(range(1, 13)):
+            raise ValueError("Incomplete rank progress")
+        if not all(
+            row["rank"] == rank and math.isfinite(row["gradient_norm_preclip"]) for row in records
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid profile gradients")
+        window = [row["window_seconds"] for row in records[2:]]
+        optimizer = [row["optimizer_seconds"] for row in records[2:]]
+        if not all(math.isfinite(value) and value > 0 for value in window + optimizer):
+            raise ValueError("Missing or invalid CUDA optimizer/window timings")
+        windows.append(statistics.median(window))
+        optimizers.append(statistics.median(optimizer))
+        files[str(path.resolve())] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    count = len(profile["identity"]["data"]["fit_members"])
+    steps = config["epochs"] * math.ceil(math.ceil(count / 8) / config["batch_size"])
+    steps *= math.ceil(math.ceil(20_000 / config["chunk_rows"]) / config["accumulate_chunks"])
+    return {
+        "planned_updates": steps,
+        "warmup_updates": math.ceil(config["warmup_fraction"] * steps),
+        "warmed_median_window_seconds_by_rank": windows,
+        "warmed_median_optimizer_seconds_by_rank": optimizers,
+        "optimizer_time_extrapolation_hours": max(optimizers) * steps / 3600,
+        "training_window_time_extrapolation_hours": max(windows) * steps / 3600,
+        "exclusions": "Startup, data reads/transfers, saves, recovery, validation, exports and long-run drift; not an ETA.",
+        "rank_logs_sha256": files,
+    }

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# One explicit stage of one cell. No queue, background process, or automatic fit.
+stage=${1:?stage: check, profile-one, profile-eight, profile-peak, admit, fit, resume, evaluate, cache, bundle}
+cell=${2:?cell: t1280_f0, t1792_f0, t1280_f2, t1792_f2}
+case "$cell" in t1280_f0|t1792_f0|t1280_f2|t1792_f2) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
+packet=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
+cd -- "$packet/../../../.."
+: "${WNN_EXPECTED_COMMIT:?pin the reviewed PR head SHA}"
+: "${WNN_RUN_ROOT:?dedicated physical disk run root}"
+: "${WNN_DATA_ROOT:?canonical data root}"
+: "${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:?the exact eight allocated GPU IDs or UUIDs}"
+IFS=, read -r -a devices <<< "$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
+[[ ${#devices[@]} == 8 ]] || { echo 'Bind exactly eight allocated GPUs' >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ $(uname -s) == Linux ]] || { echo 'Receiving Linux GPU host only' >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ $(git rev-parse HEAD) == "$WNN_EXPECTED_COMMIT" ]] || { echo 'Source commit mismatch' >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ -z $(git status --porcelain -- src scripts tests "$packet" pyproject.toml uv.lock) ]] || {
+  echo 'Runtime, checks, packet or dependency files are dirty' >&2; exit 2;
+}
+case "$cell" in
+  *_f0) split=${WNN_SPLIT_F0:?canonical F0 manifest} ;;
+  *_f2) split=${WNN_SPLIT_F2:?canonical F2 manifest} ;;
+esac
+export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src"
+export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
+export CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
+run="$WNN_RUN_ROOT/$cell"
+config="$packet/configs/$cell.json"
+mkdir -p -- "$run"
+train=(scripts/train_sequence.py --config "$config" --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$split")
+predict=(scripts/predict_sequence.py --checkpoint "$run/fit/model.pt" --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$split")
+eight=(uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=8)
+case "$stage" in
+  check)
+    checks="$WNN_RUN_ROOT/acceptance"
+    mkdir -- "$checks"
+    nvidia-smi -q > "$checks/nvidia-smi.txt"
+    nvidia-smi topo -m > "$checks/topology.txt"
+    PYTEST_ADDOPTS='' uv run --no-sync python -m pytest -q \
+      tests/test_b300_sequence_models.py tests/test_b300_sequence_contracts.py \
+      tests/test_large_teacher_runtime_guards.py tests/test_sequence_full_fit_data.py \
+      tests/test_sequence_recovery_cuda.py tests/test_sequence_muon.py --junitxml="$checks/pytest.xml" \
+      2>&1 | tee "$checks/pytest.log"
+    uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=2 \
+      scripts/check_sequence_ddp.py --output-receipt "$checks/ddp.json" \
+      2>&1 | tee "$checks/ddp.log"
+    uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=2 \
+      scripts/check_sequence_muon_ddp.py --output-receipt "$checks/muon-ddp.json" \
+      2>&1 | tee "$checks/muon-ddp.log"
+    uv run --no-sync python "$packet/admission.py" checks --directory "$checks"
+    ;;
+  profile-one)
+    uv run --no-sync torchrun --standalone --nnodes=1 --nproc-per-node=1 \
+      scripts/train_sequence.py --config "$packet/configs/${cell}_profile_one.json" \
+      --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$split" \
+      --output "$run/profile-one" --profile-updates 12
+    ;;
+  profile-eight)
+    [[ -f "$run/profile-one/profile_receipt.json" ]]
+    "${eight[@]}" "${train[@]}" --output "$run/profile-eight" --profile-updates 12
+    ;;
+  profile-peak)
+    [[ -f "$run/profile-eight/profile_receipt.json" ]]
+    "${eight[@]}" scripts/train_sequence.py --config "$packet/configs/${cell}_profile_peak.json" \
+      --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" --split-manifest "$split" \
+      --output "$run/profile-peak" --profile-updates 12
+    ;;
+  admit)
+    : "${WNN_REVIEWER:?name of receiving operator reviewing profiles}"
+    : "${WNN_HOST_RAM_BUDGET_GIB:?actual allocated host RAM, including all eight ranks}"
+    uv run --no-sync python "$packet/admission.py" profile --directory "$run" \
+      --checks "$WNN_RUN_ROOT/acceptance/acceptance.json" --config "$config" \
+      --reviewer "$WNN_REVIEWER" --host-ram-gib "$WNN_HOST_RAM_BUDGET_GIB"
+    ;;
+  fit)
+    "${eight[@]}" "${train[@]}" --output "$run/fit" --profile-receipt "$run/approved_profile.json"
+    ;;
+  resume)
+    "${eight[@]}" "${train[@]}" --output "$run/fit" --profile-receipt "$run/approved_profile.json" \
+      --resume "$run/fit/training_state.pt"
+    ;;
+  evaluate)
+    "${eight[@]}" "${predict[@]}" --membership evaluation --output "$run/evaluation"
+    uv run --no-sync python scripts/score_sequence.py --data-root "$WNN_DATA_ROOT" \
+      --split-manifest "$split" --predictions "$run/evaluation" --output "$run/fit/score.json"
+    ;;
+  cache)
+    "${eight[@]}" "${predict[@]}" --membership fit --output "$run/teacher-cache"
+    ;;
+  bundle)
+    args=()
+    for rank in {0..7}; do args+=(--evidence "rank$rank.jsonl"); done
+    uv run --no-sync python scripts/research_result_bundle.py --root "$run/fit" \
+      --output-dir "$run/bundle" --evidence run_metadata.json --evidence metrics.jsonl \
+      --evidence terminal_status.json --evidence score.json "${args[@]}" \
+      --weight model.pt --weight training_state.pt
+    ;;
+  *) echo 'Unknown stage' >&2; exit 2 ;;
+esac

+"""Remote command: ``torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 scripts/check_sequence_ddp.py --output-receipt /path/to/ddp.json``."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch import Tensor, nn
+from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_objectives import (
+    objective_numerators,
+    scaled_objective,
+    window_denominators,
+)
+
+FEATURES = 3
+OUTPUTS = 4
+TARGETS = 2
+HINTS = 2
+CHUNK_COUNT = 4
+WORLD_SIZE = 2
+KD_WEIGHT = 0.35
+HINT_WEIGHT = 0.2
+ATOL = 2e-6
+RTOL = 2e-5
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ToyBatch:
+    """One deterministic toy microbatch with the fields consumed by sequence objectives."""
+
+    x: Tensor
+    target: Tensor
+    teacher: Tensor
+    mask: Tensor
+    hint_target: Tensor
+
+
+def _toy_batch(rank: int, chunk: int, scenario: str, device: torch.device) -> ToyBatch:
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(17_291 + rank * 101 + chunk)
+    x = torch.randn((1, 3, FEATURES), generator=generator)
+    target = 0.1 + 2.5 * torch.rand((1, 3, TARGETS), generator=generator)
+    teacher = torch.randn((1, 3, TARGETS), generator=generator)
+    hint_target = torch.randn((1, 3, HINTS), generator=generator)
+    if scenario == "empty_rank" and rank == 1:
+        valid = [False, False, False]
+    elif scenario == "uneven" and rank == 1:
+        valid = [chunk % 2 == 0, chunk % 2 == 1, False]
+    else:
+        valid = [True, True, True]
+    return ToyBatch(
+        x.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
+        target.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
+        teacher.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
+        torch.tensor([valid], device=device, dtype=torch.bool),
+        hint_target.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
+    )
+
+
+def _make_batches(scenario: str, device: torch.device) -> list[list[ToyBatch]]:
+    return [
+        [_toy_batch(rank, chunk, scenario, device) for chunk in range(CHUNK_COUNT)]
+        for rank in range(WORLD_SIZE)
+    ]
+
+
+def _sum_denominators(batches: Sequence[ToyBatch], indices: Sequence[int]) -> Tensor:
+    return sum(
+        (
+            window_denominators(batch.target, batch.mask, batch.hint_target)
+            for batch in (batches[index] for index in indices)
+        ),
+        torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.float32, device=batches[0].x.device),
+    )
+
+
+def _reference_gradients(
+    model: DistributedDataParallel,
+    batches: list[list[ToyBatch]],
+    indices: Sequence[int],
+    denominators: Tensor,
+) -> list[Tensor]:
+    reference = nn.Linear(FEATURES, OUTPUTS).to(device=batches[0][0].x.device)
+    reference.load_state_dict(model.module.state_dict())
+    reference.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    reference_loss: Tensor | None = None
+    for rank_batches in batches:
+        for index in indices:
+            batch = rank_batches[index]
+            output = reference(batch.x)
+            prediction, hint_prediction = output[..., :TARGETS], output[..., TARGETS:]
+            numerators = objective_numerators(
+                prediction,
+                hint_prediction,
+                batch.target,
+                batch.teacher,
+                batch.hint_target,
+                batch.mask,
+            )
+            term = scaled_objective(numerators, denominators, 1, KD_WEIGHT, HINT_WEIGHT)
+            reference_loss = term if reference_loss is None else reference_loss + term
+    if reference_loss is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("reference objective unexpectedly had no microbatches")
+    reference_loss.backward()
+    return [parameter.grad.detach().clone() for parameter in reference.parameters()]
+
+
+def _max_absolute_error(got: Sequence[Tensor], ref: Sequence[Tensor]) -> float:
+    errors = [float((a - b).abs().max()) for a, b in zip(got, ref, strict=True)]
+    return max(errors, default=0.0)
+
+
+def _run_window(
+    model: DistributedDataParallel,
+    all_batches: list[list[ToyBatch]],
+    local_batches: Sequence[ToyBatch],
+    indices: Sequence[int],
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    local_denominators = _sum_denominators(local_batches, indices)
+    global_denominators = local_denominators.clone()
+    dist.all_reduce(global_denominators, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
+    expected_denominators = sum(
+        (_sum_denominators(rank_batches, indices) for rank_batches in all_batches),
+        torch.zeros_like(global_denominators),
+    )
+
+    model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    for micro_index, batch_index in enumerate(indices):
+        final_microbatch = micro_index == len(indices) - 1
+        sync_context = model.no_sync() if not final_microbatch else nullcontext()
+        with sync_context:
+            batch = local_batches[batch_index]
+            output = model(batch.x)
+            prediction, hint_prediction = output[..., :TARGETS], output[..., TARGETS:]
+            numerators = objective_numerators(
+                prediction,
+                hint_prediction,
+                batch.target,
+                batch.teacher,
+                batch.hint_target,
+                batch.mask,
+            )
+            loss = scaled_objective(
+                numerators,
+                global_denominators,
+                WORLD_SIZE,
+                KD_WEIGHT,
+                HINT_WEIGHT,
+            )
+            loss.backward()
+
+    actual_gradients = [parameter.grad.detach().clone() for parameter in model.module.parameters()]
+    expected_gradients = _reference_gradients(model, all_batches, indices, expected_denominators)
+    max_absolute = _max_absolute_error(actual_gradients, expected_gradients)
+    denominators_match = bool(torch.allclose(global_denominators, expected_denominators))
+    gradients_match = all(
+        torch.allclose(actual, expected, atol=ATOL, rtol=RTOL)
+        for actual, expected in zip(actual_gradients, expected_gradients, strict=True)
+    )
+    return {
+        "rank": dist.get_rank(),
+        "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
+        "indices": list(indices),
+        "denominators": {
+            "local": local_denominators.detach().cpu().tolist(),
+            "global": global_denominators.detach().cpu().tolist(),
+            "reference": expected_denominators.detach().cpu().tolist(),
+        },
+        "max_absolute_gradient_error": max_absolute,
+        "passed": denominators_match and gradients_match,
+    }
+
+
+def _run_checks(device: torch.device, rank: int) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+    torch.manual_seed(1_729)
+    model = DistributedDataParallel(
+        nn.Linear(FEATURES, OUTPUTS).to(device),
+        device_ids=[device.index],
+        output_device=device.index,
+        find_unused_parameters=False,
+    )
+    results: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for scenario in ("uneven", "empty_rank"):
+        all_batches = _make_batches(scenario, device)
+        for accumulation in (1, 3):
+            windows = [
+                list(range(start, min(start + accumulation, CHUNK_COUNT)))
+                for start in range(0, CHUNK_COUNT, accumulation)
+            ]
+            window_results = []
+            for indices in windows:
+                local = _run_window(model, all_batches, all_batches[rank], indices)
+                gathered: list[dict[str, object] | None] = [None] * WORLD_SIZE
+                dist.all_gather_object(gathered, local)
+                rank_results = [value for value in gathered if value is not None]
+                window_results.append(
+                    {
+                        "indices": local["indices"],
+                        "ranks": rank_results,
+                        "passed": len(rank_results) == WORLD_SIZE
+                        and all(bool(value["passed"]) for value in rank_results),
+                    }
+                )
+            results.append(
+                {
+                    "scenario": scenario,
+                    "accumulate_chunks": accumulation,
+                    "windows": window_results,
+                    "passed": all(bool(window["passed"]) for window in window_results),
+                }
+            )
+    return results
+
+
+def _write_receipt(path: Path, receipt: dict[str, object]) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    descriptor, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
+    temporary = Path(temporary_name)
+    try:
+        encoded = (json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
+            stream.write(encoded)
+        os.link(temporary, path)
+    finally:
+        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def _runtime_receipt(results: list[dict[str, object]], device: torch.device) -> dict[str, object]:
+    passed = all(bool(result["passed"]) for result in results)
+    return {
+        "receipt_schema": "wnn.sequence-ddp-check.v1",
+        "status": "passed" if passed else "failed",
+        "passed": passed,
+        "torch": str(torch.__version__),
+        "cuda_runtime": torch.version.cuda,
+        "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(device),
+        "world_size": WORLD_SIZE,
+        "precision": "strict_fp32_no_tf32_no_autocast",
+        "objective_weights": {"kd": KD_WEIGHT, "hints": HINT_WEIGHT},
+        "gradient_tolerance": {"atol": ATOL, "rtol": RTOL},
+        "cases": results,
+    }
+
+
+def _publish(path: Path, receipt: dict[str, object], rank: int, device: torch.device) -> None:
+    status: list[dict[str, object]] = [{"ok": True, "error": ""}]
+    if rank == 0:
+        try:
+            _write_receipt(path, receipt)
+        except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+            status[0] = {"ok": False, "error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"}
+    dist.broadcast_object_list(status, src=0, device=device)
+    if not status[0]["ok"]:
+        raise OSError(str(status[0]["error"]))
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run the two-rank CUDA acceptance check and write its runtime receipt."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-receipt", "--outputreceipt", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    world_size, rank, local_rank = (
+        int(os.environ.get(name, default))
+        for name, default in (("WORLD_SIZE", "1"), ("RANK", "0"), ("LOCAL_RANK", "0"))
+    )
+    if world_size != WORLD_SIZE or not 0 <= rank < world_size or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        parser.error("launch with torchrun on exactly two CUDA ranks")
+    if local_rank >= torch.cuda.device_count():
+        parser.error("each rank requires a visible CUDA device")
+
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
+    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
+    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
+    device = torch.device("cuda", local_rank)
+    dist.init_process_group(backend="nccl", init_method="env://", rank=rank, world_size=world_size)
+    try:
+        results = _run_checks(device, rank)
+        receipt = _runtime_receipt(results, device)
+        _publish(args.output_receipt, receipt, rank, device)
+        if not bool(receipt["passed"]):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"DDP objective gradients failed: {args.output_receipt}")
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Remote acceptance: ``torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 scripts/check_sequence_muon_ddp.py --output-receipt /path/to/muon-ddp.json``."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from datetime import timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch import Tensor, nn
+from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel
+from torch.optim import Optimizer
+from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import LambdaLR
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_distributed import configure_strict_fp32
+from wnn.training.sequence_fit_utils import make_optimizer
+from wnn.training.sequence_models import build_sequence_model
+from wnn.training.sequence_objectives import (
+    objective_numerators,
+    scaled_objective,
+    window_denominators,
+)
+
+WORLD_SIZE, ROWS, MICROBATCHES, UPDATE_COUNT, SCHEDULE_UPDATES = 2, 5, 2, 2, 4
+KD_WEIGHT, HINT_WEIGHT = 0.35, 0.2
+ATOL, RTOL, DENOM_ATOL = 1e-5, 1e-4, 1e-5
+Batch = dict[str, Tensor]
+Case = dict[str, object]
+Training = tuple[DistributedDataParallel, nn.Module, Optimizer, Optimizer, LambdaLR, LambdaLR]
+OPTIMIZER_CONFIG: dict[str, object] = {
+    "optimizer": "muon",
+    "lr": 3e-4,
+    "weight_decay": 0.01,
+    "muon_momentum": 0.95,
+    "muon_ns_steps": 5,
+    "muon_ns_eps": 1e-7,
+    "adamw_beta1": 0.9,
+    "adamw_beta2": 0.95,
+    "adamw_eps": 1e-8,
+    "schedule": "warmup_cosine_v2",
+    "min_lr_ratio": 0.1,
+    "warmup_fraction": 0.25,
+}
+MODEL_CONFIG: dict[str, object] = {
+    "architecture": "transformer",
+    "hidden": 16,
+    "layers": 2,
+    "heads": 2,
+    "ff_multiplier": 2,
+    "context_rows": 8,
+    "dropout": 0.0,
+    "hint_dim": 2,
+}
+
+
+def _toy_batch(scenario: str, update: int, rank: int, micro: int, device: torch.device) -> Batch:
+    """Build one deterministic raw-112 FP32 microbatch with its declared mask pattern."""
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(
+        17_291 + update * 1_009 + rank * 101 + micro
+    )
+    x = torch.randn((1, ROWS, 112), generator=generator) * 0.05
+    target = 0.2 + 1.4 * torch.rand((1, ROWS, 2), generator=generator)
+    teacher = torch.randn((1, ROWS, 2), generator=generator) * 0.1
+    hints = torch.randn((1, ROWS, 2), generator=generator) * 0.1
+    if scenario == "empty_rank" and rank == 1:
+        valid = [False] * ROWS
+    elif rank == 1:
+        valid = [micro % 2 == 0, False, False, micro % 2 == 1, False]
+    else:
+        valid = [True, True, False, True, True]
+    return {
+        "x": x.to(device),
+        "target": target.to(device),
+        "teacher": teacher.to(device),
+        "mask": torch.tensor([valid], device=device),
+        "hints": hints.to(device),
+    }
+
+
+def _semantic_groups(model: nn.Module, optimizer: Optimizer) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Check every trainable Transformer weight uses its required named optimizer role."""
+    groups = {
+        str(group.get("role", "")): set(group.get("param_names", []))
+        for group in optimizer.param_groups
+    }
+    named = {name for name, parameter in model.named_parameters() if parameter.requires_grad}
+    qkv = {name for name in named if name.endswith(".qkv.weight")}
+    hidden = {
+        name
+        for name in named
+        if name.endswith(
+            (".attention_output.weight", ".feedforward_in.weight", ".feedforward_out.weight")
+        )
+    }
+    adamw_matrix = named & {
+        "input_projection.weight",
+        "output_head.weight",
+        "hint_projector.linear.weight",
+    }
+    expected = dict(
+        muon_qkv=qkv,
+        muon_hidden=hidden,
+        adamw_matrix=adamw_matrix,
+        adamw_no_decay=named - qkv - hidden - adamw_matrix,
+    )
+    flat_names = [name for group in optimizer.param_groups for name in group.get("param_names", [])]
+    passed = (
+        len(qkv) == 2
+        and len(hidden) == 6
+        and groups == expected
+        and len(flat_names) == len(set(flat_names))
+    )
+    return {"passed": passed, "roles": sorted(groups)}
+
+
+def _compare(left: object, right: object) -> tuple[bool, float]:
+    """Compare nested values and return the largest absolute tensor difference."""
+    if isinstance(left, Tensor):
+        if not isinstance(right, Tensor) or left.shape != right.shape:
+            return False, 0.0
+        error = float((left - right).abs().max().item()) if left.numel() else 0.0
+        return bool(torch.allclose(left, right, atol=ATOL, rtol=RTOL)), error
+    if isinstance(left, Mapping):
+        if not isinstance(right, Mapping) or left.keys() != right.keys():
+            return False, 0.0
+        results = [_compare(left[key], right[key]) for key in left]
+        return all(ok for ok, _ in results), max((err for _, err in results), default=0.0)
+    if isinstance(left, (list, tuple)):
+        if not isinstance(right, type(left)) or len(left) != len(right):
+            return False, 0.0
+        results = [_compare(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=True)]
+        return all(ok for ok, _ in results), max((err for _, err in results), default=0.0)
+    return type(left) is type(right) and left == right, 0.0
+
+
+def _backward_window(
+    model: nn.Module, batches: list[Batch], denominator: Tensor, scale: int
+) -> None:
+    """Backpropagate one accumulation window with DDP sync only on its final microbatch."""
+    for index, batch in enumerate(batches):
+        sync = (
+            model.no_sync()
+            if isinstance(model, DistributedDataParallel) and index < len(batches) - 1
+            else nullcontext()
+        )
+        with sync:
+            prediction, hints, _ = model(batch["x"])
+            numerators = objective_numerators(
+                prediction, hints, batch["target"], batch["teacher"], batch["hints"], batch["mask"]
+            )
+            scaled_objective(numerators, denominator, scale, KD_WEIGHT, HINT_WEIGHT).backward()
+
+
+def _run_update(training: Training, batches: list[list[Batch]], rank: int) -> Case:
+    """Apply one DDP update and compare it against a concatenated weighted reference."""
+    model, reference, optimizer, reference_optimizer, scheduler, reference_scheduler = training
+    local = batches[rank]
+    records = [batch for rank_batches in batches for batch in rank_batches]
+    combined = {key: torch.cat([batch[key] for batch in records]) for key in records[0]}
+    local_den = torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.float32, device=local[0]["x"].device)
+    for batch in local:
+        local_den += window_denominators(batch["target"], batch["mask"], batch["hints"])
+    global_den = local_den.clone()
+    dist.all_reduce(global_den, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
+    reference_den = window_denominators(combined["target"], combined["mask"], combined["hints"])
+    den_error = float((global_den - reference_den).abs().max().item())
+    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    reference_optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    _backward_window(model, local, global_den, WORLD_SIZE)
+    _backward_window(reference, [combined], reference_den, 1)
+    gradients = {
+        name: parameter.grad.detach().clone() if parameter.grad is not None else None
+        for name, parameter in model.module.named_parameters()
+    }
+    reference_gradients = {
+        name: parameter.grad.detach().clone() if parameter.grad is not None else None
+        for name, parameter in reference.named_parameters()
+    }
+    grad_match, grad_error = _compare(gradients, reference_gradients)
+    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.module.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
+    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(reference.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
+    optimizer.step()
+    reference_optimizer.step()
+    scheduler.step()
+    reference_scheduler.step()
+    param_match, param_error = _compare(model.module.state_dict(), reference.state_dict())
+    state_match, state_error = _compare(optimizer.state_dict(), reference_optimizer.state_dict())
+    schedule_match, _ = _compare(scheduler.state_dict(), reference_scheduler.state_dict())
+    groups = _semantic_groups(model.module, optimizer)
+    ref_groups = _semantic_groups(reference, reference_optimizer)
+    passed = (
+        den_error <= DENOM_ATOL
+        and grad_match
+        and param_match
+        and state_match
+        and schedule_match
+        and bool(groups["passed"])
+        and groups == ref_groups
+    )
+    return dict(
+        rank=rank,
+        valid_rows=sum(int(batch["mask"].sum().item()) for batch in local),
+        passed=passed,
+        errors=dict(
+            denominator=den_error,
+            gradients=grad_error,
+            parameters=param_error,
+            optimizer_state=state_error,
+        ),
+        checks=dict(
+            gradients=grad_match,
+            parameters=param_match,
+            optimizer_state=state_match,
+            scheduler=schedule_match,
+            semantic_groups=bool(groups["passed"]),
+            reference_groups=groups == ref_groups,
+        ),
+        semantic_roles=groups["roles"],
+    )
+
+
+def _run_checks(device: torch.device, rank: int, control: dist.ProcessGroup) -> list[Case]:
+    """Run uneven-mask and empty-rank windows with two explicit Muon updates."""
+    torch.manual_seed(17_291)
+    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(17_291)
+    model = build_sequence_model(MODEL_CONFIG).to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    distributed = DistributedDataParallel(
+        model, device_ids=[device.index], output_device=device.index, find_unused_parameters=False
+    )
+    reference = build_sequence_model(MODEL_CONFIG).to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    reference.load_state_dict(distributed.module.state_dict())
+    optimizer_config = OPTIMIZER_CONFIG | {"model": MODEL_CONFIG}
+    optimizer, scheduler = make_optimizer(model, optimizer_config, SCHEDULE_UPDATES)
+    ref_optimizer, ref_scheduler = make_optimizer(reference, optimizer_config, SCHEDULE_UPDATES)
+    training = (distributed, reference, optimizer, ref_optimizer, scheduler, ref_scheduler)
+    cases = []
+    for update, scenario in enumerate(("uneven", "empty_rank")):
+        batches = [
+            [_toy_batch(scenario, update, worker, micro, device) for micro in range(MICROBATCHES)]
+            for worker in range(WORLD_SIZE)
+        ]
+        local = _run_update(training, batches, rank)
+        gathered: list[Case | None] = [None] * WORLD_SIZE
+        dist.all_gather_object(gathered, local, group=control)
+        results = [item for item in gathered if item is not None]
+        cases.append(
+            dict(
+                scenario=scenario,
+                update=update + 1,
+                ranks=results,
+                passed=len(results) == WORLD_SIZE and all(bool(item["passed"]) for item in results),
+            )
+        )
+    return cases
+
+
+def _receipt(cases: list[Case], device: torch.device) -> Case:
+    """Bind results to the strict precision mode, CUDA runtime, and numeric tolerances."""
+    return {
+        "passed": all(bool(case["passed"]) for case in cases),
+        "world_size": WORLD_SIZE,
+        "explicit_updates": UPDATE_COUNT,
+        "schedule_total_updates": SCHEDULE_UPDATES,
+        "torch": str(torch.__version__),
+        "cuda_runtime": torch.version.cuda,
+        "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(device),
+        "precision": "strict_fp32_no_tf32_no_autocast",
+        "tolerance": {"atol": ATOL, "rtol": RTOL, "denominator_atol": DENOM_ATOL},
+        "cases": cases,
+    }
+
+
+def _write_receipt(path: Path, receipt: Case) -> None:
+    """Atomically publish finite JSON without replacing an existing receipt."""
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
+    temporary = Path(name)
+    try:
+        content = (json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
+            stream.write(content)
+        os.link(temporary, path)
+    finally:
+        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Run two-rank CUDA parity and write a synchronized pass or failure receipt."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-receipt", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    world, rank, local_rank = (
+        int(os.environ.get(name, default))
+        for name, default in (("WORLD_SIZE", "1"), ("RANK", "0"), ("LOCAL_RANK", "0"))
+    )
+    if world != WORLD_SIZE or not 0 <= rank < world or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        parser.error("launch with torchrun on exactly two CUDA ranks")
+    if local_rank >= torch.cuda.device_count():
+        parser.error("each rank requires a visible CUDA device")
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    configure_strict_fp32()
+    device = torch.device("cuda", local_rank)
+    timeout = timedelta(seconds=60)
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        "nccl", init_method="env://", rank=rank, world_size=world, timeout=timeout
+    )
+    control = dist.new_group(backend="gloo", timeout=timeout)
+    try:
+        cases: list[Case] = []
+        local_error: Case | None = None
+        try:
+            cases = _run_checks(device, rank, control)
+        except Exception as error:
+            local_error = {"rank": rank, "error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"}
+        failures: list[Case | None] = [None] * WORLD_SIZE
+        dist.all_gather_object(failures, local_error, group=control)
+        if any(error is not None for error in failures):
+            cases = [{"scenario": "execution_failure", "ranks": failures, "passed": False}]
+        receipt = _receipt(cases, device)
+        status: list[Case] = [{"ok": True, "error": ""}]
+        if rank == 0:
+            try:
+                _write_receipt(args.output_receipt, receipt)
+            except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+                status[0] = {"ok": False, "error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"}
+        dist.broadcast_object_list(status, src=0, group=control)
+        if not bool(status[0]["ok"]):
+            raise OSError(str(status[0]["error"]))
+        if not bool(receipt["passed"]):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Muon DDP check failed; see {args.output_receipt}")
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group(control)
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Prepare a deterministic component-clean inner split from one outer fold."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_fit import run_sequence_fit
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    """Create the thin torchrun entrypoint for fixed-final sequence fitting."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Train the source-qualified causal sequence model on one CUDA GPU per rank."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--config", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--data-root", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--split-manifest", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--teacher-cache", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--resume", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--profile-updates", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--profile-receipt", type=Path)
+    return parser
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Validate profile/resume mode and dispatch the modular training runtime."""
+    parser = build_parser()
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.profile_updates < 0:
+        parser.error("--profile-updates cannot be negative")
+    if args.profile_updates and (args.resume is not None or args.profile_receipt is not None):
+        parser.error("profile runs cannot resume or consume a profile receipt")
+    if not args.profile_updates and args.profile_receipt is None:
+        parser.error("full fits require --profile-receipt with explicit approval")
+    run_sequence_fit(
+        config_path=args.config,
+        data_root=args.data_root,
+        split_manifest=args.split_manifest,
+        output=args.output,
+        entrypoint=Path(__file__).resolve(),
+        teacher_cache=args.teacher_cache,
+        resume=args.resume,
+        profile_updates=args.profile_updates,
+        profile_receipt=args.profile_receipt,
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Prepare and validate component-clean inner validation splits for sequence fits."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from wnn.splits import (
+    MAX_CAMPAIGN_SPLIT_BYTES,
+    SEQUENCE_INNER_SPLIT_SCHEMA,
+    CampaignSplit,
+    _read_campaign_manifest,
+    load_campaign_split,
+)
+
+SELECTION_ALGORITHM = "sha256-component-order-v1"
+
+
+def _validate_selection(seed: int, evaluation_fraction: float) -> tuple[int, float]:
+    """Validate and normalize the deterministic selection parameters."""
+    if type(seed) is not int or seed < 0:
+        raise ValueError("inner split seed must be a nonnegative integer")
+    if isinstance(evaluation_fraction, bool) or not isinstance(evaluation_fraction, (int, float)):
+        raise ValueError("evaluation fraction must be finite and strictly between zero and one")
+    try:
+        fraction = float(evaluation_fraction)
+    except OverflowError as exc:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "evaluation fraction must be finite and strictly between zero and one"
+        ) from exc
+    if not math.isfinite(fraction) or not 0.0 < fraction < 1.0:
+        raise ValueError("evaluation fraction must be finite and strictly between zero and one")
+    return seed, fraction
+
+
+def _json_equal(left: object, right: object) -> bool:
+    """Compare JSON values without Python's bool/int equality ambiguity."""
+    return json.dumps(left, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) == json.dumps(
+        right, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")
+    )
+
+
+def _selected_membership(
+    split: CampaignSplit, seed: int, evaluation_fraction: float
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...]]:
+    """Select whole valid-containing components while retaining both fit groups."""
+    seed, evaluation_fraction = _validate_selection(seed, evaluation_fraction)
+    component_of = {(source, group): component for source, group, component in split.components}
+    valid_by_component: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
+    train_by_component: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
+    for group in split.valid_groups:
+        valid_by_component.setdefault(component_of[("valid", group)], []).append(group)
+    for group in split.train_groups:
+        train_by_component.setdefault(component_of[("train", group)], []).append(group)
+    if len(valid_by_component) < 2:
+        raise ValueError("inner split requires at least two fitting validation components")
+
+    ordered = sorted(
+        valid_by_component,
+        key=lambda component: (
+            hashlib.sha256(
+                f"wnn.sequence-inner.v1:{seed}:{split.fold}:{component}".encode()
+            ).hexdigest(),
+            component,
+        ),
+    )
+    target = max(1, math.ceil(evaluation_fraction * len(split.valid_groups)))
+    selected: set[int] = set()
+    selected_valid = 0
+    selected_train_groups: set[int] = set()
+    for component in ordered:
+        if selected_valid >= target:
+            break
+        candidate_valid = len(valid_by_component[component])
+        candidate_train = set(train_by_component.get(component, ()))
+        if selected_valid + candidate_valid >= len(split.valid_groups):
+            continue
+        if len(selected_train_groups | candidate_train) >= len(split.train_groups):
+            continue
+        selected.add(component)
+        selected_valid += candidate_valid
+        selected_train_groups.update(candidate_train)
+    if selected_valid < target:
+        raise ValueError("selection cannot reach the requested fraction and retain fit groups")
+
+    evaluation = tuple(
+        sorted(group for component in selected for group in valid_by_component[component])
+    )
+    train = tuple(sorted(set(split.train_groups) - selected_train_groups))
+    valid = tuple(sorted(set(split.valid_groups) - set(evaluation)))
+    if not train or not valid or not evaluation:
+        raise ValueError("inner split must retain nonempty train, valid and evaluation groups")
+    return train, valid, evaluation
+
+
+def _strict_integer_list(value: object, label: str) -> list[int]:
+    """Validate a canonical JSON list of nonnegative row-group integers."""
+    if not isinstance(value, list) or any(type(group) is not int or group < 0 for group in value):
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid {label} membership list")
+    if value != sorted(set(value)):
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} membership must be unique and sorted")
+    return value
+
+
+def load_inner_campaign_split(
+    path: Path, root: Path, raw: bytes, manifest: dict[str, Any]
+) -> CampaignSplit:
+    """Revalidate the parent and derive inner membership from its frozen graph."""
+    required = {
+        "schema",
+        "version",
+        "fold",
+        "n_folds",
+        "parent",
+        "selection",
+        "sources",
+        "sequences",
+        "fit",
+        "evaluation",
+    }
+    if set(manifest) != required or manifest.get("schema") != SEQUENCE_INNER_SPLIT_SCHEMA:
+        raise ValueError("invalid sequence inner split wrapper schema")
+    if type(manifest.get("version")) is not int or manifest["version"] != 1:
+        raise ValueError("unsupported sequence inner split version")
+
+    parent_record = manifest.get("parent")
+    if not isinstance(parent_record, dict) or set(parent_record) != {"path", "sha256"}:
+        raise ValueError("invalid sequence inner split parent identity")
+    parent_text, parent_hash = parent_record.get("path"), parent_record.get("sha256")
+    if not isinstance(parent_text, str) or not Path(parent_text).is_absolute():
+        raise ValueError("inner split parent path must be absolute")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(parent_hash, str)
+        or len(parent_hash) != 64
+        or any(character not in "0123456789abcdef" for character in parent_hash)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("invalid inner split parent hash")
+    parent_path, parent_raw, parent_manifest = _read_campaign_manifest(Path(parent_text))
+    if str(parent_path) != parent_text:
+        raise ValueError("inner split parent path must use its resolved absolute form")
+    if parent_path == path.resolve():
+        raise ValueError("recursive sequence inner split wrapper")
+    if parent_manifest.get("schema") == SEQUENCE_INNER_SPLIT_SCHEMA:
+        raise ValueError("recursive sequence inner split wrapper")
+    parent = load_campaign_split(parent_path, root)
+    observed_parent_hash = hashlib.sha256(parent_raw).hexdigest()
+    if parent.sha256 != parent_hash or parent.sha256 != observed_parent_hash:
+        raise ValueError("inner split parent manifest hash changed")
+
+    selection = manifest.get("selection")
+    if not isinstance(selection, dict) or set(selection) != {
+        "algorithm",
+        "seed",
+        "evaluation_fraction",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("invalid sequence inner split selection metadata")
+    if selection.get("algorithm") != SELECTION_ALGORITHM:
+        raise ValueError("unsupported sequence inner split selection algorithm")
+    seed, fraction = selection.get("seed"), selection.get("evaluation_fraction")
+    if type(seed) is not int:
+        raise ValueError("inner split seed must be a nonnegative integer")
+    if isinstance(fraction, bool) or not isinstance(fraction, (int, float)):
+        raise ValueError("invalid inner split evaluation fraction")
+    seed, fraction = _validate_selection(seed, fraction)
+
+    if (
+        type(manifest.get("fold")) is not int
+        or type(manifest.get("n_folds")) is not int
+        or manifest["fold"] != parent.fold
+        or manifest["n_folds"] != parent.n_folds
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("inner split must preserve its canonical parent fold")
+    if not _json_equal(manifest.get("sources"), parent_manifest.get("sources")):
+        raise ValueError("inner split sources differ from its parent manifest")
+    if not _json_equal(manifest.get("sequences"), parent_manifest.get("sequences")):
+        raise ValueError("inner split graph differs from its parent manifest")
+
+    expected_train, expected_valid, expected_evaluation = _selected_membership(
+        parent, seed, fraction
+    )
+    fit, evaluation = manifest.get("fit"), manifest.get("evaluation")
+    if not isinstance(fit, dict) or set(fit) != {"train", "valid"}:
+        raise ValueError("invalid inner split fit membership")
+    if not isinstance(evaluation, dict) or set(evaluation) != {"valid"}:
+        raise ValueError("invalid inner split evaluation membership")
+    train = _strict_integer_list(fit.get("train"), "fit train")
+    valid = _strict_integer_list(fit.get("valid"), "fit valid")
+    held_out = _strict_integer_list(evaluation.get("valid"), "evaluation valid")
+    if (train, valid, held_out) != (
+        list(expected_train),
+        list(expected_valid),
+        list(expected_evaluation),
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("inner split membership differs from the deterministic parent selection")
+
+    component_of = {(source, group): component for source, group, component in parent.components}

+"""Bounded causal self-attention primitives for the B300 sequence models."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor, nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention_backends import LocalCausalAttention
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TransformerState:
+    """Per-layer rotated key/value cache and the next absolute sequence row."""
+
+    keys: tuple[Tensor, ...]
+    values: tuple[Tensor, ...]
+    next_position: int
+
+
+def _rotate(values: Tensor, positions: Tensor, inverse_frequency: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+    """Apply rotary position embeddings to a batch of head vectors."""
+    angles = positions[:, None] * inverse_frequency[None, :]
+    cosine = angles.cos()[None, None, :, :]
+    sine = angles.sin()[None, None, :, :]
+    paired = values.float().reshape(*values.shape[:-1], -1, 2)
+    even = paired[..., 0]
+    odd = paired[..., 1]
+    rotated = torch.stack((even * cosine - odd * sine, even * sine + odd * cosine), dim=-1).flatten(
+        -2
+    )
+    return rotated.to(dtype=values.dtype)
+
+
+class CausalTransformerBlock(nn.Module):
+    """Pre-norm Transformer block with RoPE and a bounded rolling KV cache."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden: int,
+        heads: int,
+        ff_width: int,
+        dropout: float,
+        attention_backend: str = "math",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden = hidden
+        self.heads = heads
+        self.head_dim = hidden // heads
+        self.norm_attention = nn.LayerNorm(hidden)
+        self.qkv = nn.Linear(hidden, 3 * hidden)
+        self.attention_output = nn.Linear(hidden, hidden)
+        self.norm_feedforward = nn.LayerNorm(hidden)
+        self.feedforward_in = nn.Linear(hidden, ff_width)
+        self.feedforward_out = nn.Linear(ff_width, hidden)
+        self.residual_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
+        self.local_attention = LocalCausalAttention(attention_backend)
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "rotary_inverse_frequency",
+            1.0
+            / (10000.0 ** (torch.arange(0, self.head_dim, 2, dtype=torch.float32) / self.head_dim)),
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        values: Tensor,
+        past_key: Tensor,
+        past_value: Tensor,
+        start_position: int,
+        context_rows: int,
+        dropout_p: float,
+    ) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]:
+        """Run the block and return its output plus the bounded cache."""
+        batch, rows, _ = values.shape
+        query, current_key, current_value = self.qkv(self.norm_attention(values)).chunk(3, dim=-1)
+        query = query.view(batch, rows, self.heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
+        current_key = current_key.view(batch, rows, self.heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
+        current_value = current_value.view(batch, rows, self.heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
+        positions = torch.arange(start_position, start_position + rows, device=values.device)
+        query = _rotate(query, positions, self.rotary_inverse_frequency)
+        current_key = _rotate(current_key, positions, self.rotary_inverse_frequency)
+        all_key = torch.cat((past_key.float(), current_key.float()), dim=-2)
+        all_value = torch.cat((past_value.float(), current_value.float()), dim=-2)
+        key_start = start_position - past_key.shape[-2]
+        attended = self.local_attention(
+            query,
+            all_key.to(dtype=query.dtype),
+            all_value.to(dtype=query.dtype),
+            start_position,
+            key_start,
+            context_rows,
+            dropout_p,
+        )
+        attended = attended.transpose(1, 2).reshape(batch, rows, self.hidden)
+        values = values + self.residual_dropout(self.attention_output(attended))
+        feedforward = self.feedforward_out(
+            F.gelu(self.feedforward_in(self.norm_feedforward(values)))
+        )
+        values = values + self.residual_dropout(feedforward)
+        cache_rows = min(context_rows - 1, all_key.shape[-2])
+        if cache_rows == 0:
+            next_key = all_key[..., :0, :].clone()
+            next_value = all_value[..., :0, :].clone()
+        else:
+            next_key = all_key[..., -cache_rows:, :].clone()
+            next_value = all_value[..., -cache_rows:, :].clone()
+        return values, next_key, next_value

+"""Explicit attention backend dispatch for bounded causal Transformer chunks."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor, nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+from torch.nn.attention import SDPBackend, sdpa_kernel
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention_capabilities import (
+    _efficient_mask_format,
+    attention_backend_capabilities,
+)
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention_masks import (
+    _additive_window_mask,
+    _relative_window_mask,
+    _trim_window_keys,
+)
+
+__all__ = ("LocalCausalAttention", "attention_backend_capabilities")
+
+MATH_QUERY_ROWS = 256
+FLEX_BLOCK_MASK_CACHE_SIZE = 128
+
+try:
+    from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import create_block_mask, flex_attention
+except ImportError:  # FlexAttention is optional on older or stripped PyTorch builds.
+    create_block_mask = None
+    flex_attention = None
+
+
+def _math_attention(
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    query_start: int,
+    key_start: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    dropout_p: float,
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Run the original fixed-query-chunk math SDPA implementation unchanged."""
+    query_rows = query.shape[-2]
+    key_rows = key.shape[-2]
+    outputs: list[Tensor] = []
+    for query_offset in range(0, query_rows, MATH_QUERY_ROWS):
+        query_end = min(query_offset + MATH_QUERY_ROWS, query_rows)
+        absolute_start = query_start + query_offset
+        absolute_end = query_start + query_end
+        first_key = max(0, absolute_start - (context_rows - 1) - key_start)
+        end_key = min(key_rows, absolute_end - key_start)
+        key_offset = torch.arange(first_key, end_key, device=query.device)
+        query_positions = torch.arange(absolute_start, absolute_end, device=query.device)
+        key_positions = key_offset + key_start
+        distances = query_positions[:, None] - key_positions[None, :]
+        allowed = (distances >= 0) & (distances < context_rows)
+        with sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.MATH):
+            attended = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+                query[..., query_offset:query_end, :],
+                key[..., first_key:end_key, :],
+                value[..., first_key:end_key, :],
+                attn_mask=allowed[None, None, :, :],
+                dropout_p=dropout_p,
+                is_causal=False,
+            )
+        outputs.append(attended)
+    return torch.cat(outputs, dim=-2)
+
+
+def _efficient_attention(
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    query_start: int,
+    key_start: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    dropout_p: float,
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Force efficient SDPA with a probed boolean or additive exact rolling mask."""
+    key, value, past_rows = _trim_window_keys(
+        query, key, value, query_start, key_start, context_rows
+    )
+    if torch.compiler.is_compiling():
+        # Keep OrderedDict capability-cache mutations out of Dynamo's trace.
+        mask = _additive_window_mask(
+            query.shape[-2],
+            key.shape[-2],
+            past_rows,
+            context_rows,
+            query.device,
+            query.dtype,
+        )
+    else:
+        _, mask = _efficient_mask_format(query, key, value, past_rows, context_rows, dropout_p)
+    with sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.EFFICIENT_ATTENTION):
+        return F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+            query,
+            key,
+            value,
+            attn_mask=mask,
+            dropout_p=dropout_p,
+            is_causal=False,
+        )
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=FLEX_BLOCK_MASK_CACHE_SIZE)
+def _cached_flex_block_mask(
+    batch: int,
+    heads: int,
+    query_rows: int,
+    key_rows: int,
+    past_rows: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    device_type: str,
+    device_index: int | None,
+) -> object:
+    """Cache BlockMasks by bounded shape and past length, never absolute position."""
+    if create_block_mask is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("FlexAttention is unavailable in this PyTorch build")
+    device = (
+        torch.device(device_type)
+        if device_index is None
+        else torch.device(device_type, device_index)
+    )
+
+    def local_mask(_batch: Tensor, _head: Tensor, q_index: Tensor, kv_index: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        """Return one causal sliding-window element of the block mask."""
+        return _relative_window_mask(q_index, kv_index, past_rows, context_rows)
+
+    return create_block_mask(
+        local_mask,
+        batch,
+        heads,
+        query_rows,
+        key_rows,
+        device=device,
+    )
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def _compiled_flex_attention() -> Callable[..., Tensor]:
+    """Compile the installed FlexAttention callable once without max-autotune overhead."""
+    if flex_attention is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("FlexAttention is unavailable in this PyTorch build")
+    return torch.compile(flex_attention, mode="default")
+
+
+def _flex_attention(
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    query_start: int,
+    key_start: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    dropout_p: float,
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Run FlexAttention with a bounded relative-offset causal BlockMask."""
+    if create_block_mask is None or flex_attention is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("FlexAttention is unavailable in this PyTorch build")
+    if not query.is_cuda:
+        raise RuntimeError("FlexAttention requires a CUDA tensor for this backend path")
+    if dropout_p != 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("FlexAttention backend requires attention dropout_p=0")
+    key, value, past_rows = _trim_window_keys(
+        query, key, value, query_start, key_start, context_rows
+    )
+    block_mask = _cached_flex_block_mask(
+        query.shape[0],
+        query.shape[1],
+        query.shape[-2],
+        key.shape[-2],
+        past_rows,
+        context_rows,
+        query.device.type,
+        query.device.index,
+    )
+    return _compiled_flex_attention()(
+        query,
+        key,
+        value,
+        block_mask=block_mask,
+        kernel_options={"BACKEND": "TRITON"},
+    )
+
+
+class LocalCausalAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Dispatch exact rolling causal attention to one explicitly selected backend."""
+
+    def __init__(self, attention_backend: str = "math") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if attention_backend not in ("math", "efficient", "flex"):
+            raise ValueError("attention_backend must be 'math', 'efficient', or 'flex'")
+        self.attention_backend = attention_backend
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        query: Tensor,
+        key: Tensor,
+        value: Tensor,
+        query_start: int,
+        key_start: int,
+        context_rows: int,
+        dropout_p: float = 0.0,
+    ) -> Tensor:
+        """Attend over current and cached keys using the selected exact mask."""
+        if query.ndim != 4 or key.ndim != 4 or value.ndim != 4:
+            raise ValueError("query, key, and value must have shape [batch, heads, rows, dim]")
+        if (
+            key.shape != value.shape
+            or query.shape[:2] != key.shape[:2]
+            or query.shape[-1] != key.shape[-1]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("query, key, and value batch/head dimensions must match")
+        if query.dtype != key.dtype or key.dtype != value.dtype:
+            raise TypeError("query, key, and value must use the same dtype")
+        if query.device != key.device or key.device != value.device:
+            raise ValueError("query, key, and value must use the same device")
+        if context_rows < 1 or query_start < key_start:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "context_rows must be positive and key_start cannot exceed query_start"
+            )
+
+        if self.attention_backend == "math":
+            return _math_attention(
+                query, key, value, query_start, key_start, context_rows, dropout_p
+            )
+        if self.attention_backend == "efficient":
+            if not query.is_cuda:
+                raise RuntimeError("efficient attention requires CUDA; no fallback was attempted")
+            return _efficient_attention(
+                query, key, value, query_start, key_start, context_rows, dropout_p
+            )
+        return _flex_attention(query, key, value, query_start, key_start, context_rows, dropout_p)
