+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import OrderedDict
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention_masks import (
+    _additive_window_mask,
+    _trim_window_keys,
+    _window_mask,
+)
+
+_MAX_EFFICIENT_CAPABILITIES = 128
+_EFFICIENT_MASK_FORMATS: OrderedDict[tuple[object, ...], str] = OrderedDict()
+
+
+def _sdpa_params(
+    query: Tensor, key: Tensor, value: Tensor, mask: Tensor, dropout_p: float
+) -> object:
+    """Build an SDPA probe value across supported PyTorch constructor signatures."""
+    try:
+        return torch.backends.cuda.SDPAParams(query, key, value, mask, dropout_p, False, False)
+    except TypeError:
+        return torch.backends.cuda.SDPAParams(query, key, value, mask, dropout_p, False)
+
+
+def _can_use(
+    checker: Callable[..., bool],
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    mask: Tensor,
+    dropout_p: float,
+) -> bool:
+    """Ask PyTorch whether one forced SDPA backend accepts this exact mask."""
+    return bool(checker(_sdpa_params(query, key, value, mask, dropout_p), debug=False))
+
+
+def _cache_key(
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    past_rows: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    dropout_p: float,
+) -> tuple[object, ...]:
+    """Key results by bounded tensor layout and relative cache geometry."""
+    return (
+        query.device.type,
+        query.device.index,
+        query.dtype,
+        tuple(query.shape),
+        tuple(query.stride()),
+        tuple(key.shape),
+        tuple(key.stride()),
+        tuple(value.shape),
+        tuple(value.stride()),
+        past_rows,
+        context_rows,
+        float(dropout_p),
+    )
+
+
+def _efficient_mask_format(
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    past_rows: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    dropout_p: float,
+) -> tuple[str, Tensor]:
+    """Select boolean or additive exact mask after a cached eligibility probe."""
+    key_id = _cache_key(query, key, value, past_rows, context_rows, dropout_p)
+    selected = _EFFICIENT_MASK_FORMATS.get(key_id)
+    if selected is not None:
+        _EFFICIENT_MASK_FORMATS.move_to_end(key_id)
+        return selected, _mask_for_format(selected, query, key, past_rows, context_rows)
+
+    checker = torch.backends.cuda.can_use_efficient_attention
+    for name in ("boolean", "additive"):
+        mask = _mask_for_format(name, query, key, past_rows, context_rows)
+        if _can_use(checker, query, key, value, mask, dropout_p):
+            _remember(key_id, name)
+            return name, mask
+    _remember(key_id, "unsupported")
+    raise RuntimeError("efficient SDPA rejected boolean and additive exact rolling masks")
+
+
+def _mask_for_format(
+    name: str, query: Tensor, key: Tensor, past_rows: int, context_rows: int
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Construct the requested exact mask with its padded backing stride."""
+    if name == "boolean":
+        return _window_mask(query.shape[-2], key.shape[-2], past_rows, context_rows, query.device)
+    if name == "additive":
+        return _additive_window_mask(
+            query.shape[-2],
+            key.shape[-2],
+            past_rows,
+            context_rows,
+            query.device,
+            query.dtype,
+        )
+    raise RuntimeError("efficient SDPA rejected boolean and additive exact rolling masks")
+
+
+def _remember(key: tuple[object, ...], value: str) -> None:
+    """Insert one bounded capability result in the LRU cache."""
+    _EFFICIENT_MASK_FORMATS[key] = value
+    if len(_EFFICIENT_MASK_FORMATS) > _MAX_EFFICIENT_CAPABILITIES:
+        _EFFICIENT_MASK_FORMATS.popitem(last=False)
+
+
+def attention_backend_capabilities(
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    query_start: int,
+    key_start: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    dropout_p: float = 0.0,
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, bool | str]]:
+    """Report exact-mask eligibility for math, efficient, flash, cuDNN, and flex."""
+    key, value, past_rows = _trim_window_keys(
+        query, key, value, query_start, key_start, context_rows
+    )
+    report: dict[str, dict[str, bool | str]] = {
+        "math": {
+            "available": True,
+            "eligible": True,
+            "selectable": True,
+            "reason": "always available",
+        }
+    }
+    if not query.is_cuda:
+        for backend in ("efficient", "flash", "cudnn"):
+            report[backend] = {
+                "available": False,
+                "eligible": False,
+                "selectable": backend == "efficient",
+                "mask_formats": "",
+                "reason": "requires CUDA tensors",
+            }
+    else:
+        cuda = torch.backends.cuda
+        checks = (
+            ("efficient", cuda.can_use_efficient_attention, True),
+            ("flash", cuda.can_use_flash_attention, False),
+            ("cudnn", cuda.can_use_cudnn_attention, False),
+        )
+        for name, checker, selectable in checks:
+            try:
+                formats = [
+                    mask_format
+                    for mask_format in ("boolean", "additive")
+                    if _can_use(
+                        checker,
+                        query,
+                        key,
+                        value,
+                        _mask_for_format(mask_format, query, key, past_rows, context_rows),
+                        dropout_p,
+                    )
+                ]
+                eligible = bool(formats)
+                reason = (
+                    f"eligible with exact {', '.join(formats)} mask"
+                    if eligible
+                    else "backend rejected boolean and additive exact masks"
+                )
+            except (RuntimeError, TypeError, AttributeError) as error:
+                formats = []
+                eligible = False
+                reason = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
+            report[name] = {
+                "available": True,
+                "eligible": eligible,
+                "selectable": selectable,
+                "mask_formats": ",".join(formats),
+                "reason": reason,
+            }

+        from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import create_block_mask as _create_block_mask
+        from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import flex_attention as _flex_attention
+    except ImportError:
+        flex_available = False
+    else:
+        flex_available = _create_block_mask is not None and _flex_attention is not None
+    flex_eligible = flex_available and query.is_cuda and dropout_p == 0.0
+    report["flex"] = {
+        "available": flex_available,
+        "eligible": flex_eligible,
+        "selectable": True,
+        "reason": (
+            "bounded Flex Triton path can be attempted"
+            if flex_eligible
+            else "requires FlexAttention, CUDA tensors, and zero attention dropout"
+        ),
+    }
+    return report

+"""Bounded causal sliding-window masks shared by the attention backends."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor
+
+MASK_STORAGE_ALIGNMENT = 8
+
+
+def _trim_window_keys(
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    query_start: int,
+    key_start: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, int]:
+    """Trim keys older than the first query's rolling context window."""
+    past_rows = query_start - key_start
+    if past_rows < 0:
+        raise ValueError("key_start cannot be newer than query_start")
+    first_key = max(0, past_rows - (context_rows - 1))
+    end_key = min(key.shape[-2], past_rows + query.shape[-2])
+    if first_key >= end_key:
+        raise ValueError("causal attention requires at least one key for every query")
+    return key[..., first_key:end_key, :], value[..., first_key:end_key, :], past_rows - first_key
+
+
+def _mask_storage_rows(key_rows: int) -> int:
+    """Round mask backing width for fused kernels while retaining exact visible K length."""
+    return (
+        (key_rows + MASK_STORAGE_ALIGNMENT - 1) // MASK_STORAGE_ALIGNMENT * MASK_STORAGE_ALIGNMENT
+    )
+
+
+def _window_mask(
+    query_rows: int,
+    key_rows: int,
+    past_rows: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Build the exact rolling mask with aligned backing stride and visible Q by K shape."""
+    storage_rows = _mask_storage_rows(key_rows)
+    query_offsets = torch.arange(query_rows, device=device)
+    key_offsets = torch.arange(storage_rows, device=device)
+    distance = past_rows + query_offsets[:, None] - key_offsets[None, :]
+    allowed = (distance >= 0) & (distance < context_rows) & (key_offsets[None, :] < key_rows)
+    return allowed[None, None, :, :][..., :key_rows]
+
+
+def _additive_window_mask(
+    query_rows: int,
+    key_rows: int,
+    past_rows: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Represent the same exact visible window as a zero-or-negative-infinity bias."""
+    allowed = _window_mask(query_rows, key_rows, past_rows, context_rows, device)
+    storage_rows = _mask_storage_rows(key_rows)
+    mask = torch.zeros((1, 1, query_rows, storage_rows), dtype=dtype, device=device)
+    mask[..., :key_rows].masked_fill_(~allowed, float("-inf"))
+    return mask[..., :key_rows]
+
+
+def _relative_window_mask(
+    query_index: Tensor, key_index: Tensor, past_rows: int, context_rows: int
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Apply the exact sliding-window rule using only bounded cache-relative offsets."""
+    distance = past_rows + query_index - key_index
+    return (distance >= 0) & (distance < context_rows)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from wnn.data import SEQUENCE_LENGTH
+from wnn.splits import CampaignSplit, file_sha256
+from wnn.training.sequence_cache_ensemble_lineage import (
+    ENSEMBLE_KIND,
+    is_sha256,
+    validate_producer,
+)
+
+MAX_CACHE_MANIFEST_BYTES = 32_000_000
+
+
+def validate_export_schema(meta: dict[str, Any], membership: str) -> None:
+    """Check the shared full-row FP32 export schema before loading payloads."""
+    if not isinstance(meta, dict):
+        raise ValueError("prediction metadata must be an object")
+    if meta.get("input_schema") != "raw112-v1" or meta.get("membership") != membership:
+        raise ValueError("unexpected prediction inputs or membership")
+    if meta.get("sequence_length") != SEQUENCE_LENGTH:
+        raise ValueError("prediction sequence length mismatch")
+    hint_dim = meta.get("hint_dim")
+    if type(hint_dim) is not int or not 0 <= hint_dim <= 4096:
+        raise ValueError("unsupported hint width")
+
+
+class TeacherCache:
+    """Validate fitting-only producer identity and lazily read per-sequence targets."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        root: Path,
+        split: CampaignSplit,
+        members: list[tuple[str, int]],
+    ) -> None:
+        self.root = root
+        manifest = root / "manifest.json"
+        size = manifest.stat().st_size
+        if size > MAX_CACHE_MANIFEST_BYTES:
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache manifest exceeds bounded metadata size")
+        with manifest.open("rb") as stream:
+            raw = stream.read(MAX_CACHE_MANIFEST_BYTES + 1)
+        if len(raw) != size or len(raw) > MAX_CACHE_MANIFEST_BYTES:
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache manifest changed while being read")
+        self.metadata = json.loads(raw)
+        meta = self.metadata
+        if not isinstance(meta, dict) or meta.get("schema") != "sequence-teacher-cache-v1":
+            raise ValueError("incomplete or unsupported teacher cache")
+        if meta.get("complete") is not True:
+            raise ValueError("incomplete or unsupported teacher cache")
+        validate_export_schema(meta, "fit")
+        if meta.get("split_sha256") != split.sha256:
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache split/input ancestry mismatch")
+        sequences = meta.get("sequences")
+        if not isinstance(sequences, list):
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache sequence entries are malformed")
+        observed: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
+        for entry in sequences:
+            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
+                raise ValueError("teacher cache sequence entry is malformed")
+            source, group = entry.get("split"), entry.get("row_group")
+            if source not in ("train", "valid") or type(group) is not int or group < 0:
+                raise ValueError("teacher cache sequence identity is malformed")
+            if not isinstance(entry.get("file"), str) or not is_sha256(entry.get("sha256")):
+                raise ValueError("teacher cache file reference is malformed")
+            observed.append((source, group))
+        if len(set(observed)) != len(observed) or set(observed) != set(members):
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache must cover exactly fitting membership")
+        if len({entry["file"] for entry in sequences}) != len(sequences):
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache members must reference distinct array files")
+        producer = meta.get("producer")
+        if not isinstance(producer, dict):
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache producer is malformed")
+        validate_producer(producer, split.sha256, members)
+        self.entries = dict(zip(observed, sequences, strict=True))
+        manifest_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+        if producer.get("kind") == ENSEMBLE_KIND:
+            self.identity = {
+                "manifest_sha256": manifest_hash,
+                "composition_sha256": producer["composition_sha256"],
+                "producer": producer,
+            }
+        else:
+            self.identity = {
+                "manifest_sha256": manifest_hash,
+                "checkpoint_sha256": producer["checkpoint_sha256"],
+                "producer": producer,
+            }
+        for entry in self.entries.values():
+            path = self._entry_path(entry)
+            if file_sha256(path) != entry["sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"teacher cache hash mismatch: {entry['file']}")
+
+    def _entry_path(self, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> Path:
+        """Resolve one canonical flat cache filename without following escapes."""
+        relative = Path(entry["file"])
+        root = self.root.resolve()
+        path = self.root / relative
+        if relative.is_absolute() or len(relative.parts) != 1 or relative.name in (".", ".."):
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache path escapes its root")
+        if path.is_symlink() or path.resolve().parent != root:
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache path escapes its root")
+        return path
+
+    def verify_unchanged(self) -> None:
+        """Recheck the manifest and every source array after a streaming consumer pass."""
+        manifest_hash = file_sha256(self.root / "manifest.json")
+        if manifest_hash != self.identity["manifest_sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError("teacher cache manifest changed during merge")
+        for entry in self.entries.values():
+            path = self._entry_path(entry)
+            if file_sha256(path) != entry["sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"teacher cache changed during merge: {entry['file']}")
+
+    def read(self, split: str, group: int, hint_dim: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Load one hash-checked cache entry without materializing the full cache."""
+        entry = self.entries[(split, group)]
+        values = np.load(self._entry_path(entry), mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+        if values.dtype != np.float32 or values.shape != (
+            SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
+            2 + self.metadata["hint_dim"],
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("teacher target shape/dtype mismatch")
+        if not np.isfinite(values).all():
+            raise ValueError("nonfinite teacher cache")
+        predictions = torch.from_numpy(np.array(values[:, :2], copy=True))
+        hints = torch.zeros(SEQUENCE_LENGTH, hint_dim)
+        if hint_dim and self.metadata["hint_dim"] == hint_dim:
+            hints = torch.from_numpy(np.array(values[:, 2:], copy=True))
+        return predictions, hints

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from wnn.data import SEQUENCE_LENGTH
+from wnn.splits import CampaignSplit, file_sha256, load_campaign_split
+from wnn.training.sequence_cache import ENSEMBLE_KIND, MAX_CACHE_MANIFEST_BYTES, TeacherCache
+from wnn.training.sequence_cache_ensemble_lineage import common_provenance
+
+PARENT_COUNT = 3
+
+
+def _canonical_sha256(value: object) -> str:
+    """Return a stable digest for JSON-compatible cache provenance."""
+    encoded = json.dumps(
+        value,
+        ensure_ascii=False,
+        sort_keys=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+        allow_nan=False,
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _teacher_recipe(producer: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], int]:
+    """Extract a seed and complete normalized teacher recipe from one producer."""
+    if producer.get("kind") == ENSEMBLE_KIND:
+        raise ValueError("mean cache inputs must be three single-checkpoint teachers")
+    if "checkpoint_sha256" not in producer or not isinstance(producer.get("config"), dict):
+        raise ValueError("teacher producer must identify a checkpoint and recipe")
+    config = producer["config"]
+    seed = config.get("seed")
+    model = config.get("model")
+    if type(seed) is not int or not 0 <= seed < 2**32:
+        raise ValueError("teacher recipe must contain an unsigned seed")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(model, dict)
+        or type(model.get("hint_dim")) is not int
+        or model.get("hint_dim") != 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("teacher recipe must use zero representation hints")
+    recipe = dict(config)
+    recipe.pop("seed")
+    return recipe, seed
+
+
+def _parent_records(caches: list[TeacherCache]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Bind each source cache, physical checkpoint, recipe and provenance into the output."""
+    parents: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    references: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    recipes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    common_provenances: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for cache in caches:
+        producer = cache.metadata["producer"]
+        recipe, seed = _teacher_recipe(producer)
+        provenance = producer.get("provenance")
+        if not isinstance(provenance, dict):
+            raise ValueError("teacher producer provenance must be a JSON object")
+        common_provenances.append(common_provenance(producer, provenance))
+        checkpoint_hash = producer["checkpoint_sha256"]
+        recipe_hash = _canonical_sha256(recipe)
+        producer_hash = _canonical_sha256(producer)
+        provenance_hash = _canonical_sha256(provenance)
+        manifest_hash = cache.identity["manifest_sha256"]
+        parents.append(
+            {
+                "manifest_sha256": manifest_hash,
+                "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
+                "seed": seed,
+                "recipe_sha256": recipe_hash,
+                "producer_sha256": producer_hash,
+                "provenance_sha256": provenance_hash,
+                "producer": producer,
+                "provenance": provenance,
+            }
+        )
+        references.append(
+            {
+                "manifest_sha256": manifest_hash,
+                "checkpoint_sha256": checkpoint_hash,
+                "seed": seed,
+                "recipe_sha256": recipe_hash,
+                "producer_sha256": producer_hash,
+                "provenance_sha256": provenance_hash,
+            }
+        )
+        recipes.append(recipe)
+    if len({parent["checkpoint_sha256"] for parent in parents}) != PARENT_COUNT:
+        raise ValueError("teacher caches must come from three distinct checkpoints")
+    if len({parent["manifest_sha256"] for parent in parents}) != PARENT_COUNT:
+        raise ValueError("teacher caches must have three distinct manifests")
+    if len({parent["seed"] for parent in parents}) != PARENT_COUNT:
+        raise ValueError("teacher caches must use three distinct seeds")
+    if recipes[1:] != recipes[:1] * 2:
+        raise ValueError("teacher recipes must match exactly except for seed")
+    if common_provenances[1:] != common_provenances[:1] * 2:
+        raise ValueError("teacher source, runtime, data or normalizer provenance differs")
+    shared_provenance_hash = _canonical_sha256(common_provenances[0])
+    recipe = recipes[0]
+    composition = {
+        "schema": "sequence-teacher-composition-v1",
+        "method": ENSEMBLE_KIND,
+        "clip_before_mean": False,
+        "shared_provenance_sha256": shared_provenance_hash,
+        "parents": references,
+    }
+    producer = {
+        "kind": ENSEMBLE_KIND,
+        "split_sha256": caches[0].metadata["split_sha256"],
+        "fit_members": caches[0].metadata["producer"]["fit_members"],
+        "recipe": recipe,
+        "recipe_sha256": _canonical_sha256(recipe),
+        "shared_provenance_sha256": shared_provenance_hash,
+        "composition": composition,
+        "composition_sha256": _canonical_sha256(composition),
+        "parents": parents,
+    }
+    return producer
+
+
+def _cache_values(cache: TeacherCache, member: tuple[str, int]) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Read and validate one full FP32 two-target sequence from a teacher cache."""
+    entry = cache.entries[member]
+    values = np.load(cache._entry_path(entry), mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+    if values.dtype != np.float32 or values.shape != (SEQUENCE_LENGTH, 2):
+        raise ValueError("teacher arrays must be exactly float32 20000x2")
+    if not np.isfinite(values).all():
+        raise ValueError("nonfinite teacher cache")
+    return values
+
+
+def _mean_sequence(caches: list[TeacherCache], member: tuple[str, int]) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Accumulate three sequence predictions in FP32 without clipping members."""
+    mean = np.zeros((SEQUENCE_LENGTH, 2), dtype=np.float32)
+    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
+        for cache in caches:
+            np.add(mean, _cache_values(cache, member), out=mean)
+        np.divide(mean, np.float32(PARENT_COUNT), out=mean)
+    if not np.isfinite(mean).all():
+        raise ValueError("mean teacher cache contains nonfinite values")
+    return mean
+
+
+def _write_sequence(root: Path, member: tuple[str, int], values: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Write one complete sequence and return its manifest checksum record."""
+    source, group = member
+    name = f"{source}-{group}.npy"
+    path = root / name
+    with path.open("xb") as stream:
+        np.save(stream, values, allow_pickle=False)
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    return {"split": source, "row_group": group, "file": name, "sha256": file_sha256(path)}
+
+
+def _write_manifest(path: Path, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Publish a cache manifest only after all referenced sequence hashes exist."""
+    payload = (json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode(
+        "utf-8"
+    )
+    if len(payload) > MAX_CACHE_MANIFEST_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError("merged teacher cache manifest exceeds the consumer size limit")
+    temporary = path / "manifest.json.partial"
+    with temporary.open("xb") as stream:
+        stream.write(payload)
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    temporary.replace(path / "manifest.json")
+
+
+def _verify_data_unchanged(data_root: Path, split_manifest: Path, expected: CampaignSplit) -> None:
+    """Reload the frozen split and source identities after all parent arrays were streamed."""
+    current = load_campaign_split(split_manifest, data_root)
+    if current.sha256 != expected.sha256 or current != expected:
+        raise ValueError("split manifest or raw data changed during cache merge")
+
+
+def merge_teacher_caches(
+    input_roots: list[Path],
+    data_root: Path,
+    split_manifest: Path,
+    output: Path,
+) -> Path:
+    """Create a provenance-bound equal mean of exactly three full fit teacher caches."""
+    if len(input_roots) != PARENT_COUNT:
+        raise ValueError("exactly three --input cache roots are required")
+    split = load_campaign_split(split_manifest, data_root)
+    members = [("train", group) for group in split.train_groups] + [
+        ("valid", group) for group in split.valid_groups
+    ]
+    caches = [TeacherCache(root, split, members) for root in input_roots]
+    for cache in caches:
+        if cache.metadata["hint_dim"] != 0:
+            raise ValueError("mean teacher caches require hint_dim=0")
+    producer = _parent_records(caches)
+    target = output.parent.resolve() / output.name
+    if target.name in ("", ".", ".."):
+        raise ValueError("output path must name a new cache directory")
+    input_paths = [root.resolve() for root in input_roots]
+    if any(target == root or root in target.parents for root in input_paths):
+        raise ValueError("output path must be outside every input cache")
+    if not target.parent.is_dir():
+        raise ValueError("output parent directory must already exist")
+    lock = target.with_name(f".{target.name}.merge.lock")
+    stage: Path | None = None
+    lock_created = False
+    try:
+        with lock.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            stream.write("merge in progress\n")
+        lock_created = True
+        if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
+            raise FileExistsError(f"output already exists: {target}")
+        stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{target.name}.merge-", dir=target.parent))
+        entries = [
+            _write_sequence(stage, member, _mean_sequence(caches, member)) for member in members
+        ]
+        for cache in caches:
+            cache.verify_unchanged()
+        _verify_data_unchanged(data_root, split_manifest, split)
+        manifest = {
+            "schema": "sequence-teacher-cache-v1",
+            "complete": True,
+            "input_schema": "raw112-v1",
+            "membership": "fit",
+            "split_sha256": split.sha256,
+            "hint_dim": 0,
+            "sequence_length": SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
+            "producer": producer,
+            "sequences": entries,
+        }
+        _write_manifest(stage, manifest)
+        for cache in caches:
+            cache.verify_unchanged()
+        _verify_data_unchanged(data_root, split_manifest, split)
+        if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
+            raise FileExistsError(f"output appeared during merge: {target}")
+        stage.rename(target)
+        stage = None
+        return target
+    finally:
+        if stage is not None:
+            shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
+        if lock_created:
+            lock.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Merge three independently seeded full fit teacher exports into one cache."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path, action="append", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--data-root", type=Path, required=True)

+def _validate_teacher_reference(reference: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Resolve a historical teacher identity while checking newer identity fields."""
+    if not isinstance(reference, dict) or not isinstance(reference.get("producer"), dict):
+        raise ValueError("teacher ancestry reference is malformed")
+    producer = reference["producer"]

+            raise ValueError("ensemble teacher identity cannot claim a checkpoint")

+        "checkpoint_sha256"

+def _validate_ensemble_node(current: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Validate parent receipts and return the three physical checkpoint producers."""
+    if "checkpoint_sha256" in current:

+    if current.get("teacher") is not None:
+        raise ValueError("ensemble producer must express ancestry through its parent branch")
+    parents = current.get("parents")

+    seeds: list[int] = []
+    checkpoint_hashes: list[str] = []

+    references: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    parent_producers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    common_provenances: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for parent in parents:

+        provenance = producer.get("provenance")

+        manifest_hash = parent.get("manifest_sha256")

+    if len(set(manifest_hashes)) != 3:

+    shared_provenance_hash = _canonical_sha256(common_provenances[0])
+    if current.get("shared_provenance_sha256") != shared_provenance_hash:
+        raise ValueError("ensemble shared provenance hash does not match its parents")
+    expected_recipe_hash = _canonical_sha256(recipes[0])
+    if current.get("recipe") != recipes[0] or current.get("recipe_sha256") != expected_recipe_hash:
+        raise ValueError("ensemble recipe identity does not match its parents")

+def validate_producer(
+    producer: dict[str, Any],
+    split_hash: str,

+    """Require same-fold fitting ancestry through linear and ensemble branches."""
+    expected_members = [list(member) for member in members]
+    active: set[int] = set()

+    def visit(current: object, depth: int) -> int:
+        """Validate a producer and its ancestors, returning its bounded node count."""
+        if depth > MAX_ANCESTRY_DEPTH:
+            raise ValueError("teacher ancestry exceeds supported depth")
+        if not isinstance(current, dict):
+            raise ValueError("teacher ancestry producer is malformed")
+        identity = id(current)
+        if identity in active:
+            raise ValueError("teacher ancestry contains a cycle")
+        active.add(identity)
+        try:
+            if current.get("split_sha256") != split_hash:
+                raise ValueError("teacher ancestry crosses evaluation folds")
+            if current.get("fit_members") != expected_members:

+                teacher = current.get("teacher")
+                children = [] if teacher is None else [_validate_teacher_reference(teacher)]
+            count = 1
+            for child in children:
+                count += visit(child, depth + 1)
+                if count > MAX_ANCESTRY_NODES:

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import re
+from typing import Any
+
+LEGACY_STRICT_FP32 = "strict_fp32_no_autocast_no_tf32_math_sdpa"
+BF16_BF16X9 = "bf16_bf16x9"
+SUPPORTED_ATTENTION_BACKENDS = frozenset(("math", "efficient", "flex"))
+COMPILER_RECOMPILE_LIMIT = 64
+
+
+def canonical_sha256(value: object) -> str:
+    """Hash JSON-compatible provenance with stable encoding."""
+    try:
+        encoded = json.dumps(
+            value,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            sort_keys=True,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+            allow_nan=False,
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise ValueError("teacher provenance is not finite JSON") from error
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _bf16_bf16x9_identity(attention_backend: str) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Mirror PR40's precision identity for the one accepted nonlegacy mode."""
+    if attention_backend not in SUPPORTED_ATTENTION_BACKENDS:
+        raise ValueError("teacher precision names an unsupported attention backend")
+    return {
+        "mode": BF16_BF16X9,
+        "attention_backend": attention_backend,
+        "cublas_emulate_single_precision": "1",
+        "parameter_dtype": "float32",
+        "gradient_dtype": "float32",
+        "optimizer_state_dtype": "float32",
+        "activation_cache_dtype": "float32",
+        "amp_scaler": False,
+        "model_compute": "BF16 autocast plus process-wide cuBLAS single-precision emulation",
+        "model_forward": "FP32 tensor interface with BF16 autocast and cuBLAS emulation",
+        "loss": "FP32 after prediction and hint casts",
+        "optimizer": "process-wide cuBLAS emulation may affect Muon operations",
+    }
+
+
+def _compiler_identity(enabled: bool) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Return the PR40 compiler receipt dictated by the producer config."""
+    return {
+        "enabled": enabled,
+        "backend": "inductor" if enabled else None,
+        "mode": "default" if enabled else None,
+        "fullgraph": False,
+        "dynamic": None,
+        "recompile_limit": COMPILER_RECOMPILE_LIMIT if enabled else None,
+    }
+
+
+def _validate_precision_contract(
+    config: dict[str, Any], provenance: dict[str, Any], runtime: dict[str, Any]
+) -> object:
+    """Bind legacy strict-FP32 or PR40 BF16x9 attestations to the config."""
+    model = config.get("model")
+    if not isinstance(model, dict):
+        raise ValueError("teacher precision recipe has no model config")
+    mode = config.get("precision_mode", "fp32")
+    attention_backend = model.get("attention_backend", "math")
+    compile_blocks = model.get("compile_blocks", False)
+    if (
+        not isinstance(mode, str)
+        or not isinstance(attention_backend, str)
+        or type(compile_blocks) is not bool
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("teacher precision recipe is malformed")
+
+    if mode == BF16_BF16X9:
+        if model.get("precision_mode") != mode:
+            raise ValueError("teacher runtime model precision differs from its config")
+        expected = _bf16_bf16x9_identity(attention_backend)
+        if (
+            provenance.get("precision") != expected
+            or runtime.get("precision") != expected
+            or runtime.get("attention_backend") != attention_backend
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("teacher BF16x9 precision provenance does not match its config")
+        if runtime.get("compiler") != _compiler_identity(compile_blocks):
+            raise ValueError("teacher compiler provenance does not match its config")
+        return expected
+
+    if mode == "fp32" and provenance.get("precision") == LEGACY_STRICT_FP32:
+        if (
+            attention_backend != "math"
+            or compile_blocks
+            or "precision" in runtime
+            or "compiler" in runtime
+            or runtime.get("attention_backend") != "math"
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("legacy strict-FP32 provenance does not match its config")
+        return LEGACY_STRICT_FP32
+
+    raise ValueError("teacher precision provenance does not match a supported config")
+
+
+def common_provenance(producer: dict[str, Any], provenance: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Normalize seed-specific checkpoint provenance to the shared fit contract."""
+    config = producer.get("config")
+    identity = provenance.get("identity")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(config, dict)
+        or provenance.get("schema") != "wnn.sequence-provenance.v1"
+        or not isinstance(identity, dict)
+        or identity.get("schema") != "wnn.sequence-run-identity.v1"
+        or identity.get("config_sha256") != canonical_sha256(config)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("teacher run provenance is incomplete or detached from its recipe")
+    data = identity.get("data")
+    normalization = provenance.get("normalization")
+    training_mask = data.get("training_mask") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
+    expected_mask = {
+        "is_scored": "is_scored AND row_index>=99",
+        "all_after_warmup": "all_after_warmup AND row_index>=99",
+    }.get(training_mask)
+    sources = data.get("sources") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
+    members = producer.get("fit_members")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(data, dict)
+        or data.get("split_sha256") != producer.get("split_sha256")
+        or data.get("fit_members") != members
+        or data.get("input_schema") != "raw112-v1"
+        or expected_mask is None
+        or data.get("mask") != expected_mask
+        or not isinstance(sources, dict)
+        or not isinstance(members, list)
+        or not isinstance(data.get("normalization"), dict)
+        or not isinstance(data["normalization"].get("source_fingerprints"), dict)
+        or identity.get("data_sha256") != canonical_sha256(data)
+        or not isinstance(normalization, dict)
+        or not isinstance(identity.get("source_files"), dict)
+        or identity.get("source_sha256") != canonical_sha256(identity["source_files"])
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("teacher data, source or normalizer provenance is malformed")
+    member_sources: set[str] = set()
+    for member in members:
+        if (
+            not isinstance(member, list)
+            or len(member) != 2
+            or member[0] not in ("train", "valid")
+            or type(member[1]) is not int
+            or member[1] < 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("teacher fit membership is malformed")
+        key = f"datasets/{member[0]}.parquet"
+        member_sources.add(key)
+        record = sources.get(key)
+        if (
+            not isinstance(record, dict)
+            or not isinstance(record.get("sha256"), str)
+            or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", record["sha256"]) is None
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("teacher fit source fingerprints are incomplete")
+    for key, fingerprint in data["normalization"]["source_fingerprints"].items():
+        if (
+            key not in member_sources
+            or not isinstance(fingerprint, dict)
+            or fingerprint.get("sha256") != sources[key].get("sha256")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("teacher normalizer source fingerprints are inconsistent")
+    if not data["normalization"]["source_fingerprints"]:
+        raise ValueError("teacher normalizer source fingerprints are incomplete")
+    means, scales = normalization.get("mean"), normalization.get("std")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(means, list)
+        or not isinstance(scales, list)
+        or len(means) != 112
+        or len(scales) != 112
+        or any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) for value in means)
+        or any(
+            type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) or value <= 0
+            for value in scales
+        )
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("teacher actual normalizer must contain finite raw112 moments")
+    if (
+        type(config.get("epochs")) is not int
+        or provenance.get("completed_epochs") != config["epochs"]
+        or type(provenance.get("global_updates")) is not int
+        or provenance["global_updates"] < 1
+        or provenance.get("fixed_checkpoint_policy") != "configured-final-epoch"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("teacher provenance does not attest a complete fixed fit")
+    runtime = identity.get("runtime")
+    devices = runtime.get("devices") if isinstance(runtime, dict) else None
+    if not isinstance(runtime, dict) or not isinstance(devices, list) or not devices:
+        raise ValueError("teacher runtime provenance is incomplete")
+    world_size = identity.get("world_size")
+    if (
+        type(world_size) is not int
+        or world_size < 1
+        or runtime.get("world_size") != world_size
+        or len(devices) != world_size
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("teacher runtime world size is inconsistent")
+    if (
+        runtime.get("matmul_precision") != "highest"
+        or runtime.get("matmul_tf32") is not False
+        or runtime.get("cudnn_tf32") is not False
+        or runtime.get("autocast") is not False
+        or runtime.get("amp_scaler") is not False
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("teacher runtime has incompatible FP32 process controls")
+    precision = _validate_precision_contract(config, provenance, runtime)
+    semantic_devices = []
+    for device in devices:
+        if (
+            not isinstance(device, dict)
+            or not isinstance(device.get("name"), str)
+            or not device["name"]
+            or not isinstance(device.get("capability"), list)
+            or any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in device["capability"])
+            or type(device.get("total_memory_bytes")) is not int
+            or device["total_memory_bytes"] <= 0
+            or type(device.get("rank")) is not int
+            or type(device.get("local_rank")) is not int
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("teacher device provenance is malformed")
+        semantic_devices.append(
+            {
+                "name": device["name"],
+                "capability": device["capability"],
+                "total_memory_bytes": device["total_memory_bytes"],
+            }
+        )
+    semantic_devices.sort(key=canonical_sha256)
+    common_identity = dict(identity)
+    common_identity.pop("config_sha256")
+    common_runtime = dict(runtime)
+    common_runtime["devices"] = semantic_devices
+    common_identity["runtime"] = common_runtime
+    return {
+        "schema": provenance["schema"],
+        "identity": common_identity,
+        "normalization": normalization,
+        "completed_epochs": provenance.get("completed_epochs"),
+        "global_updates": provenance.get("global_updates"),
+        "precision": precision,
+        "fixed_checkpoint_policy": provenance.get("fixed_checkpoint_policy"),
+    }

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import random
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_distributed import DistributedContext, all_ranks_true, barrier
+from wnn.training.sequence_provenance import json_value
+
+
+def capture_rng_state(context: DistributedContext) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Capture rank-local Python, NumPy, CPU Torch, and CUDA RNG at an epoch boundary."""
+    return {
+        "python": random.getstate(),
+        "numpy": np.random.get_state(),  # noqa: NPY002 - serialize the process-global legacy RNG
+        "torch_cpu": torch.get_rng_state(),
+        "torch_cuda": torch.cuda.get_rng_state(context.device),
+    }
+
+
+def restore_rng_state(state: Mapping[str, object], context: DistributedContext) -> None:
+    """Restore one rank's stochastic state after loading model and optimizer tensors."""
+    random.setstate(state["python"])
+    np.random.set_state(state["numpy"])  # noqa: NPY002 - restore the serialized global RNG
+    torch.set_rng_state(state["torch_cpu"])
+    torch.cuda.set_rng_state(state["torch_cuda"], device=context.device)
+
+
+def _atomic_torch_save(value: object, path: Path) -> None:
+    """Durably replace one safe-boundary checkpoint after serialization succeeds."""
+    descriptor, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
+    temporary = Path(temporary_name)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
+            torch.save(value, stream)
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+        directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
+        try:
+            os.fsync(directory_fd)
+        finally:
+            os.close(directory_fd)
+    finally:
+        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def _gather_rng_states(context: DistributedContext) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+    local = capture_rng_state(context)
+    if not context.process_group:
+        return [local]
+    gathered: list[dict[str, object] | None] = [None] * context.world_size
+    dist.all_gather_object(gathered, local)
+    if any(item is None for item in gathered):
+        raise RuntimeError("a rank did not contribute its epoch-boundary RNG state")
+    return [item for item in gathered if item is not None]
+
+
+def gather_rank_log_offsets(offset: int, context: DistributedContext) -> list[int]:
+    """Collect flushed per-rank JSONL positions for one resumable epoch boundary."""
+    if offset < 0:
+        raise ValueError("rank log offset must be nonnegative")
+    if not context.process_group:
+        return [offset]
+    gathered: list[int | None] = [None] * context.world_size
+    dist.all_gather_object(gathered, offset)
+    if any(value is None or value < 0 for value in gathered):
+        raise RuntimeError("a rank did not contribute a valid safe log offset")
+    return [int(value) for value in gathered if value is not None]
+
+
+def save_training_state(path: Path, state: dict[str, object], context: DistributedContext) -> None:
+    """Atomically save optimizer/model state and each rank's RNG at a safe boundary."""
+    rank_rng_states = _gather_rng_states(context)
+    result: list[dict[str, str | bool]] = [{"ok": True, "error": ""}]
+    if context.is_primary:
+        try:
+            _atomic_torch_save({**state, "rank_rng_states": rank_rng_states}, path)
+        except Exception as error:
+            result[0] = {"ok": False, "error": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"}
+    if context.process_group:
+        dist.broadcast_object_list(result, src=0, device=context.device)
+    if not result[0]["ok"]:
+        raise OSError(str(result[0]["error"]))
+    barrier(context)
+
+
+def load_training_state(
+    path: Path, expected_identity: dict[str, object], context: DistributedContext
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Load a safe checkpoint and reject config/data/source/runtime/world-size drift."""
+    state: dict[str, object] | None = None
+    error = ""
+    try:
+        loaded = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+        if not isinstance(loaded, dict):
+            raise TypeError("resume checkpoint must contain an object")
+        if loaded.get("checkpoint_schema") != "wnn.sequence-resume.v1":
+            raise ValueError("unsupported resume checkpoint schema")
+        if loaded.get("contract") != expected_identity:
+            raise ValueError("resume config/data/source/runtime identity does not match")
+        if not _counter(loaded.get("world_size")) or loaded["world_size"] != context.world_size:
+            raise ValueError("resume requires the exact original torchrun world size")
+        for field in ("next_epoch", "global_step", "metrics_offset"):
+            if not _counter(loaded.get(field)):
+                raise ValueError(f"resume checkpoint {field} must be a nonnegative integer")
+        if not isinstance(loaded.get("model"), dict):
+            raise ValueError("resume checkpoint is missing model state")
+        if not isinstance(loaded.get("optimizer"), dict):
+            raise ValueError("resume checkpoint is missing optimizer state")
+        if not isinstance(loaded.get("scheduler"), dict):
+            raise ValueError("resume checkpoint is missing scheduler state")
+        if not isinstance(loaded.get("history"), list):
+            raise ValueError("resume history must be a list")
+        history = loaded["history"]
+        next_epoch = int(loaded["next_epoch"])
+        global_step = int(loaded["global_step"])
+        if len(history) != next_epoch or not all(isinstance(row, dict) for row in history):
+            raise ValueError("resume history does not match its completed epoch counter")
+        if any(
+            not _counter(row.get("epoch"))
+            or row["epoch"] != index
+            or not _counter(row.get("updates"))
+            or row.get("complete") is not True
+            for index, row in enumerate(history)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("resume history contains malformed epoch records")
+        if sum(int(row["updates"]) for row in history) != global_step:
+            raise ValueError("resume global step does not match completed epoch updates")
+        ranks = loaded.get("rank_rng_states")
+        offsets = loaded.get("rank_log_offsets")
+        if not isinstance(ranks, list) or len(ranks) != context.world_size:
+            raise ValueError("resume checkpoint is missing rank-local RNG states")
+        if not all(
+            isinstance(item, Mapping)
+            and set(item) >= {"python", "numpy", "torch_cpu", "torch_cuda"}
+            for item in ranks
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("resume checkpoint contains malformed rank-local RNG state")
+        if (
+            not isinstance(offsets, list)
+            or len(offsets) != context.world_size
+            or not all(_counter(value) for value in offsets)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("resume checkpoint is missing per-rank safe log offsets")
+        state = loaded
+    except Exception as exception:
+        error = f"{type(exception).__name__}: {exception}"
+    if not all_ranks_true(state is not None, context):
+        messages: list[str | None] = [None] * context.world_size
+        if context.process_group:
+            dist.all_gather_object(messages, error)
+        else:
+            messages[0] = error
+        detail = "; ".join(message for message in messages if message)
+        raise RuntimeError(f"resume checkpoint failed on at least one rank: {detail}")
+    if state is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("resume checkpoint did not load")
+    return state
+
+
+def _counter(value: object) -> bool:
+    """Accept only nonnegative integer checkpoint counters, excluding booleans."""
+    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value >= 0
+
+
+def atomic_write_json(value: object, path: Path) -> None:
+    """Atomically write one JSON receipt without replacing an existing artifact."""
+    if path.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to replace existing receipt: {path}")
+    encoded = (
+        json.dumps(json_value(value), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        + "\n"
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+    descriptor, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
+    temporary = Path(temporary_name)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
+            stream.write(encoded)
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        os.link(temporary, path)
+        directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
+        try:
+            os.fsync(directory_fd)
+        finally:
+            os.close(directory_fd)
+    finally:
+        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def save_final_model(
+    path: Path,
+    model_state: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+    config: dict[str, object],
+    epoch: int,
+    completed_epochs: int,
+    data_provenance: Mapping[str, object],
+    provenance: dict[str, object],
+) -> None:
+    """Write the fixed-final inference envelope once after every configured epoch."""
+    if completed_epochs != int(config["epochs"]):
+        raise ValueError("final model requires all configured epochs to be complete")
+    if path.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to replace existing final model: {path}")
+    cpu_state = {name: tensor.detach().cpu() for name, tensor in model_state.items()}
+    payload = {
+        "checkpoint_schema": "wnn.sequence-fit.v1",
+        "model": cpu_state,
+        "config": config,
+        "epoch": epoch,
+        "completed_epochs": completed_epochs,
+        "data": json_value(data_provenance),
+        "provenance": provenance,
+    }
+    descriptor, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
+    temporary = Path(temporary_name)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
+            torch.save(payload, stream)
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        os.link(temporary, path)
+        directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
+        try:
+            os.fsync(directory_fd)
+        finally:
+            os.close(directory_fd)
+    finally:
+        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)

+"""Explicit optional compilation for the Transformer block modules."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+from torch import nn
+
+COMPILER_RECOMPILE_LIMIT = 64
+
+
+def compile_transformer_blocks(blocks: nn.ModuleList, *, enabled: bool) -> bool:
+    """Compile blocks in place, preserving module parameter and checkpoint paths.
+
+    PyTorch defers compilation until a block is first called and caches compiled
+    specializations internally. Static-shape compilation avoids CUDA graph capture;
+    graph breaks may run eager segments and must be recorded by the profile.
+    """
+    if type(enabled) is not bool:
+        raise TypeError("enabled must be a bool")
+    if not enabled:
+        return False
+    if len(blocks) == 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("cannot compile an empty Transformer block list")
+
+    # The recipe has three KV lengths, full/tail row chunks, final partial batches,
+    # and train/eval variants. Bound those specializations without the default
+    # eight-frame cap permanently switching a long fit back to eager execution.
+    import torch._dynamo.config as dynamo_config
+
+    dynamo_config.recompile_limit = COMPILER_RECOMPILE_LIMIT
+
+    compile_methods: list[Callable[..., object]] = []
+    for index, block in enumerate(blocks):
+        compile_method = getattr(block, "compile", None)
+        if not callable(compile_method):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Transformer block {index} does not support torch.compile")
+        compile_methods.append(compile_method)
+
+    for compile_method in compile_methods:
+        compile_method(backend="inductor", mode="default", fullgraph=False, dynamic=None)
+    return True

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_precision import PRECISION_MODES, validate_process_environment
+
+# JSON is heterogeneous at this boundary; validated fields are consumed by the runtime.
+DEFAULTS: dict[str, Any] = {
+    "schema_version": 1,
+    "epochs": 3,
+    "batch_size": 1,
+    "accumulate_chunks": 4,
+    "chunk_rows": 256,

+    "adamw_beta1": 0.9,

+    "adamw_eps": 1e-8,
+    "grad_clip": 1.0,
+    "warmup_fraction": 0.05,
+    "schedule": "legacy_warmup_cosine",
+    "min_lr_ratio": 0.0,
+    "kd_weight": 0.0,
+    "hint_weight": 0.0,

+    "normalization_scope": "prefix",
+    "required_world_size": None,

+    "precision_mode": "fp32",
+}
+MODEL_DEFAULTS: dict[str, Any] = {
+    "architecture": "transformer",
+    "hidden": 768,
+    "layers": 24,
+    "heads": 12,
+    "ff_multiplier": 4,

+
+def load_config(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read a bounded precision-explicit recipe; reject silently ignored settings."""
+    raw = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) - (set(DEFAULTS) | {"model"}):
+        raise ValueError("unknown sequence recipe field")
+    config = DEFAULTS | raw
+    # Preserve legacy AdamW's .999 while defaulting the Muon-side AdamW groups to .95.
+    if config["optimizer"] == "muon" and "adamw_beta2" not in raw:
+        config["adamw_beta2"] = 0.95
+    model = MODEL_DEFAULTS | raw.get("model", {})
+    if set(model) - set(MODEL_DEFAULTS):
+        raise ValueError("unknown sequence model field")
+    config["model"] = model
+    for key in (
+        "schema_version",
+        "epochs",
+        "batch_size",
+        "accumulate_chunks",
+        "chunk_rows",
+        "normalization_sequences",
+    ):
+        if type(config[key]) is not int or config[key] < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"{key} must be a positive integer")
+    if config["schema_version"] != 1 or config["chunk_rows"] > 20_000:
+        raise ValueError("unsupported schema or chunk length")
+    if type(config["seed"]) is not int or not 0 <= config["seed"] < 2**32:
+        raise ValueError("seed must be an unsigned 32-bit integer")
+    for key in (
+        "lr",
+        "weight_decay",
+        "grad_clip",
+        "warmup_fraction",
+        "kd_weight",
+        "hint_weight",
+        "muon_ns_eps",
+        "adamw_eps",
+    ):
+        if not isinstance(config[key], (float, int)) or not math.isfinite(config[key]):
+            raise ValueError(f"{key} must be finite")
+        if config[key] < 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{key} must be nonnegative")
+    if config["lr"] == 0 or config["grad_clip"] == 0 or config["warmup_fraction"] >= 1:
+        raise ValueError("positive learning rate/clipping and warmup_fraction < 1 required")
+    if type(config["muon_ns_steps"]) is not int or config["muon_ns_steps"] <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("muon_ns_steps must be a positive integer")
+    for key in ("muon_ns_eps", "adamw_eps"):
+        value = config[key]
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (float, int)) or value <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{key} must be a positive number")
+    for key in ("muon_momentum", "adamw_beta1", "adamw_beta2"):
+        value = config[key]
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (float, int)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{key} must be numeric")
+        if not math.isfinite(value) or not 0 <= value < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"{key} must be finite and in [0, 1)")
+    if config["optimizer"] not in ("adamw", "muon"):
+        raise ValueError("optimizer must be adamw or muon")
+    if config["precision_mode"] not in PRECISION_MODES:
+        raise ValueError("precision_mode must be fp32, tf32, bf16, fp32_bf16x9, or bf16_bf16x9")
+    validate_process_environment(config["precision_mode"])
+    if config["schedule"] not in ("legacy_warmup_cosine", "warmup_cosine_v2"):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported sequence learning-rate schedule")
+    ratio = config["min_lr_ratio"]
+    if isinstance(ratio, bool) or not isinstance(ratio, (float, int)):
+        raise ValueError("min_lr_ratio must be numeric")
+    if not math.isfinite(ratio) or not 0 <= ratio <= 1:
+        raise ValueError("min_lr_ratio must be finite and in [0, 1]")
+    if config["schedule"] == "legacy_warmup_cosine" and ratio != 0:
+        raise ValueError("legacy_warmup_cosine requires min_lr_ratio=0")
+    for key in ("hidden", "layers", "heads", "ff_multiplier", "context_rows"):
+        if type(model[key]) is not int or model[key] < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"model.{key} must be a positive integer")
+    if type(model["hint_dim"]) is not int or model["hint_dim"] < 0:
+        raise ValueError("hint_dim must be a nonnegative integer")
+    if model["architecture"] not in ("transformer", "gru"):
+        raise ValueError("architecture must be transformer or gru")
+    if model["attention_backend"] not in ("math", "efficient", "flex"):
+        raise ValueError("model.attention_backend must be math, efficient, or flex")
+    if model["architecture"] == "gru" and model["attention_backend"] != "math":
+        raise ValueError("attention backends are supported only by Transformer models")
+    if type(model["compile_blocks"]) is not bool:
+        raise ValueError("model.compile_blocks must be boolean")
+    if model["architecture"] == "gru" and model["compile_blocks"]:
+        raise ValueError("model.compile_blocks requires a Transformer model")
+    if config["optimizer"] == "muon" and model["architecture"] != "transformer":
+        raise ValueError("sequence Muon currently supports Transformer models only")
+    if model["hint_projection"] not in ("fixed", "learned"):
+        raise ValueError("hint_projection must be fixed or learned")
+    if model["dropout"] != 0 or type(model["checkpoint_blocks"]) is not bool:
+        raise ValueError("this paired runtime freezes dropout=0 and boolean checkpoint_blocks")
+    if model["architecture"] == "transformer" and model["hidden"] % (2 * model["heads"]):
+        raise ValueError("RoPE requires an even integral head dimension")
+    if config["hint_weight"] > 0 and (
+        model["hint_dim"] == 0 or model["hint_projection"] != "learned"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("hint distillation requires a learned student projection")
+    if config["hint_mode"] not in ("aligned", "component_permuted"):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported hint control")
+    if config["hint_mode"] != "aligned" and config["hint_weight"] <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("permuted hints require a positive hint loss")
+    if config["training_mask"] not in ("is_scored", "all_after_warmup"):
+        raise ValueError("training_mask must be is_scored or all_after_warmup")
+    if config["normalization_scope"] not in ("prefix", "all_fit"):
+        raise ValueError("normalization_scope must be prefix or all_fit")
+    required_world_size = config["required_world_size"]
+    if required_world_size is not None and (
+        type(required_world_size) is not int or required_world_size < 1
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("required_world_size must be null or a positive integer")
+    required_device = config["required_device"]
+    if required_device not in (None, "B300"):
+        raise ValueError("required_device must be null or B300")
+    expected_fold = config["expected_fold"]
+    if expected_fold is not None and (type(expected_fold) is not int or expected_fold < 0):
+        raise ValueError("expected_fold must be null or a nonnegative integer")
+    # This runtime-only field lets fit and inference build the same precision-aware model.
+    model["precision_mode"] = config["precision_mode"]
+    config["model"] = model
+    return config
+
+
+def validate_runtime_requirements(
+    config: dict[str, Any], world_size: int, device_name: str
+) -> bool:
+    """Check the recipe's optional world-size and device requirements on this rank."""
+    required_world_size = config["required_world_size"]
+    if required_world_size is not None and world_size != required_world_size:
+        raise ValueError(f"recipe requires world size {required_world_size}, received {world_size}")
+    if config["required_device"] == "B300" and "B300" not in device_name.upper():
+        raise ValueError(f"recipe requires an NVIDIA B300 device, received {device_name!r}")
+    return True
+
+
+def validate_expected_fold(config: dict[str, Any], actual_fold: int) -> bool:
+    """Check the loaded split's fold against the recipe's optional fold requirement."""
+    expected_fold = config["expected_fold"]
+    if expected_fold is not None and actual_fold != expected_fold:
+        raise ValueError(f"recipe requires fold {expected_fold}, received fold {actual_fold}")
+    return True

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from attrs import define
+from torch.utils.data import Dataset
+
+from wnn.data import N_FEATURES, SEQUENCE_LENGTH, WARMUP
+from wnn.splits import MAX_CAMPAIGN_SPLIT_BYTES, CampaignSplit, load_campaign_split
+from wnn.training.datasets import Sequences
+from wnn.training.environment import InputConfiguration, TrainingEnvironment
+from wnn.training.sequence_cache import TeacherCache
+from wnn.training.sequence_normalization import (
+    NormalizationMoments,
+    build_normalization_identity,
+    compute_population_moments,
+    load_or_compute_full_fit_moments,
+    moments_sha256,
+    normalization_identity_sha256,
+)
+
+# Heterogeneous JSON recipes/provenance are restricted to the public runtime boundary.
+
+
+class SequenceRecords(Dataset):
+    """Wrap canonical full sequences with explicit source keys and zero-weight DDP padding."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        root: Path,
+        members: list[tuple[str, int]],
+        hint_dim: int,
+        cache: TeacherCache | None = None,
+        hint_members: list[tuple[str, int]] | None = None,
+        training_mask: str = "is_scored",
+    ) -> None:
+        self.members = members
+        self.hint_dim = hint_dim
+        self.cache = cache
+        self.hint_members = hint_members
+        if training_mask not in ("is_scored", "all_after_warmup"):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported sequence training mask")
+        self.training_mask = training_mask
+        env = TrainingEnvironment(root=root, inputs=InputConfiguration(raw_only=True))
+        self.sources = {
+            split: Sequences(
+                split, [group for source, group in members if source == split], environment=env
+            )
+            for split in ("train", "valid")
+        }
+        self.positions = {}
+        for split in ("train", "valid"):
+            for position, group in enumerate(self.sources[split].indices):
+                self.positions[(split, group)] = position
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        """Return the number of real source-qualified sequences."""
+        return len(self.members)
+
+    def validate_source_schema(self) -> None:
+        """Require targets and, for scored fitting, the explicit evaluation mask."""
+        for source in self.sources.values():
+            if not source.indices:
+                continue
+            if source._file is None:
+                source._file = source.environment.sequence_file(source.path)
+            if not source._file.has_targets:
+                raise ValueError("fitting sources require t0/t1 target columns")
+            if self.training_mask == "is_scored" and not source._file.has_mask:
+                raise ValueError("fitting sources require t0/t1 and is_scored columns")
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Return raw inputs, labels, masks and optional cached teacher values."""
+        if index == -1:
+            return {
+                "x": torch.zeros(SEQUENCE_LENGTH, N_FEATURES),
+                "y": torch.zeros(SEQUENCE_LENGTH, 2),
+                "mask": torch.zeros(SEQUENCE_LENGTH, dtype=torch.bool),
+                "teacher": torch.zeros(SEQUENCE_LENGTH, 2),
+                "hints": torch.zeros(SEQUENCE_LENGTH, self.hint_dim),
+            }
+        split, group = self.members[index]
+        x, y, mask = self.sources[split][self.positions[(split, group)]]
+        if x.shape != (SEQUENCE_LENGTH, N_FEATURES) or y.shape != (SEQUENCE_LENGTH, 2):
+            raise ValueError("raw112/full-sequence training schema mismatch")
+        if not torch.isfinite(x).all() or not torch.isfinite(y).all():
+            raise ValueError(f"nonfinite source sequence: {split}/{group}")
+        if self.training_mask == "all_after_warmup":
+            mask = torch.ones_like(mask, dtype=torch.bool)
+        else:
+            mask = mask.clone()
+        mask[:WARMUP] = False
+        teacher = torch.zeros_like(y)
+        hints = torch.zeros(SEQUENCE_LENGTH, self.hint_dim)
+        if self.cache is not None:
+            teacher, hints = self.cache.read(split, group, self.hint_dim)
+            if self.hint_members is not None:
+                hint_source, hint_group = self.hint_members[index]
+                _, hints = self.cache.read(hint_source, hint_group, self.hint_dim)
+        return {"x": x.float(), "y": y.float(), "mask": mask, "teacher": teacher, "hints": hints}
+
+
+@define
+class SequenceData:
+    """Validated membership shared by fitting, teacher exports and official scoring."""
+
+    fit: SequenceRecords
+    evaluation: SequenceRecords
+    split: CampaignSplit
+    provenance: dict[str, Any]
+    normalization_sequences: int
+
+    def normalization(self) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Resolve source-bound raw-input moments from fitting members only.
+
+        Float64 moment accumulation is preprocessing, not mixed-precision training.
+        All model buffers and input tensors are serialized and consumed as FP32.
+        """
+        normalization = self.provenance["normalization"]
+        scope = normalization["scope"]
+        if scope == "all_fit":
+            members = list(self.fit.members)
+        elif scope == "prefix":
+            members = self.fit.members[: min(len(self.fit), self.normalization_sequences)]
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("unsupported normalization scope")
+        if len(members) != normalization["sequence_count"]:
+            raise ValueError("normalization membership changed after data construction")
+
+        def read_features(source_name: str, group: int) -> np.ndarray:
+            """Read one selected fitting row group without labels or scoring masks."""
+            source = self.fit.sources[source_name]
+            if source._file is None:
+                source._file = source.environment.sequence_file(source.path)
+            return source._file.read(group, targets=False, mask=False).features
+
+        source_root = self.fit.sources[members[0][0]].environment.root.resolve()
+        source_fingerprints = normalization["source_fingerprints"]
+        if scope == "all_fit":
+            result = load_or_compute_full_fit_moments(
+                source_root / "cache" / "sequence_normalization",
+                source_fingerprints,
+                self.provenance["split_sha256"],
+                members,
+                read_features,
+                feature_count=N_FEATURES,
+            )
+        else:
+            identity = build_normalization_identity(
+                source_fingerprints,
+                self.provenance["split_sha256"],
+                members,
+                scope,
+                N_FEATURES,
+            )
+            mean, std = compute_population_moments(members, read_features, feature_count=N_FEATURES)
+            result = NormalizationMoments(
+                mean,
+                std,
+                normalization_identity_sha256(identity),
+                moments_sha256(mean, std),
+                len(members),
+            )
+        normalization["identity_sha256"] = result.identity_sha256
+        normalization["moments_sha256"] = result.moments_sha256
+        return torch.from_numpy(result.mean), torch.from_numpy(result.std)
+
+
+def permuted_hint_members(
+    members: list[tuple[str, int]],
+    split: CampaignSplit,
+    seed: int,
+) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
+    """Rotate fitting components, retaining row position and excluding the source component."""
+    component_of = {(s, g): c for s, g, c in split.components}
+    groups: dict[int, list[tuple[str, int]]] = {}
+    for member in members:
+        groups.setdefault(component_of[member], []).append(member)
+    ordered = list(np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(sorted(groups)))
+    if len(ordered) < 2:
+        raise ValueError("component-permuted hints need at least two fitting components")
+    mapping = {}
+    for index, component in enumerate(ordered):
+        donor = groups[ordered[(index + 1) % len(ordered)]]
+        for position, member in enumerate(groups[component]):
+            mapping[member] = donor[position % len(donor)]
+    return [mapping[member] for member in members]
+
+
+def build_data(
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    data_root: Path,
+    split_manifest: Path,
+    teacher_cache: Path | None = None,
+) -> SequenceData:
+    """Validate the canonical component split before opening any training stream."""
+    split = load_campaign_split(split_manifest, data_root)
+    members = [("train", group) for group in split.train_groups]
+    members += [("valid", group) for group in split.valid_groups]
+    hint_dim = config["model"]["hint_dim"]

+        "input_schema": "raw112-v1",

+            "all_after_warmup AND row_index>=99"
+            if training_mask == "all_after_warmup"
+            else "is_scored AND row_index>=99"

+        "hint_members": None if hint_members is None else [list(member) for member in hint_members],

+        data_root,
+        members,
+        hint_dim,
+        cache,
+        hint_members,
+        training_mask=training_mask,

+    evaluation.validate_source_schema()

+        fit,
+        evaluation,
+        split,
+        provenance,
+        config["normalization_sequences"],

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TypeVar
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DistributedContext:
+    """CUDA and process-group identity for one torchrun worker."""
+
+    rank: int
+    local_rank: int
+    world_size: int
+    device: torch.device
+    process_group: bool
+
+    @property
+    def is_primary(self) -> bool:
+        """Return whether this worker owns shared artifacts and summaries."""
+        return self.rank == 0
+
+
+def configure_strict_fp32() -> None:
+    """Disable TF32 and request IEEE FP32 matmul precision for fit and inference."""
+    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
+    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
+    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
+
+
+def initialize_distributed() -> DistributedContext:
+    """Initialize one strict-FP32 CUDA worker and NCCL when multiple ranks run."""
+    rank = int(os.environ.get("RANK", "0"))
+    world_size = int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1"))
+    local_rank = int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", "0"))
+    if world_size < 1 or not 0 <= rank < world_size or local_rank < 0:
+        raise ValueError("invalid torchrun rank configuration")
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        raise RuntimeError("sequence fitting requires CUDA; CPU training is disabled")
+    if local_rank >= torch.cuda.device_count():
+        raise RuntimeError("LOCAL_RANK exceeds the visible CUDA device count")
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    configure_strict_fp32()
+    process_group = world_size > 1
+    if process_group:
+        if not dist.is_available():
+            raise RuntimeError("this PyTorch build does not provide distributed support")
+        dist.init_process_group(
+            backend="nccl", init_method="env://", rank=rank, world_size=world_size
+        )
+    return DistributedContext(
+        rank, local_rank, world_size, torch.device("cuda", local_rank), process_group
+    )
+
+
+def wrap_distributed(model: torch.nn.Module, context: DistributedContext) -> torch.nn.Module:
+    """Wrap the model in one-process-per-GPU DDP when the world has multiple ranks."""
+    if not context.process_group:
+        return model
+    return DistributedDataParallel(
+        model,
+        device_ids=[context.local_rank],
+        output_device=context.local_rank,
+        broadcast_buffers=True,
+        find_unused_parameters=False,
+    )
+
+
+def local_sequence_indices(
+    size: int, context: DistributedContext, seed: int, epoch: int
+) -> list[int]:
+    """Shard one deterministic shuffled permutation, padding only with the -1 sentinel."""
+    if size < 1 or epoch < 0:
+        raise ValueError("training data must be nonempty and epoch must be nonnegative")
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu")
+    generator.manual_seed(seed + epoch)
+    permutation = torch.randperm(size, generator=generator).tolist()
+    padding = (-len(permutation)) % context.world_size
+    permutation.extend([-1] * padding)
+    local = permutation[context.rank :: context.world_size]
+    if len(local) != (size + context.world_size - 1) // context.world_size:
+        raise RuntimeError("distributed sequence partition produced unequal rank counts")
+    return local
+
+
+def global_sum(values: torch.Tensor, context: DistributedContext) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Sum a small device tensor across ranks while preserving its input value."""
+    result = values.clone()
+    if context.process_group:
+        dist.all_reduce(result, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
+    return result
+
+
+def all_ranks_true(local_value: bool, context: DistributedContext) -> bool:
+    """Agree on a finite/error predicate before any rank takes a divergent path."""
+    flag = torch.tensor(int(local_value), dtype=torch.int32, device=context.device)
+    if context.process_group:
+        dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN)
+    return bool(flag.item())
+
+
+def coordinated_call(function: Callable[[], T], label: str, context: DistributedContext) -> T:
+    """Run one setup operation and report any rank-local Python failure to every worker."""
+    value: T | None = None
+    local_error = ""
+    try:
+        value = function()
+    except Exception as error:
+        local_error = f"rank {context.rank}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}"
+    if not all_ranks_true(not local_error, context):
+        errors: list[str | None] = [None] * context.world_size
+        if context.process_group:
+            dist.all_gather_object(errors, local_error)
+        else:
+            errors[0] = local_error
+        detail = "; ".join(message for message in errors if message)
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} failed on at least one torchrun rank: {detail}")
+    if value is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} returned no value")
+    return value
+
+
+def collective_output_setup(output: Path, resume: bool, context: DistributedContext) -> None:
+    """Create a new run directory on rank zero or validate an explicit resume directory."""
+    status: list[dict[str, str | bool]] = [{"ok": True, "error": ""}]
+    if context.is_primary:
+        try:
+            if resume:
+                if not output.is_dir():
+                    raise FileNotFoundError(f"resume output directory does not exist: {output}")
+            else:
+                output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+        except (FileExistsError, FileNotFoundError, OSError) as error:
+            status[0] = {"ok": False, "error": str(error)}
+    if context.process_group:
+        dist.broadcast_object_list(status, src=0, device=context.device)
+    if not status[0]["ok"]:
+        raise FileExistsError(str(status[0]["error"]))
+
+
+def barrier(context: DistributedContext) -> None:
+    """Wait for all workers when a real process group is active."""
+    if context.process_group:
+        dist.barrier()
+
+
+def shutdown_distributed(context: DistributedContext) -> None:
+    """Release an initialized NCCL process group at normal process completion."""
+    if context.process_group and dist.is_initialized():
+        dist.destroy_process_group()

+        mean.shape == (112,)
+        and std.shape == (112,)
+        and bool(torch.isfinite(mean).all())
+        and bool(torch.isfinite(std).all())
