+def epoch_summary(
+    result: EpochResult, config: Mapping[str, object]
+) -> dict[str, int | float | bool]:
+    """Convert global sufficient sums into losses, work counts, and epoch duration."""
+    totals = result.totals
+    label_denom, hint_denom = float(totals[6].item()), float(totals[7].item())
+    label_loss = float(totals[0].item()) / label_denom if label_denom > 0 else 0.0
+    kd_loss = float(totals[1].item()) / label_denom if label_denom > 0 else 0.0
+    hint_loss = float(totals[2].item()) / hint_denom if hint_denom > 0 else 0.0
+    return {
+        "updates": result.updates,
+        "complete": result.complete,
+        "label_loss": label_loss,
+        "kd_loss": kd_loss,
+        "hint_loss": hint_loss,
+        "total_loss": label_loss
+        + float(config["kd_weight"]) * kd_loss
+        + float(config["hint_weight"]) * hint_loss,
+        "valid_rows": int(totals[3].item()),
+        "forwarded_rows": int(totals[4].item()),
+        "real_rows": int(totals[5].item()),
+        "elapsed_seconds": result.elapsed_seconds,
+    }
+
+
+def write_final_outputs(
+    output: Path,
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    history: list[dict[str, object]],
+    identity: dict[str, object],
+    normalization: dict[str, list[float]],
+    data_provenance: Mapping[str, object],
+    profile_receipt: Path,
+    profile_hash: str,
+    global_step: int,
+) -> bool:
+    """Write a fixed-final model and its terminal hash, preserving any prior artifact."""
+    epochs = int(config["epochs"])
+    model_path = output / "model.pt"
+    provenance: dict[str, object] = {
+        "schema": "wnn.sequence-provenance.v1",
+        "identity": identity,
+        "normalization": normalization,
+        "profile_receipt": {"path": str(profile_receipt), "sha256": profile_hash},
+        "history": json_value(history),
+        "fixed_checkpoint_policy": "configured-final-epoch",
+        "completed_epochs": epochs,
+        "global_updates": global_step,
+        "precision": precision_identity(
+            str(config.get("precision_mode", "fp32")),
+            str(config["model"].get("attention_backend", "math")),
+        ),
+    }
+    if model_path.exists():
+        saved = torch.load(model_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
+        saved_provenance = saved.get("provenance") if isinstance(saved, dict) else None
+        if (
+            not isinstance(saved, dict)
+            or saved.get("checkpoint_schema") != "wnn.sequence-fit.v1"
+            or saved.get("completed_epochs") != epochs
+            or not isinstance(saved_provenance, dict)
+            or saved_provenance.get("identity") != identity
+        ):
+            raise FileExistsError("an incompatible model.pt already exists; refusing to replace it")
+    else:
+        save_final_model(
+            model_path,
+            model.state_dict(),
+            config,
+            epochs - 1,
+            epochs,
+            data_provenance,
+            provenance,
+        )
+    status_path = output / "terminal_status.json"
+    status = {
+        "status": "completed",
+        "completed_epochs": epochs,
+        "global_updates": global_step,
+        "model_sha256": file_sha256(model_path),
+        "identity": identity,
+    }
+    if status_path.exists():
+        saved_status = json.loads(status_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        if json_value(saved_status) != json_value(status):
+            raise FileExistsError("an incompatible terminal status already exists")
+    else:
+        atomic_write_json(status, status_path)
+    return True
+
+
+def record_epoch_metrics(
+    recorder: RunRecorder | None,
+    summary: Mapping[str, int | float | bool],
+    epoch: int,
+    global_step: int,
+    learning_rates: Mapping[str, float],
+) -> bool:
+    """Append one aggregate epoch row after training and before its safe checkpoint."""
+    if recorder is None:
+        return True
+    elapsed = float(summary["elapsed_seconds"])
+    forwarded = float(summary["forwarded_rows"])
+    valid = float(summary["valid_rows"])
+    recorder.record_metrics(
+        step=global_step,
+        epoch=epoch + 1,
+        loss=float(summary["total_loss"]),
+        learning_rates=dict(learning_rates),
+        throughput={
+            "valid_rows_per_second": valid / max(elapsed, 1e-12),
+            "forwarded_rows_per_second": forwarded / max(elapsed, 1e-12),
+        },
+        timing={"epoch_seconds": elapsed},
+    )
+    return True
+
+
+def metrics_offset(output: Path, context: DistributedContext) -> int:
+    """Return the rank-zero aggregate log size for the current safe boundary."""
+    if not context.is_primary:
+        return 0
+    path = output / "metrics.jsonl"
+    return path.stat().st_size if path.exists() else 0

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import random
+import stat
+import time
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Protocol, TypedDict
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from torch.utils.data._utils.collate import default_collate
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_optimizer import build_sequence_muon_optimizer
+from wnn.training.sequence_provenance import json_value
+
+SEQUENCE_ROWS = 20_000
+FEATURE_COUNT = 112
+TARGET_COUNT = 2
+
+
+class SequenceItem(TypedDict):
+    """One canonical sequence record returned by the fit dataset."""
+
+    x: torch.Tensor
+    y: torch.Tensor
+    mask: torch.Tensor
+    teacher: torch.Tensor
+    hints: torch.Tensor
+
+
+class SequenceDataset(Protocol):
+    """Minimal complete-sequence dataset boundary used by the torchrun loop."""
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        """Return the number of canonical fit sequences."""
+        ...
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index: int) -> SequenceItem:
+        """Return one record, including the all-zero masked record for index -1."""
+        ...
+
+
+def seed_worker(seed: int, rank: int) -> None:
+    """Seed construction identically, then give each rank independent stochastic updates."""
+    random.seed(seed + rank)
+    np.random.seed((seed + rank) % (2**32))  # noqa: NPY002 - seed process-global NumPy users
+    torch.manual_seed(seed + rank)
+    torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed + rank)
+
+
+def collate_sequences(dataset: SequenceDataset, indices: Sequence[int]) -> SequenceItem:
+    """Collate complete records directly without creating DataLoader worker processes."""
+    if not indices:
+        raise ValueError("cannot collate an empty sequence batch")
+    records = [dataset[index] for index in indices]
+    batch = default_collate(records)
+    if not isinstance(batch, dict):
+        raise TypeError("sequence dataset records must collate to a mapping")
+    return batch
+
+
+def move_and_validate_batch(
+    batch: SequenceItem, device: torch.device, hint_dim: int
+) -> SequenceItem:
+    """Move one batch and enforce canonical FP32 row, target, mask, and hint shapes."""
+    moved = {key: value.to(device=device, non_blocking=True) for key, value in batch.items()}
+    x, target, mask, teacher, hints = (
+        moved["x"],
+        moved["y"],
+        moved["mask"],
+        moved["teacher"],
+        moved["hints"],
+    )
+    expected_rows = (x.shape[0], SEQUENCE_ROWS)
+    if x.shape != (*expected_rows, FEATURE_COUNT):
+        raise ValueError(f"expected x[B,20000,112], received {tuple(x.shape)}")
+    if target.shape != (*expected_rows, TARGET_COUNT) or teacher.shape != target.shape:
+        raise ValueError("label and teacher batches must have shape [B,20000,2]")
+    if mask.shape != expected_rows or mask.dtype != torch.bool:
+        raise ValueError("sequence mask must be boolean with shape [B,20000]")
+    if hints.shape != (*expected_rows, hint_dim):
+        raise ValueError(f"hint target must have shape [B,20000,{hint_dim}]")
+    for name, value in (("x", x), ("y", target), ("teacher", teacher), ("hints", hints)):
+        if value.dtype != torch.float32:
+            raise TypeError(f"{name} must use strict FP32, received {value.dtype}")
+    return moved
+
+
+def make_optimizer(
+    model: torch.nn.Module, config: Mapping[str, object], total_updates: int
+) -> tuple[torch.optim.Optimizer, torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR]:
+    """Create the configured sequence optimizer and update-indexed LR schedule."""
+    optimizer_name = config.get("optimizer", "adamw")
+    if optimizer_name == "adamw":
+        parameters = [parameter for parameter in model.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad]
+        if not parameters:
+            raise ValueError("sequence model has no trainable parameters")
+        learning_rate = float(config["lr"])
+        betas = (
+            float(config.get("adamw_beta1", 0.9)),
+            float(config.get("adamw_beta2", 0.999)),
+        )
+        optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
+            parameters,
+            lr=learning_rate,
+            betas=betas,
+            eps=float(config.get("adamw_eps", 1e-8)),
+            weight_decay=float(config["weight_decay"]),
+        )
+    elif optimizer_name == "muon":
+        optimizer = build_sequence_muon_optimizer(model, config)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("optimizer must be adamw or muon")
+    multiplier = sequence_lr_multiplier(
+        str(config.get("schedule", "legacy_warmup_cosine")),
+        total_updates,
+        float(config.get("warmup_fraction", 0.05)),
+        float(config.get("min_lr_ratio", 0.0)),
+    )
+    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(optimizer, multiplier)
+    return optimizer, scheduler
+
+
+def sequence_lr_multiplier(
+    schedule: str, total: int, warmup_fraction: float, min_lr_ratio: float
+) -> Callable[[int], float]:
+    """Create a legacy or endpoint-aligned warmup-cosine multiplier.
+
+    Args:
+        schedule: ``legacy_warmup_cosine`` to preserve prior steps or ``warmup_cosine_v2``.
+        total: Number of optimizer updates in the complete fit.
+        warmup_fraction: Fraction of updates reserved for linear warmup.
+        min_lr_ratio: Final fraction of the shared peak learning rate for v2.
+
+    Returns:
+        A callable indexed by ``LambdaLR`` optimizer step number.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If the schedule name, duration, or floor is invalid.
+    """
+    if total < 1 or not 0 <= warmup_fraction < 1 or not 0 <= min_lr_ratio <= 1:
+        raise ValueError("invalid sequence schedule duration, warmup, or floor")
+    if schedule == "legacy_warmup_cosine":
+        if min_lr_ratio != 0:
+            raise ValueError("legacy_warmup_cosine requires min_lr_ratio=0")
+        warmup_updates = min(total, math.ceil(total * warmup_fraction))
+
+        def legacy_multiplier(step: int) -> float:
+            """Preserve the previous warmup/cosine indexing exactly."""
+            if warmup_updates > 0 and step < warmup_updates:
+                return (step + 1) / warmup_updates
+            cosine_updates = max(1, total - warmup_updates)
+            progress = min(1.0, max(0.0, (step - warmup_updates + 1) / cosine_updates))
+            return 0.5 * (1.0 + math.cos(math.pi * progress))
+
+        return legacy_multiplier
+    if schedule != "warmup_cosine_v2":
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown sequence learning-rate schedule: {schedule}")
+    if total < 2:
+        raise ValueError("warmup_cosine_v2 requires at least two optimizer updates")
+    warmup_updates = math.ceil(total * warmup_fraction)
+    if warmup_updates >= total - 1:
+        raise ValueError("warmup_cosine_v2 requires at least one post-warmup endpoint interval")
+
+    def warmup_cosine_v2_multiplier(step: int) -> float:
+        """Reach the configured floor on the final actual update."""
+        if step < warmup_updates:
+            return (step + 1) / warmup_updates if warmup_updates else 1.0
+        denominator = max(1, total - 1 - warmup_updates)
+        progress = min(1.0, max(0.0, (step - warmup_updates) / denominator))
+        cosine = 0.5 * (1.0 + math.cos(math.pi * progress))
+        return min_lr_ratio + (1.0 - min_lr_ratio) * cosine
+
+    return warmup_cosine_v2_multiplier
+
+
+def total_updates(config: Mapping[str, object], sequence_count: int, world_size: int) -> int:
+    """Count fixed schedule steps with the same padded per-rank batching as training."""
+    local_sequences = math.ceil(sequence_count / world_size)
+    batches = math.ceil(local_sequences / int(config["batch_size"]))
+    chunks_per_sequence = math.ceil(SEQUENCE_ROWS / int(config["chunk_rows"]))
+    windows = math.ceil(chunks_per_sequence / int(config["accumulate_chunks"]))
+    return int(config["epochs"]) * batches * windows
+
+
+class RankJsonlLog:
+    """Append rank-local progress records beside the rank-zero aggregate reporter."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: Path, *, resume: bool) -> None:
+        """Open a new rank log or append only when resuming the same run directory."""
+        self._path = path
+        self._stream = path.open("a+b" if resume else "x+b")
+
+    def write(self, record: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
+        """Write one normalized finite JSON line and flush it for failure diagnosis."""
+        value = json_value(record)
+        line = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
+        self._stream.write((line + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
+        self._stream.flush()
+
+    def position(self) -> int:
+        """Return the flushed byte offset used by the latest safe checkpoint."""
+        self._stream.flush()
+        return self._stream.tell()
+
+    def truncate(self, offset: int, *, rank: int, global_step: int) -> int:
+        """Preserve abandoned attempt bytes, then restore the safe log boundary."""
+        return truncate_with_evidence(self._path, offset, rank=rank, global_step=global_step)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Flush and close the rank-owned progress file."""
+        self._stream.close()
+
+
+def truncate_with_evidence(path: Path, offset: int, *, rank: int, global_step: int) -> int:
+    """Preserve post-checkpoint bytes before truncating an interrupted attempt log."""
+    if offset < 0 or global_step < 0 or rank < 0:
+        raise ValueError("resume offsets, rank, and global step must be nonnegative")
+    if not path.exists():
+        if offset == 0:
+            return 0
+        raise ValueError(f"log is missing its checkpointed safe offset: {path}")
+    if not stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode):
+        raise ValueError(f"resume log must be a regular file: {path}")
+    with path.open("r+b") as stream:
+        stream.seek(0, 2)
+        size = stream.tell()
+        if size < offset:
+            raise ValueError(f"log is shorter than its checkpointed safe offset: {path}")
+        if size == offset:
+            return 0
+        stream.seek(offset)
+        discarded = stream.read()
+        evidence = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.replay_tail-{time.time_ns()}.jsonl")
+        with evidence.open("xb") as saved:
+            saved.write(discarded)
+            saved.flush()
+            os.fsync(saved.fileno())
+        audit = path.parent / f"resume_replay_rank{rank}.jsonl"
+        record = {
+            "rank": rank,
+            "safe_global_step": global_step,
+            "source_log": path.name,
+            "evidence_file": evidence.name,
+            "discarded_bytes": len(discarded),
+        }
+        with audit.open("ab") as log:
+            log.write((json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
+            log.flush()
+            os.fsync(log.fileno())
+        stream.truncate(offset)
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    return len(discarded)
+
+
+def optimizer_states_are_finite_fp32(optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer) -> bool:
+    """Require every floating optimizer slot to remain finite strict-FP32 state."""
+    by_device: dict[torch.device, list[torch.Tensor]] = {}
+    for state in optimizer.state.values():
+        for value in state.values():
+            if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) and value.is_floating_point():
+                if value.dtype != torch.float32:
+                    return False
+                by_device.setdefault(value.device, []).append(torch.isfinite(value).all())
+    return all(bool(torch.stack(flags).all()) for flags in by_device.values())

+def _chunks(row_count: int, chunk_rows: int) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
+    """Return nonoverlapping row intervals covering the entire fixed sequence."""
+    return [
+        (start, min(start + chunk_rows, row_count)) for start in range(0, row_count, chunk_rows)
+    ]

+def _check_finite_loss(loss: torch.Tensor, context: DistributedContext) -> None:
+    local_finite = bool(torch.isfinite(loss.detach()).all())
+    if not all_ranks_true(local_finite, context):
+        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite objective detected consistently across torchrun ranks")

+def _backward_window(
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    target: torch.Tensor,
+    teacher: torch.Tensor,
+    hint_target: torch.Tensor,
+    mask: torch.Tensor,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    intervals: list[tuple[int, int]],

+    for index, (start, stop) in enumerate(intervals):

+            model.no_sync()

+            sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.MATH) if attention_backend == "math" else nullcontext()

+        mode = str(config.get("precision_mode", "fp32"))
+        with sync_context, attention_context:
+            with forward_context(mode, context.device.type):
+                prediction, hint_prediction, next_state = model(x[:, start:stop], state)
+            state = detach_state(next_state)
+            prediction = prediction.float()
+            hint_prediction = hint_prediction.float()

+                hint_prediction,

+        "hint_loss": hint_loss,
+        "total_loss": label_loss + kd_weight * kd_loss + hint_weight * hint_loss,
+        "valid_rows": int(stats[3].item()),
+        "forwarded_rows": int(stats[4].item()),
+        "real_rows": int(stats[5].item()),
+        "label_weight": label_denom,
+        "hint_elements": hint_denom,
+        "learning_rate": learning_rate,
+        "gradient_norm_preclip": float(gradient_norm.item()),
+        "gradient_clipped": int(float(gradient_norm.item()) > gradient_clip),
+        "window_seconds": elapsed,
+        "valid_rows_per_second": float(stats[3].item()) / max(elapsed, 1e-12),
+        "forwarded_rows_per_second": float(stats[4].item()) / max(elapsed, 1e-12),
+        "peak_memory_bytes": peak_memory,
+    }
+
+
+def train_epoch(
+    dataset: SequenceDataset,
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    scheduler: torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR,
+    config: dict[str, object],
+    context: DistributedContext,
+    rank_log: RankJsonlLog,
+    epoch: int,
+    global_step: int,
+    max_updates: int | None = None,
+) -> EpochResult:
+    """Run complete sequences in padded distributed order with fixed-window DDP scaling."""
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    model.train()
+    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    size = len(dataset)
+    indices = local_sequence_indices(size, context, int(config["seed"]), epoch)
+    batch_size = int(config["batch_size"])
+    chunk_intervals = _chunks(SEQUENCE_ROWS, int(config["chunk_rows"]))
+    accumulation = int(config["accumulate_chunks"])
+    total_count = torch.zeros(8, dtype=torch.float64, device=context.device)
+    updates = 0
+    for batch_start in range(0, len(indices), batch_size):
+        batch_ids = indices[batch_start : batch_start + batch_size]
+        batch = coordinated_call(
+            lambda batch_ids=batch_ids: move_and_validate_batch(
+                collate_sequences(dataset, batch_ids),
+                context.device,
+                int(config["model"]["hint_dim"]),
+            ),
+            "sequence batch load and validation",
+            context,
+        )
+        target, teacher, mask, hints, x = (
+            batch["y"],
+            batch["teacher"],
+            batch["mask"],
+            batch["hints"],
+            batch["x"],
+        )
+        real_sequence_count = sum(index >= 0 for index in batch_ids)
+        state: Any = None
+        for window_start in range(0, len(chunk_intervals), accumulation):
+            if max_updates is not None and updates >= max_updates:
+                return EpochResult(updates, False, total_count, time.perf_counter() - started)
+            window_started = time.perf_counter()
+            intervals = chunk_intervals[window_start : window_start + accumulation]
+            denominators = _window_denominators(target, mask, hints, intervals, context)

+            state, local_stats = _backward_window(
+                model,
+                optimizer,
+                target,
+                teacher,
+                hints,
+                mask,
+                x,
+                intervals,
+                real_sequence_count,
+                denominators,
+                state,
+                config,
+                context,
+            )
+            gradient_norm, optimizer_seconds = finish_update(
+                model, optimizer, scheduler, context, float(config["grad_clip"])
+            )
+            updates += 1
+            global_step += 1
+            global_stats = global_sum(local_stats, context)
+            total_count[:6] += global_stats
+            total_count[6:] += denominators
+            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - window_started
+            record = _window_record(
+                global_stats,
+                denominators,
+                context.rank,
+                epoch,
+                global_step,
+                lr,
+                gradient_norm,
+                elapsed,
+                torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(context.device),
+                float(config["grad_clip"]),
+                float(config["kd_weight"]),
+                float(config["hint_weight"]),
+            )
+            record["learning_rates"] = rates
+            record["optimizer_seconds"] = optimizer_seconds
+            rank_log.write(record)
+        state = None
+    return EpochResult(updates, True, total_count, time.perf_counter() - started)

+"""Small shared hint and streaming-state helpers for sequence adapters."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor, nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention import TransformerState
+
+SequenceState = Tensor | TransformerState | None
+
+
+class HintProjector(nn.Module):
+    """Produce learned hints or a fixed, normalized random representation."""
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden: int, hint_dim: int, mode: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hint_dim = hint_dim
+        self.linear: nn.Linear | None = None
+        self.normalizer: nn.LayerNorm | None = None
+        self.register_buffer("fixed_projection", None)
+        if hint_dim == 0:
+            return
+        if mode == "learned":
+            self.linear = nn.Linear(hidden, hint_dim)
+            return
+        self.normalizer = nn.LayerNorm(hidden, elementwise_affine=False)
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1729)
+        projection = torch.randn(hint_dim, hidden, generator=generator, dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.fixed_projection = projection / math.sqrt(hidden)
+
+    def forward(self, hidden: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        """Project hidden row vectors when hints are enabled."""
+        if self.hint_dim == 0:
+            return hidden.new_empty((*hidden.shape[:-1], 0))
+        if self.linear is not None:
+            return self.linear(hidden)
+        if self.normalizer is None or self.fixed_projection is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("fixed hint projection was not initialized")
+        return F.linear(self.normalizer(hidden), self.fixed_projection)
+
+
+def detach_state(state: SequenceState) -> SequenceState:
+    """Detach recurrent or Transformer state at an explicit TBPTT boundary."""
+    if state is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(state, Tensor):
+        return state.detach()
+    if isinstance(state, TransformerState):
+        return TransformerState(
+            tuple(key.detach() for key in state.keys),
+            tuple(value.detach() for value in state.values),
+            state.next_position,
+        )
+    raise TypeError(f"unsupported sequence state: {type(state).__name__}")

+"""Causal Transformer and canonical GRU adapters for raw-112 sequence training."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor, nn
+from torch.utils.checkpoint import checkpoint
+
+from wnn.nn import RNNModel
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention import CausalTransformerBlock, TransformerState
+from wnn.training.sequence_compile import compile_transformer_blocks
+from wnn.training.sequence_model_helpers import HintProjector as _HintProjector
+from wnn.training.sequence_model_helpers import detach_state as detach_state
+from wnn.training.sequence_precision import (
+    PRECISION_MODES,
+    checkpoint_context_fn,
+    configure_precision_mode,
+    validate_forward_state,
+)
+
+RAW_INPUT_WIDTH = 112
+
+
+def _check_fp32_environment(model: nn.Module, values: Tensor, precision_mode: str) -> None:
+    if values.dtype != torch.float32:
+        raise TypeError("sequence models require float32 inputs")
+    if any(parameter.dtype != torch.float32 for parameter in model.parameters()):
+        raise TypeError("sequence models require float32 parameters")
+    if any(buffer is not None and buffer.dtype != torch.float32 for buffer in model.buffers()):
+        raise TypeError("sequence models require float32 buffers")
+    validate_forward_state(precision_mode, values.device.type)
+
+
+def _check_input_shape(values: Tensor) -> None:
+    if values.ndim != 3 or values.shape[-1] != RAW_INPUT_WIDTH:
+        raise ValueError("sequence models accept only raw input shaped [batch, rows, 112]")
+    if values.shape[0] <= 0 or values.shape[1] <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("sequence batches and row chunks must be non-empty")
+
+
+class _GRUSequenceAdapter(RNNModel):
+    """Expose canonical GRU hidden rows for hints without changing its prediction path."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden: int,
+        layers: int,
+        dropout: float,
+        hint_dim: int,
+        hint_mode: str,
+        precision_mode: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            RAW_INPUT_WIDTH, hidden, layers, dropout, n_out=2, cell="gru", enc="linear"
+        )
+        self.precision_mode = precision_mode
+        self.hint_projector = _HintProjector(hidden, hint_dim, hint_mode)
+
+    def forward(self, values: Tensor, state: Tensor | None = None) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]:
+        """Return canonical GRU predictions, hidden-state hints, and recurrent state."""
+        _check_input_shape(values)
+        _check_fp32_environment(self, values, self.precision_mode)
+        if state is not None and (
+            state.shape != (self.gru.num_layers, values.shape[0], self.hidden)
+            or state.device != values.device
+            or state.dtype != torch.float32
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "GRU state must match the model layers, batch, device, and float32 dtype"
+            )
+        encoded = self.encode((values - self.mean) / self.std)
+        recurrent, next_state = self.gru(encoded, state)
+        prediction = self.head(torch.cat((recurrent, encoded), dim=-1))
+        # Autocast can return BF16 recurrent state; the next chunk's public
+        # streaming interface and saved activation state remain FP32.
+        return prediction, self.hint_projector(recurrent), next_state.float()
+
+
+class _TransformerSequenceAdapter(nn.Module):
+    """Causal RoPE Transformer; receptive field spans up to 1 + layers * (context_rows - 1)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden: int,
+        layers: int,
+        heads: int,
+        ff_width: int,
+        context_rows: int,
+        dropout: float,
+        checkpoint_blocks: bool,
+        hint_dim: int,
+        hint_mode: str,
+        precision_mode: str,
+        attention_backend: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.hidden = hidden
+        self.heads = heads
+        self.head_dim = hidden // heads
+        self.context_rows = context_rows
+        self.dropout = dropout
+        self.checkpoint_blocks = checkpoint_blocks
+        self.precision_mode = precision_mode
+        self.attention_backend = attention_backend
+        self.register_buffer("mean", torch.zeros(RAW_INPUT_WIDTH, dtype=torch.float32))
+        self.register_buffer("std", torch.ones(RAW_INPUT_WIDTH, dtype=torch.float32))
+        self.input_projection = nn.Linear(RAW_INPUT_WIDTH, hidden)
+        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList(
+            CausalTransformerBlock(hidden, heads, ff_width, dropout, attention_backend)
+            for _ in range(layers)
+        )
+        self.output_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden)
+        self.output_head = nn.Linear(hidden, 2)
+        self.hint_projector = _HintProjector(hidden, hint_dim, hint_mode)
+
+    def _state_for_batch(self, values: Tensor, state: TransformerState | None) -> TransformerState:
+        if state is None:
+            empty = values.new_empty(values.shape[0], self.heads, 0, self.head_dim)
+            return TransformerState(
+                tuple(empty for _ in self.blocks), tuple(empty for _ in self.blocks), 0
+            )
+        if len(state.keys) != len(self.blocks) or len(state.values) != len(self.blocks):
+            raise ValueError("Transformer state layer count differs from this model")
+        if type(state.next_position) is not int or state.next_position < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Transformer state has an invalid absolute position")
+        cache_length: int | None = None
+        for key, value in zip(state.keys, state.values, strict=True):
+            if key.shape != value.shape or key.ndim != 4:
+                raise ValueError("Transformer state key/value shapes do not match")
+            if key.shape[:2] != (values.shape[0], self.heads) or key.shape[-1] != self.head_dim:
+                raise ValueError("Transformer state batch or head shape differs from this model")
+            if (
+                key.device != values.device
+                or value.device != values.device
+                or key.dtype != torch.float32
+                or value.dtype != torch.float32
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Transformer state must use the input device and float32")
+            if cache_length is None:
+                cache_length = key.shape[-2]
+            elif cache_length != key.shape[-2]:
+                raise ValueError("Transformer layer caches must have the same row count")
+        if (cache_length or 0) > min(self.context_rows - 1, state.next_position):
+            raise ValueError("Transformer state exceeds the configured causal context")
+        return state
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        values: Tensor,
+        state: TransformerState | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, TransformerState]:
+        """Predict each raw row using only current and bounded past sequence rows."""
+        _check_input_shape(values)
+        _check_fp32_environment(self, values, self.precision_mode)
+        previous = self._state_for_batch(values, state)
+        position = previous.next_position
+        hidden = self.input_projection((values - self.mean) / self.std)
+        dropout_p = self.dropout if self.training else 0.0
+        next_keys: list[Tensor] = []
+        next_values: list[Tensor] = []
+        for block, past_key, past_value in zip(
+            self.blocks, previous.keys, previous.values, strict=True
+        ):
+            if self.checkpoint_blocks and self.training:
+
+                def _run_block(
+                    x: Tensor,
+                    key: Tensor,
+                    value: Tensor,
+                    layer: CausalTransformerBlock = block,
+                ) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]:
+                    return layer(x, key, value, position, self.context_rows, dropout_p)
+
+                hidden, key, value = checkpoint(
+                    _run_block,
+                    hidden,
+                    past_key,
+                    past_value,
+                    use_reentrant=False,
+                    context_fn=lambda: checkpoint_context_fn(
+                        self.precision_mode, values.device.type
+                    ),
+                )
+            else:
+                hidden, key, value = block(
+                    hidden, past_key, past_value, position, self.context_rows, dropout_p
+                )
+            next_keys.append(key)
+            next_values.append(value)
+        latent = self.output_norm(hidden)
+        prediction = self.output_head(latent)
+        next_state = TransformerState(
+            tuple(next_keys), tuple(next_values), position + values.shape[1]
+        )
+        return prediction, self.hint_projector(latent), next_state
+
+
+def _integer_option(config: dict[str, object], name: str, default: int | None = None) -> int:
+    if name not in config:
+        if default is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"model config requires {name!r}")
+        return default
+    value = config[name]
+    if type(value) is not int:
+        raise TypeError(f"model config {name!r} must be an integer")
+    return value
+
+
+def _float_option(config: dict[str, object], name: str, default: float) -> float:
+    value = config.get(name, default)
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        raise TypeError(f"model config {name!r} must be numeric")
+    parsed = float(value)
+    if not math.isfinite(parsed):
+        raise ValueError(f"model config {name!r} must be finite")
+    return parsed
+
+
+def build_sequence_model(config: dict[str, object]) -> nn.Module:
+    """Build a causal Transformer or canonical GRU with FP32 master parameters.
+
+    Args:
+        config: Model settings with architecture, hidden, layers, heads,
+            ff_multiplier, and context_rows. Dropout, activation checkpointing,
+            hint_dim, and hint_projection are optional.
+
+    Returns:
+        A module accepting raw ``[batch, rows, 112]`` values and returning
+        predictions, hints, and resumable sequence state.
+
+    Raises:
+        TypeError: If a setting has the wrong type or the default dtype is reduced.
+        ValueError: If the architecture or dimensions are invalid.
+    """
+    if torch.get_default_dtype() != torch.float32:
+        raise TypeError("sequence model construction requires the default dtype to be float32")
+    architecture = config.get("architecture")
+    if architecture not in ("transformer", "gru"):
+        raise ValueError("model config architecture must be 'transformer' or 'gru'")
+    hidden = _integer_option(config, "hidden")
+    layers = _integer_option(config, "layers")
+    heads = _integer_option(config, "heads")
+    context_rows = _integer_option(config, "context_rows")
+    hint_dim = _integer_option(config, "hint_dim", 0)
+    dropout = _float_option(config, "dropout", 0.0)
+    ff_multiplier = _float_option(config, "ff_multiplier", 4.0)
+    checkpoint_blocks = config.get("checkpoint_blocks", False)
+    hint_mode = config.get("hint_projection", "learned")
+    precision_mode = config.get("precision_mode", "fp32")
+    attention_backend = config.get("attention_backend", "math")
+    compile_blocks = config.get("compile_blocks", False)
+    if type(checkpoint_blocks) is not bool:
+        raise TypeError("model config 'checkpoint_blocks' must be boolean")
+    if hint_mode not in ("learned", "fixed"):
+        raise ValueError("model config hint_projection must be 'learned' or 'fixed'")
+    if precision_mode not in PRECISION_MODES:
+        raise ValueError("unsupported sequence precision mode")
+    if type(compile_blocks) is not bool:
+        raise TypeError("model config 'compile_blocks' must be boolean")
+    configure_precision_mode(str(precision_mode))
+    if attention_backend not in ("math", "efficient", "flex"):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported sequence attention backend")
+    if min(hidden, layers, heads, context_rows) <= 0 or hint_dim < 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "hidden, layers, heads, and context_rows must be positive; hint_dim nonnegative"
+        )
+    if not 0.0 <= dropout < 1.0 or ff_multiplier <= 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("dropout must be in [0, 1) and ff_multiplier must be positive")
+    if architecture == "gru":
+        if compile_blocks:
+            raise ValueError("compile_blocks requires a Transformer model")
+        if attention_backend != "math":
+            raise ValueError("attention backend selection requires a Transformer model")
+        return _GRUSequenceAdapter(hidden, layers, dropout, hint_dim, hint_mode, precision_mode)
+    if hidden % heads != 0 or (hidden // heads) % 2 != 0:
+        raise ValueError("Transformer hidden width must divide evenly into even rotary head widths")
+    ff_width = int(hidden * ff_multiplier)
+    if ff_width <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("Transformer feed-forward width must be positive")
+    model = _TransformerSequenceAdapter(
+        hidden,
+        layers,
+        heads,
+        ff_width,
+        context_rows,
+        dropout,
+        checkpoint_blocks,
+        hint_dim,
+        hint_mode,
+        precision_mode,
+        attention_backend,
+    )
+    compile_transformer_blocks(model.blocks, enabled=compile_blocks)
+    return model

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+from attrs import frozen
+
+# One canonical row group is the fixed upper bound; members are never stacked.
+NORMALIZATION_CHUNK_ROWS = 20_000
+NORMALIZATION_STD_FLOOR = 0.001
+# The receipt includes the complete fitting membership (many thousands of rows).
+MAX_CACHE_BYTES = 32_000_000
+ALGORITHM = {
+    "name": "float64_population_moments",
+    "version": 1,
+    "accumulation": "sequence_order_sum_and_square",
+    "chunk_rows": NORMALIZATION_CHUNK_ROWS,
+    "std_floor": NORMALIZATION_STD_FLOOR,
+}
+
+
+@frozen
+class NormalizationMoments:
+    """Resolved FP32 model moments plus the identities used to produce them."""
+
+    mean: np.ndarray
+    std: np.ndarray
+    identity_sha256: str
+    moments_sha256: str
+    sequence_count: int
+
+
+def _canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
+    """Serialize cache identity data with a stable JSON representation."""
+    return json.dumps(
+        value,
+        ensure_ascii=False,
+        sort_keys=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+        allow_nan=False,
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def normalization_identity_sha256(identity: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Hash the exact source, split, scope, and member identity."""
+    return hashlib.sha256(_canonical_json(identity)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def moments_sha256(mean: np.ndarray, std: np.ndarray) -> str:
+    """Hash canonical little-endian FP32 means and scales."""
+    mean32 = np.ascontiguousarray(mean, dtype="<f4")
+    std32 = np.ascontiguousarray(std, dtype="<f4")
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    digest.update(mean32.tobytes(order="C"))
+    digest.update(std32.tobytes(order="C"))
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def compute_population_moments(
+    members: Sequence[tuple[str, int]],
+    reader: Callable[[str, int], np.ndarray],
+    *,
+    feature_count: int = 112,
+) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Accumulate population moments from one source-qualified sequence at a time."""
+    if not members or feature_count < 1:
+        raise ValueError("normalization requires fitting members and a positive feature width")
+    total = np.zeros(feature_count, dtype=np.float64)
+    square = np.zeros(feature_count, dtype=np.float64)
+    count = 0
+    seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
+    for source, group in members:
+        member = (source, int(group))
+        if not isinstance(source, str) or not source or member[1] < 0 or member in seen:
+            raise ValueError("normalization members must be unique source-qualified groups")
+        seen.add(member)
+        features = np.asarray(reader(source, member[1]))
+        if features.ndim != 2 or features.shape[1] != feature_count or features.shape[0] == 0:
+            raise ValueError("normalization input has an unexpected feature shape")
+        for start in range(0, features.shape[0], NORMALIZATION_CHUNK_ROWS):
+            chunk = np.asarray(features[start : start + NORMALIZATION_CHUNK_ROWS], dtype=np.float64)
+            if not np.isfinite(chunk).all():
+                raise ValueError(f"nonfinite normalization input: {source}/{group}")
+            total += chunk.sum(axis=0)
+            square += np.square(chunk).sum(axis=0)
+            count += len(chunk)
+    if count == 0:
+        raise ValueError("normalization has no input rows")
+    mean64 = total / count
+    variance64 = np.maximum(square / count - np.square(mean64), 0.0)
+    std64 = np.sqrt(variance64)
+    std64 = np.maximum(std64, NORMALIZATION_STD_FLOOR)
+    mean = np.ascontiguousarray(mean64.astype(np.float32))
+    std = np.ascontiguousarray(std64.astype(np.float32))
+    if not np.isfinite(mean).all() or not np.isfinite(std).all() or np.any(std <= 0):
+        raise ValueError("normalization moments must be finite FP32 with positive scales")
+    return mean, std
+
+
+def _members_identity(members: Sequence[tuple[str, int]]) -> list[list[object]]:
+    """Validate and encode ordered source-qualified row-group membership."""
+    result: list[list[object]] = []
+    seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
+    for source, group in members:
+        member = (source, int(group))
+        if not isinstance(source, str) or not source or member[1] < 0 or member in seen:
+            raise ValueError("normalization members must be unique source-qualified groups")
+        seen.add(member)
+        result.append([member[0], member[1]])
+    if not result:
+        raise ValueError("full-fit normalization requires at least one fitting member")
+    return result
+
+
+def build_normalization_identity(
+    source_fingerprints: Mapping[str, Any],
+    split_sha256: str,
+    members: Sequence[tuple[str, int]],
+    scope: str,
+    feature_count: int,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build source-bound identity without model size or distributed-world fields."""
+    if scope not in ("prefix", "all_fit"):
+        raise ValueError("unsupported normalization scope")
+    valid_digest = len(split_sha256) == 64 and all(
+        char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in split_sha256
+    )
+    if not valid_digest:
+        raise ValueError("split_sha256 must be a lowercase SHA-256 digest")
+    if feature_count < 1:
+        raise ValueError("normalization feature width must be positive")
+    if not source_fingerprints or any(not isinstance(name, str) for name in source_fingerprints):
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache requires source fingerprints")
+    fingerprints = dict(sorted(source_fingerprints.items()))
+    encoded_members = _members_identity(members)
+    required_sources = {f"datasets/{member[0]}.parquet" for member in encoded_members}
+    if not required_sources.issubset(fingerprints):
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache is missing a fitting-source fingerprint")
+    return {
+        "algorithm": ALGORITHM,
+        "feature_count": feature_count,
+        "normalization_scope": scope,
+        "normalization_members": encoded_members,
+        "normalization_sequence_count": len(encoded_members),
+        "source_fingerprints": fingerprints,
+        "split_sha256": split_sha256,
+    }
+
+
+def _decode_cache(
+    path: Path, identity: dict[str, Any], identity_sha256: str
+) -> NormalizationMoments:
+    """Read and verify one bounded immutable cache record."""
+    size = path.stat().st_size
+    if size <= 0 or size > MAX_CACHE_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache record exceeds its read bound")
+    raw = path.read_bytes()
+    if len(raw) != size:
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache changed while being read")
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(raw)
+    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache is not valid JSON") from error
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict) or set(payload) != {
+        "identity",
+        "identity_sha256",
+        "mean",
+        "std",
+        "moments_sha256",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache schema is invalid")
+    if payload["identity"] != identity or payload["identity_sha256"] != identity_sha256:
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache identity does not match this fitting set")
+    try:
+        mean = np.asarray(payload["mean"], dtype=np.float32)
+        std = np.asarray(payload["std"], dtype=np.float32)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError) as error:
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache moments are not numeric") from error
+    feature_count = int(identity["feature_count"])
+    if mean.shape != (feature_count,) or std.shape != (feature_count,):
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache moment shapes do not match the feature schema")
+    if not np.isfinite(mean).all() or not np.isfinite(std).all() or np.any(std <= 0):
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache moments must be finite with positive scales")
+    digest = moments_sha256(mean, std)
+    if payload["moments_sha256"] != digest:
+        raise ValueError("normalization cache moments SHA-256 mismatch")
+    return NormalizationMoments(
+        np.ascontiguousarray(mean),
+        np.ascontiguousarray(std),
+        identity_sha256,
+        digest,
+        int(identity["normalization_sequence_count"]),
+    )
+
+
+def _write_cache_no_overwrite(path: Path, payload: bytes) -> bool:
+    """Atomically publish a complete cache file without replacing an existing one."""
+    descriptor, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".normalization-", dir=path.parent)
+    temporary = Path(temporary_name)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
+            stream.write(payload)
+            stream.flush()
+            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+        try:
+            os.link(temporary, path)
+        except FileExistsError:
+            return False
+        directory_descriptor = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
+        try:
+            os.fsync(directory_descriptor)
+        finally:
+            os.close(directory_descriptor)
+        return True
+    finally:
+        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def load_or_compute_full_fit_moments(
+    cache_dir: Path,
+    source_fingerprints: Mapping[str, Any],
+    split_sha256: str,
+    members: Sequence[tuple[str, int]],
+    reader: Callable[[str, int], np.ndarray],
+    *,
+    feature_count: int = 112,
+) -> NormalizationMoments:
+    """Reuse or atomically create fitting-only all-fit moments bound to exact ancestry."""
+    identity = build_normalization_identity(
+        source_fingerprints, split_sha256, members, "all_fit", feature_count
+    )
+    identity_sha = normalization_identity_sha256(identity)
+    cache_path = cache_dir / f"{identity_sha}.json"
+    cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if cache_path.exists():
+        return _decode_cache(cache_path, identity, identity_sha)
+    mean, std = compute_population_moments(members, reader, feature_count=feature_count)
+    digest = moments_sha256(mean, std)
+    payload = {
+        "identity": identity,
+        "identity_sha256": identity_sha,
+        "mean": mean.tolist(),
+        "std": std.tolist(),
+        "moments_sha256": digest,
+    }
+    encoded = _canonical_json(payload)
+    _write_cache_no_overwrite(cache_path, encoded)
+    return _decode_cache(cache_path, identity, identity_sha)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ObjectiveNumerators:
+    """Unnormalized local objective sums for one recurrent chunk."""
+
+    label: torch.Tensor
+    distillation: torch.Tensor
+    hints: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def window_denominators(
+    target: torch.Tensor, mask: torch.Tensor, hint_target: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute label and hint denominators before a distributed accumulation window."""
+    clipped = target.float().clamp(-2.0, 2.0)
+    row_mask = mask.to(dtype=torch.float32)
+    label_mass = (clipped.abs() * row_mask[..., None]).sum()
+    hint_mass = row_mask.sum() * hint_target.shape[-1]
+    return torch.stack((label_mass, hint_mass))
+
+
+def objective_numerators(
+    prediction: torch.Tensor,
+    hint_prediction: torch.Tensor,
+    target: torch.Tensor,
+    teacher: torch.Tensor,
+    hint_target: torch.Tensor,
+    mask: torch.Tensor,
+) -> ObjectiveNumerators:
+    """Return clipped weighted label/KD sums and a masked elementwise hint sum."""
+    clipped = target.float().clamp(-2.0, 2.0)
+    weight = clipped.abs() * mask.to(dtype=torch.float32)[..., None]
+    label_error = prediction.float() - clipped
+    teacher_error = prediction.float() - teacher.float().clamp(-2.0, 2.0)
+    hint_error = hint_prediction.float() - hint_target.float()
+    hint_weight = mask.to(dtype=torch.float32)[..., None]
+    return ObjectiveNumerators(
+        (label_error.square() * weight).sum(),
+        (teacher_error.square() * weight).sum(),
+        (hint_error.square() * hint_weight).sum(),
+    )
+
+
+def scaled_objective(
+    numerators: ObjectiveNumerators,
+    denominators: torch.Tensor,
+    world_size: int,
+    kd_weight: float,
+    hint_weight: float,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Scale local sums for DDP's gradient averaging across the full window."""
+    label_denom = float(denominators[0].item())
+    hint_denom = float(denominators[1].item())
+    label_scale = world_size / label_denom if label_denom > 0 else 0.0
+    hint_scale = world_size / hint_denom if hint_denom > 0 else 0.0
+    return (
+        numerators.label * label_scale
+        + numerators.distillation * (kd_weight * label_scale)
+        + numerators.hints * (hint_weight * hint_scale)
+    )
+
+
+def detached_sums(
+    numerators: ObjectiveNumerators, target: torch.Tensor, mask: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pack chunk numerators and valid-row count for epoch telemetry reductions."""
+    rows = mask.sum(dtype=torch.float64)
+    return torch.stack(
+        (
+            numerators.label.detach().double(),
+            numerators.distillation.detach().double(),
+            numerators.hints.detach().double(),
+            rows,
+            torch.tensor(float(target.shape[0] * target.shape[1]), device=target.device),
+        )
+    )

+"""Strict-FP32 Muon groups for causal Transformer sequence fits."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import re
+from collections import defaultdict
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from wnn.optim import MuonAdamW
+
+_QKV_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^blocks\.(\d+)\.qkv\.weight$")
+_MUON_ROLES: dict[str, int] = {
+    "muon_qkv": 3,
+    "muon_hidden": 1,
+}
+
+
+def _parameter_role(name: str, parameter: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[str, bool]:
+    """Assign a named Transformer parameter to a semantic optimizer group."""
+    if _QKV_PATTERN.fullmatch(name):
+        return "muon_qkv", True
+    if re.fullmatch(r"blocks\.\d+\.(attention_output|feedforward_(in|out))\.weight", name):
+        return "muon_hidden", True
+    if any(
+        marker in name
+        for marker in ("output_norm.", ".norm_attention.", ".norm_feedforward.", ".normalizer.")
+    ):
+        return "adamw_no_decay", False
+    if name.startswith("blocks.") and name.endswith(".weight"):
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported trainable Transformer block matrix {name}")
+    if parameter.ndim <= 1 or name.endswith(".bias"):
+        return "adamw_no_decay", False
+    return "adamw_matrix", True
+
+
+def _group_specs(model: nn.Module) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+    """Build ordered groups with exact trainable-parameter ownership."""
+    blocks = getattr(model, "blocks", None)
+    if not isinstance(blocks, nn.ModuleList) or not len(blocks):
+        raise ValueError("sequence Muon requires a Transformer model with nonempty blocks")
+    named_parameters = [
+        (name, parameter) for name, parameter in model.named_parameters() if parameter.requires_grad
+    ]
+    if not named_parameters:
+        raise ValueError("sequence model has no trainable parameters")
+
+    roles: dict[str, list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor, bool]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    qkv_indices: set[int] = set()
+    muon_names: set[str] = set()
+    for name, parameter in named_parameters:
+        match = _QKV_PATTERN.fullmatch(name)
+        role, decay_enabled = _parameter_role(name, parameter)
+        if match:
+            block_index = int(match.group(1))
+            qkv_indices.add(block_index)
+            if parameter.ndim != 2 or parameter.shape[0] != 3 * parameter.shape[1]:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must stack three square D-by-D projection matrices")
+        if role in _MUON_ROLES and parameter.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"Muon parameter {name} must be a matrix")
+        if role in _MUON_ROLES:
+            muon_names.add(name)
+        roles[role].append((name, parameter, decay_enabled))
+    if qkv_indices != set(range(len(blocks))):
+        raise ValueError("every Transformer block must expose a trainable qkv.weight matrix")
+    expected_muon_names = {
+        f"blocks.{index}.{suffix}.weight"
+        for index in range(len(blocks))
+        for suffix in (
+            "qkv",
+            "attention_output",
+            "feedforward_in",
+            "feedforward_out",
+        )
+    }
+    if muon_names != expected_muon_names:
+        raise ValueError("every Transformer block must expose the declared Muon matrix groups")
+
+    expected_ids = {id(parameter) for _, parameter in named_parameters}
+    owned_ids = [id(parameter) for entries in roles.values() for _, parameter, _ in entries]
+    if len(owned_ids) != len(set(owned_ids)) or set(owned_ids) != expected_ids:
+        raise ValueError("sequence Muon groups must own every trainable parameter exactly once")
+
+    specs: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    role_order = (*_MUON_ROLES, "adamw_matrix", "adamw_no_decay")
+    for role in role_order:
+        entries = roles.get(role, [])
+        if not entries:
+            continue
+        muon = role in _MUON_ROLES
+        decay_enabled = entries[0][2]
+        if any(entry[2] != decay_enabled for entry in entries):
+            raise ValueError(f"optimizer role {role} has inconsistent weight-decay policy")
+        specs.append(
+            {
+                "params": [parameter for _, parameter, _ in entries],
+                "param_names": [name for name, _, _ in entries],
+                "role": role,
+                "group_name": role,
+                "optimizer_implementation": "wnn.optim.MuonAdamW",
+                "optimizer_group_schema": "wnn.sequence-muon-group.v1",
+                "muon": muon,
+                "blocks": _MUON_ROLES.get(role, 1),
+                "weight_decay_enabled": decay_enabled,
+                "strict_fp32": True,
+            }
+        )
+    spec_ids = [id(parameter) for group in specs for parameter in group["params"]]
+    if len(spec_ids) != len(set(spec_ids)) or set(spec_ids) != expected_ids:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "sequence optimizer groups must own every trainable parameter exactly once"
+        )
+    return specs
+
+
+def build_sequence_muon_optimizer(model: nn.Module, config: Mapping[str, object]) -> MuonAdamW:
+    """Create one resumable Muon/AdamW optimizer for a strict-FP32 Transformer.
+
+    Args:
+        model: A built sequence Transformer with named causal attention blocks.
+        config: Validated sequence recipe with Muon, AdamW, and shared learning-rate settings.
+
+    Returns:
+        A ``MuonAdamW`` instance whose parameter groups record roles and names in state dictionaries.
+
+    Raises:
+        TypeError: If a configured optimizer value has the wrong type.
+        ValueError: If the model groups or optimizer settings are invalid.
+    """
+    learning_rate = _positive_number(config, "lr")
+    weight_decay = _nonnegative_number(config, "weight_decay")
+    muon_momentum = _unit_interval(config, "muon_momentum")
+    adamw_beta1 = _unit_interval(config, "adamw_beta1")
+    adamw_beta2 = _unit_interval(config, "adamw_beta2")
+    adamw_eps = _positive_number(config, "adamw_eps")
+    ns_eps = _positive_number(config, "muon_ns_eps")
+    ns_steps = config.get("muon_ns_steps")
+    if type(ns_steps) is not int or ns_steps < 1:
+        raise ValueError("muon_ns_steps must be a positive integer")
+    model_config = config.get("model")
+    if not isinstance(model_config, Mapping):
+        raise TypeError("sequence Muon config requires a model mapping")
+    if model_config.get("architecture") != "transformer":
+        raise ValueError("sequence Muon is scoped to Transformer models")
+
+    groups = _group_specs(model)
+    for group in groups:
+        role = str(group["role"])
+        muon = bool(group["muon"])
+        group.update(
+            lr=learning_rate,
+            weight_decay=weight_decay if group["weight_decay_enabled"] else 0.0,
+            betas=(muon_momentum, muon_momentum) if muon else (adamw_beta1, adamw_beta2),
+            eps=adamw_eps,
+            ns_steps=ns_steps,
+            ns_eps=ns_eps,
+            rms=0.2,
+            optimizer_role=role,
+        )
+    return MuonAdamW(
+        groups,
+        lr=learning_rate,
+        betas=(adamw_beta1, adamw_beta2),
+        eps=adamw_eps,
+        weight_decay=weight_decay,
+        ns_steps=ns_steps,
+        rms=0.2,
+        strict_fp32=True,
+        ns_eps=ns_eps,
+    )
+
+
+def _number(config: Mapping[str, object], name: str) -> float:
+    """Read one finite numeric optimizer setting while rejecting booleans."""
+    value = config.get(name)
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be numeric")
+    result = float(value)
+    if not math.isfinite(result):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
+    return result
+
+
+def _positive_number(config: Mapping[str, object], name: str) -> float:
+    """Read one finite, strictly positive optimizer setting."""
+    value = _number(config, name)
+    if value <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive")
+    return value
+
+
+def _nonnegative_number(config: Mapping[str, object], name: str) -> float:
+    """Read one finite, nonnegative optimizer setting."""
+    value = _number(config, name)
+    if value < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonnegative")
+    return value
+
+
+def _unit_interval(config: Mapping[str, object], name: str) -> float:
+    """Read one finite optimizer coefficient in the open unit interval."""
+    value = _number(config, name)
+    if not 0 <= value < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be in [0, 1)")
+    return value

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+import torch
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_provenance import json_value
+
+
+def optimizer_learning_rates(optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer) -> dict[str, float]:
+    """Name every actual hybrid group instead of labelling all rates AdamW."""
+    return {
+        str(group.get("group_name", f"group_{index}")): float(group["lr"])
+        for index, group in enumerate(optimizer.param_groups)
+    }
+
+
+def optimizer_contract(
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer, config: Mapping[str, object], total_updates: int
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Bind actual parameter groups and the full update schedule into run identity."""
+    groups: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    fields = (
+        "group_name",
+        "role",
+        "param_names",
+        "muon",
+        "blocks",
+        "lr",
+        "initial_lr",
+        "weight_decay",
+        "betas",
+        "eps",
+        "ns_steps",
+        "rms",
+        "ns_eps",
+        "strict_fp32",
+    )
+    for index, group in enumerate(optimizer.param_groups):
+        record = {field: json_value(group[field]) for field in fields if field in group}
+        record["group_name"] = str(group.get("group_name", f"group_{index}"))
+        record["parameter_count"] = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in group["params"])
+        record["matrix_update_scale"] = (

+        "groups": groups,
+        "total_updates": total_updates,
+        "warmup_updates": min(
+            total_updates, math.ceil(total_updates * float(config["warmup_fraction"]))
+        ),
+        "schedule": str(config.get("schedule", "legacy_warmup_cosine")),
+        "peak_lr": float(config["lr"]),
+        "min_lr_ratio": float(config.get("min_lr_ratio", 0.0)),

+"""Explicit sequence-model precision controls with process identity binding.
+
+The default path uses IEEE FP32. BF16 autocast is scoped to model computation;
+cuBLAS emulation is process-wide and may also affect Muon matrix operations.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from contextlib import AbstractContextManager, nullcontext
+from typing import Literal
+
+import torch
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_compile import COMPILER_RECOMPILE_LIMIT
+
+PrecisionMode = Literal["fp32", "tf32", "bf16", "fp32_bf16x9", "bf16_bf16x9"]
+PRECISION_MODES = ("fp32", "tf32", "bf16", "fp32_bf16x9", "bf16_bf16x9")
+EMULATION_ENV = "CUBLAS_EMULATE_SINGLE_PRECISION"
+
+
+def validate_process_environment(mode: str, environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> str | None:
+    """Fail closed when process-wide cuBLAS emulation disagrees with the mode."""
+    if mode not in PRECISION_MODES:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported sequence precision mode: {mode!r}")
+    environment = os.environ if environ is None else environ
+    value = environment.get(EMULATION_ENV)
+    if mode in ("fp32_bf16x9", "bf16_bf16x9"):
+        if value != "1":
+            raise ValueError(f"{EMULATION_ENV}=1 is required for {mode}")
+    elif value not in (None, "0"):
+        raise ValueError(f"{EMULATION_ENV} must be unset or 0 for {mode}")
+    return value
+
+
+def configure_precision_mode(mode: str) -> None:
+    """Validate process identity and reset global PyTorch precision flags to FP32."""
+    validate_process_environment(mode)
+    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
+    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
+    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
+
+
+def _tf32_context() -> AbstractContextManager[None]:
+    """Enable TF32 only for the dynamic extent of one model forward or backward."""
+
+    class _Context:
+        def __enter__(self) -> None:
+            self.precision = torch.get_float32_matmul_precision()
+            self.matmul_tf32 = torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32
+            self.cudnn_tf32 = torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32
+            torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("high")
+            torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True
+            torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = True
+            return None
+
+        def __exit__(self, exc_type: object, exc: object, traceback: object) -> None:
+            torch.set_float32_matmul_precision(self.precision)
+            torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = self.matmul_tf32
+            torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = self.cudnn_tf32
+
+    return _Context()
+
+
+def forward_context(mode: str, device_type: str = "cuda") -> AbstractContextManager[object]:
+    """Return the precision context for one model forward call."""
+    if mode in ("bf16", "bf16_bf16x9"):
+        return torch.autocast(device_type=device_type, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    if mode == "tf32":
+        return _tf32_context()
+    if mode in ("fp32", "fp32_bf16x9"):
+        return nullcontext()
+    raise ValueError(f"unsupported sequence precision mode: {mode!r}")
+
+
+def backward_context(mode: str, device_type: str = "cuda") -> AbstractContextManager[object]:
+    """Return a model-backward context; autocast is intentionally absent for BF16."""
+    if mode == "tf32":
+        return _tf32_context()
+    if mode in ("fp32", "bf16", "fp32_bf16x9", "bf16_bf16x9"):
+        return nullcontext()
+    raise ValueError(f"unsupported sequence precision mode: {mode!r}")
+
+
+def checkpoint_context_fn(
+    mode: str, device_type: str = "cuda"
+) -> tuple[AbstractContextManager[object], AbstractContextManager[object]]:
+    """Provide matching precision contexts to non-reentrant checkpoint regions."""
+    if mode in ("bf16", "bf16_bf16x9"):
+        return forward_context(mode, device_type), forward_context(mode, device_type)
+    if mode in ("fp32", "tf32", "fp32_bf16x9"):
+        return nullcontext(), nullcontext()
+    raise ValueError(f"unsupported sequence precision mode: {mode!r}")
+
+
+def validate_forward_state(mode: str, device_type: str = "cuda") -> None:
+    """Check that model execution is inside the selected forward precision scope."""
+    autocast = torch.is_autocast_enabled(device_type)
+    if mode in ("bf16", "bf16_bf16x9"):
+        if not autocast or torch.get_autocast_dtype(device_type) != torch.bfloat16:
+            raise RuntimeError("bf16 mode requires a bfloat16 autocast model-forward context")
+        if (
+            torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32
+            or torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32
+            or torch.get_float32_matmul_precision() != "highest"
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("bf16 mode requires TF32 controls to remain disabled")
+        return
+    if autocast:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{mode} mode requires autocast to be disabled")
+    if mode == "tf32":
+        if (
+            not torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32
+            or not torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32
+            or torch.get_float32_matmul_precision() != "high"
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("tf32 mode requires its scoped matmul controls")
+        return
+    if mode in ("fp32", "fp32_bf16x9"):
+        if (

+    model = config.get("model")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from wnn.data import SEQUENCE_LENGTH
+from wnn.splits import file_sha256, load_campaign_split
+from wnn.training.sequence_data import SequenceRecords
+from wnn.training.sequence_models import build_sequence_model
+from wnn.training.sequence_precision import forward_context
+
+# Checkpoint payloads contain tensors and JSON-compatible provenance, validated on load.
+
+
+def load_endpoint(checkpoint: Path, device: torch.device) -> tuple[torch.nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load only a completed fixed-final endpoint with explicit FP32 ancestry."""
+    payload = torch.load(checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+    if payload.get("checkpoint_schema") != "wnn.sequence-fit.v1":
+        raise ValueError("unsupported endpoint; native/legacy weights require an explicit adapter")
+    config = payload["config"]
+    if payload["completed_epochs"] != config["epochs"] or payload["epoch"] != config["epochs"] - 1:
+        raise ValueError("cache/score requires the fixed-final completed checkpoint")
+    for name, value in payload["model"].items():
+        if value.is_floating_point() and (
+            value.dtype != torch.float32 or not torch.isfinite(value).all()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid strict-FP32 checkpoint tensor: {name}")
+    model = build_sequence_model(config["model"])
+    model.load_state_dict(payload["model"], strict=True)
+    return model.to(device).eval(), payload
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def predict_sequence(
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    chunk_rows: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Reset once per sequence, forward every warm-up row, and carry bounded causal state."""
+    state = None
+    outputs = []
+    precision_mode = str(getattr(model, "precision_mode", "fp32"))
+    for start in range(0, len(x), chunk_rows):
+        with forward_context(precision_mode, device.type):
+            prediction, hints, state = model(
+                x[start : start + chunk_rows].unsqueeze(0).to(device), state
+            )
+        outputs.append(torch.cat((prediction.float(), hints.float()), -1).squeeze(0).cpu().numpy())
+    values = np.concatenate(outputs).astype(np.float32, copy=False)
+    if not np.isfinite(values).all():
+        raise ValueError("nonfinite endpoint output")
+    return values
+
+
+def _producer(checkpoint: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    data = payload["data"]
+    return {
+        "checkpoint_sha256": file_sha256(checkpoint),
+        "split_sha256": data["split_sha256"],
+        "fit_members": data["fit_members"],
+        "teacher": data["teacher"],
+        "config": payload["config"],
+        "provenance": payload["provenance"],
+    }
+
+
+def export_predictions(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    """Export disjoint rank shards, publishing a complete manifest only after all ranks finish."""
+    # Import the shared runtime here to keep all precision policy in one implementation.
+    from wnn.training.sequence_distributed import (
+        collective_output_setup,
+        initialize_distributed,
+    )
+
+    runtime = initialize_distributed()
+    device, rank, world = runtime.device, runtime.rank, runtime.world_size
+    split = load_campaign_split(args.split_manifest, args.data_root)
+    model, payload = load_endpoint(args.checkpoint, device)
+    if payload["data"]["split_sha256"] != split.sha256:
+        raise ValueError("endpoint does not exclude this evaluation fold")
+    fitting = [("train", g) for g in split.train_groups] + [
+        ("valid", g) for g in split.valid_groups
+    ]
+    if payload["data"]["fit_members"] != [list(member) for member in fitting]:
+        raise ValueError("endpoint fitting membership is not this source-qualified split")
+    members = (
+        fitting if args.membership == "fit" else [("valid", g) for g in split.evaluation_groups]
+    )
+    collective_output_setup(args.output, False, runtime)
+    if world > 1:
+        dist.barrier()
+    dataset = SequenceRecords(args.data_root, members, 0)
+    entries = []
+    for index in range(rank, len(dataset), world):
+        source, group = members[index]
+        values = predict_sequence(
+            model, dataset[index]["x"], payload["config"]["chunk_rows"], device
+        )
+        if args.membership == "evaluation":
+            values = values[:, :2].copy()
+        name = f"{source}-{group}.npy"
+        target = args.output / name
+        temporary = args.output / f"{name}.partial"
+        with temporary.open("xb") as stream:
+            np.save(stream, values, allow_pickle=False)
+        temporary.replace(target)
+        entries.append(
+            {"split": source, "row_group": group, "file": name, "sha256": file_sha256(target)}
+        )
+    part = args.output / f"rank-{rank}.json"
+    part.write_text(json.dumps(entries, sort_keys=True))
+    if world > 1:
+        dist.barrier()
+    if rank == 0:
+        all_entries = [
+            entry
+            for worker in range(world)
+            for entry in json.loads((args.output / f"rank-{worker}.json").read_text())
+        ]
+        entry_map = {(entry["split"], entry["row_group"]): entry for entry in all_entries}
+        if len(all_entries) != len(members) or set(entry_map) != set(members):
+            raise ValueError("missing or duplicate export shards")
+        manifest = {
+            "schema": "sequence-teacher-cache-v1"
+            if args.membership == "fit"
+            else "sequence-predictions-v1",
+            "complete": True,
+            "input_schema": "raw112-v1",
+            "membership": args.membership,
+            "split_sha256": split.sha256,
+            "hint_dim": payload["config"]["model"]["hint_dim"] if args.membership == "fit" else 0,
+            "sequence_length": SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
+            "producer": _producer(args.checkpoint, payload),
+            "world_size": world,
+            "sequences": [entry_map[member] for member in members],
+        }
+        temporary = args.output / "manifest.json.partial"
+        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
+        temporary.replace(args.output / "manifest.json")
+    if world > 1:
+        dist.barrier()
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Export complete fitting-only KD targets or held-out predictions on allocated GPUs."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--data-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--split-manifest", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--membership", choices=("fit", "evaluation"), required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1")) < 1:
+        parser.error("invalid distributed world size")
+    export_predictions(args)

+
+from wnn.research_reporting import RunRecorder
+from wnn.training.sequence_checkpoint import atomic_write_json

+    DistributedContext,
+    all_ranks_true,
+    barrier,
+    coordinated_call,
+)
