+    SequenceDataset,
+    optimizer_states_are_finite_fp32,
+)
+from wnn.training.sequence_loop import train_epoch
+
+
+def _write_profile_receipt(receipt: dict[str, object], path: Path) -> bool:
+    """Write one immutable profile receipt and return a coordination sentinel."""
+    atomic_write_json(receipt, path)
+    return True
+
+
+def run_profile(
+    dataset: SequenceDataset,
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    scheduler: torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR,
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    context: DistributedContext,
+    rank_log: RankJsonlLog,
+    recorder: RunRecorder | None,
+    identity: dict[str, object],
+    output: Path,
+    profile_updates: int,
+    max_updates: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Run bounded real-data updates and emit an unapproved engineering-only receipt."""
+    if not 1 <= profile_updates <= max_updates:
+        raise ValueError("--profile-updates must be within the configured full-fit update budget")
+    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(context.device)
+    started = time.perf_counter()
+    updates, epochs_seen = 0, 0
+    totals = torch.zeros(8, dtype=torch.float64, device=context.device)
+    while updates < profile_updates and epochs_seen < int(config["epochs"]):
+        result = train_epoch(
+            dataset,
+            model,
+            optimizer,
+            scheduler,
+            config,
+            context,
+            rank_log,
+            epochs_seen,
+            updates,
+            profile_updates - updates,
+        )
+        updates += result.updates
+        totals += result.totals
+        epochs_seen += int(result.complete)
+        if result.updates == 0:
+            break
+    optimizer_finite = all_ranks_true(optimizer_states_are_finite_fp32(optimizer), context)
+    errors = [] if optimizer_finite else ["optimizer state is not finite strict-FP32"]
+    valid_rows = int(totals[3].item())
+    forwarded_rows = int(totals[4].item())
+    real_rows = int(totals[5].item())
+    complete = updates == profile_updates and not errors
+    local_memory = {
+        "rank": context.rank,
+        "peak_allocated_bytes": int(torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(context.device)),
+        "peak_reserved_bytes": int(torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(context.device)),
+        "device_total_memory_bytes": int(
+            torch.cuda.get_device_properties(context.local_rank).total_memory
+        ),
+        "host_peak_rss_bytes": _host_peak_rss_bytes(),
+    }
+    if context.process_group:
+        memory_by_rank: list[dict[str, int] | None] = [None] * context.world_size
+        dist.all_gather_object(memory_by_rank, local_memory)
+        memory = [item for item in memory_by_rank if item is not None]
+    else:
+        memory = [local_memory]
+    if len(memory) != context.world_size:
+        raise RuntimeError("profile resource receipt is missing a torchrun rank")
+    memory.sort(key=lambda item: item["rank"])
+    label_denom, hint_denom = float(totals[6].item()), float(totals[7].item())
+    label_loss = float(totals[0].item()) / label_denom if label_denom > 0 else 0.0
+    kd_loss = float(totals[1].item()) / label_denom if label_denom > 0 else 0.0
+    hint_loss = float(totals[2].item()) / hint_denom if hint_denom > 0 else 0.0
+    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
+    if updates != profile_updates:
+        errors.append("profile stopped before its requested optimizer update count")
+        complete = False
+    if min(valid_rows, forwarded_rows, real_rows) <= 0 or forwarded_rows < real_rows:
+        errors.append("profile did not produce positive, internally consistent work counts")
+        complete = False
+    if updates < 1 or elapsed <= 0:
+        errors.append("profile did not produce positive optimizer work and elapsed time")
+        complete = False
+    receipt = {
+        "receipt_schema": "wnn.sequence-profile.v1",
+        "status": "profile_complete" if complete else "profile_incomplete",
+        "approved": False,
+        "identity": identity,
+        "updates": updates,
+        "epochs_traversed": epochs_seen,
+        "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
+        "forwarded_rows": forwarded_rows,
+        "real_rows": real_rows,
+        "valid_rows": valid_rows,
+        "losses": {
+            "label": label_loss,
+            "distillation": kd_loss,
+            "hint": hint_loss,
+            "total": label_loss
+            + float(config["kd_weight"]) * kd_loss
+            + float(config["hint_weight"]) * hint_loss,
+        },
+        "model_parameters": identity["model_parameters"],
+        "memory_by_rank": memory,
+        "peak_memory_bytes": max(item["peak_allocated_bytes"] for item in memory),
+        "peak_reserved_bytes": max(item["peak_reserved_bytes"] for item in memory),
+        "device_total_memory_bytes": [item["device_total_memory_bytes"] for item in memory],
+        "host_peak_rss_bytes": [item["host_peak_rss_bytes"] for item in memory],
+        "errors": errors,
+        "error_count": len(errors),
+        "scientific_checkpoint_written": False,
+        "approval_note": "Review the engineering evidence and set approved=true before a full fit.",
+    }
+    coordinated_call(
+        lambda: (
+            _write_profile_receipt(receipt, output / "profile_receipt.json")
+            if context.is_primary
+            else True
+        ),
+        "profile receipt write",
+        context,
+    )
+    barrier(context)
+    coordinated_call(
+        lambda: (
+            _record_profile_metrics(
+                recorder,
+                config,
+                updates,
+                elapsed,
+                label_loss,
+                kd_loss,
+                hint_loss,
+                valid_rows,
+                forwarded_rows,
+            )
+            if context.is_primary and recorder is not None
+            else True
+        ),
+        "profile metrics record",
+        context,
+    )
+    if not complete:
+        raise RuntimeError("profile failed its requested work or optimizer-state checks")
+
+
+def _host_peak_rss_bytes() -> int:
+    """Normalize the platform-specific resource.ru_maxrss unit to bytes."""
+    value = int(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
+    return value if sys.platform == "darwin" else value * 1024
+
+
+def _record_profile_metrics(
+    recorder: RunRecorder | None,
+    config: dict[str, Any],
+    updates: int,
+    elapsed: float,
+    label_loss: float,
+    kd_loss: float,
+    hint_loss: float,
+    valid_rows: int,
+    forwarded_rows: int,
+) -> bool:
+    """Record one bounded engineering profile summary in repository run metadata."""
+    if recorder is None:
+        return True
+    recorder.record_metrics(
+        step=updates,
+        epoch=0,
+        loss=label_loss
+        + float(config["kd_weight"]) * kd_loss
+        + float(config["hint_weight"]) * hint_loss,
+        throughput={
+            "valid_rows_per_second": valid_rows / max(elapsed, 1e-12),
+            "forwarded_rows_per_second": forwarded_rows / max(elapsed, 1e-12),
+        },
+        timing={"profile_seconds": elapsed},
+    )
+    return True

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import platform
+import subprocess
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from wnn.research_reporting import RunMetadata, RunRecorder
+from wnn.training.sequence_distributed import DistributedContext
+from wnn.training.sequence_precision import runtime_precision_identity
+
+
+def json_value(value: object) -> object:
+    """Normalize supported provenance values into deterministic JSON data."""
+    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, bool, int, float)):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, Path):
+        return str(value)
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        if not all(isinstance(key, str) for key in value):
+            raise TypeError("provenance object keys must be strings")
+        return {str(key): json_value(item) for key, item in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
+        return [json_value(item) for item in value]
+    scalar = getattr(value, "item", None)
+    if callable(scalar):
+        return json_value(scalar())
+    raise TypeError(f"unsupported provenance value: {type(value).__name__}")
+
+
+def canonical_sha256(value: object) -> str:
+    """Hash a normalized JSON value using a stable key and whitespace policy."""
+    encoded = json.dumps(
+        json_value(value),
+        ensure_ascii=False,
+        sort_keys=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+        allow_nan=False,
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+
+
+def file_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash a file in bounded blocks without loading its payload into memory."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def source_identity(source_root: Path, entrypoint: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Hash every source file under src plus the public entrypoint for exact resume."""
+    root = source_root.resolve()
+    paths = sorted((root / "src").rglob("*.py"))
+    resolved_entrypoint = entrypoint.resolve()
+    if resolved_entrypoint not in paths:
+        paths.append(resolved_entrypoint)
+    files = {path.relative_to(root).as_posix(): file_sha256(path) for path in paths}
+    return {"sha256": canonical_sha256(files), "files": files}
+
+
+def _local_runtime_identity(context: DistributedContext) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Capture strict-FP32 software, device, and process identity before fitting."""
+    properties = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(context.local_rank)
+    driver_result = subprocess.run(
+        ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=driver_version", "--format=csv,noheader"],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    driver_versions = {line.strip() for line in driver_result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()}
+    if len(driver_versions) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError("could not establish one NVIDIA driver identity")
+    raw_uuid = getattr(properties, "uuid", None)
+    device_uuid = None
+    if raw_uuid is not None:
+        device_uuid = raw_uuid.decode("utf-8") if isinstance(raw_uuid, bytes) else str(raw_uuid)
+    return {
+        "python": platform.python_version(),
+        "platform": platform.platform(),
+        "torch": str(torch.__version__),
+        "cuda_runtime": torch.version.cuda,
+        "cudnn": torch.backends.cudnn.version(),
+        "nvidia_driver": driver_versions.pop(),
+        "device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(context.local_rank),
+        "capability": [properties.major, properties.minor],
+        "device_uuid": device_uuid,
+        "device_total_memory_bytes": int(properties.total_memory),
+        "visible_devices": torch.cuda.device_count(),
+        "world_size": context.world_size,
+        "rank": context.rank,
+        "local_rank": context.local_rank,
+        "matmul_precision": torch.get_float32_matmul_precision(),
+        "matmul_tf32": torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32,
+        "cudnn_tf32": torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32,
+        "autocast": False,
+        "amp_scaler": False,
+        "cublas_workspace_config": os.environ.get("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG"),
+    }
+
+
+def runtime_identity(context: DistributedContext) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Collect identical software and per-rank device metadata on every worker."""
+    local: dict[str, object] | None = None
+    local_error: str | None = None
+    try:
+        local = _local_runtime_identity(context)
+    except Exception as error:
+        local_error = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
+    if context.process_group:
+        gathered: list[tuple[dict[str, object] | None, str | None]] = [
+            (None, None)
+        ] * context.world_size
+        dist.all_gather_object(gathered, (local, local_error))
+        failures = [f"rank {rank}: {error}" for rank, (_, error) in enumerate(gathered) if error]
+        if failures:
+            raise RuntimeError("could not collect runtime identity: " + "; ".join(failures))
+        workers = [identity for identity, _ in gathered if identity is not None]
+    else:
+        if local is None or local_error is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"could not collect runtime identity: {local_error or 'empty result'}"
+            )
+        workers = [local]
+    if len(workers) != context.world_size:
+        raise RuntimeError("could not collect runtime identity from every rank")
+    common_fields = (
+        ("python", "platform", "torch", "cuda_runtime", "cudnn", "nvidia_driver")
+        + ("visible_devices", "world_size", "matmul_precision", "matmul_tf32", "cudnn_tf32")
+        + ("autocast", "amp_scaler", "cublas_workspace_config")
+    )
+    baseline = workers[0]
+    if any(
+        any(worker.get(field) != baseline.get(field) for field in common_fields)
+        for worker in workers
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("torchrun workers disagree on their runtime precision identity")
+    devices = [
+        {
+            "rank": worker["rank"],
+            "local_rank": worker["local_rank"],
+            "name": worker["device"],
+            "capability": worker["capability"],
+            "uuid": worker["device_uuid"],
+            "total_memory_bytes": worker["device_total_memory_bytes"],
+        }
+        for worker in sorted(workers, key=lambda item: int(item["rank"]))
+    ]
+    return {field: baseline[field] for field in common_fields} | {"devices": devices}
+
+
+def run_identity(
+    config: dict[str, object],
+    data_provenance: Mapping[str, object],
+    source: dict[str, object],
+    runtime: dict[str, object],
+    world_size: int,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Bind configuration, supplied data/teacher, source, runtime, and exact rank count."""
+    data_value = json_value(data_provenance)
+    return {
+        "schema": "wnn.sequence-run-identity.v1",
+        "config_sha256": canonical_sha256(config),
+        "data_sha256": canonical_sha256(data_value),
+        "data": data_value,
+        "source_sha256": source["sha256"],
+        "source_files": source["files"],
+        "runtime": runtime_precision_identity(config, runtime),
+        "world_size": world_size,
+    }
+
+
+def assert_same_identity(identity: dict[str, object], context: DistributedContext) -> None:
+    """Reject rank-local config, data, or source differences before any optimization."""
+    digest = canonical_sha256(identity)
+    if not context.process_group:
+        return
+    hashes: list[str | None] = [None] * context.world_size
+    dist.all_gather_object(hashes, digest)
+    if any(value != digest for value in hashes):
+        raise RuntimeError("torchrun ranks disagree on the source-qualified run identity")
+
+
+def recorder_for_run(
+    output: Path,
+    config: dict[str, object],
+    identity: dict[str, object],
+) -> RunRecorder:
+    """Initialize the repository's immutable run metadata and append-only metrics."""
+    metadata = RunMetadata(
+        source={"sha256": identity["source_sha256"], "files": identity["source_files"]},
+        config=json_value(config),
+        provenance={
+            "data_sha256": identity["data_sha256"],
+            "data": identity["data"],
+            "runtime": identity["runtime"],
+            "world_size": identity["world_size"],
+            "model_parameters": identity.get("model_parameters"),
+        },
+    )
+    return RunRecorder(output, metadata)
+
+
+def validate_profile_receipt(path: Path, identity: dict[str, object]) -> str:
+    """Require a manually approved engineering profile with exact fit identities."""
+    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError("profile receipt must contain a JSON object")
+    if value.get("receipt_schema") != "wnn.sequence-profile.v1":
+        raise ValueError("unsupported engineering profile receipt")
+    if value.get("status") != "profile_complete" or value.get("approved") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("full fitting requires an explicitly approved completed profile receipt")
+    if value.get("identity") != identity:
+        raise ValueError("profile receipt config/data/source/runtime identity does not match")
+    for name in ("updates", "forwarded_rows", "real_rows", "valid_rows"):
+        if not _positive_integer(value.get(name)):
+            raise ValueError(f"profile receipt {name} must be a positive integer")
+    epochs = value.get("epochs_traversed")
+    if not isinstance(epochs, int) or isinstance(epochs, bool) or epochs < 0:
+        raise ValueError("profile completed-epoch count must be a nonnegative integer")
+    if value["forwarded_rows"] < value["real_rows"] or value["valid_rows"] > value["real_rows"]:
+        raise ValueError("profile work counts are internally inconsistent")
+    if not _finite_nonnegative(value.get("elapsed_seconds")) or value["elapsed_seconds"] <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("profile receipt elapsed time must be finite and positive")
+    if value.get("scientific_checkpoint_written") is not False:
+        raise ValueError("engineering profiles must not write a scientific checkpoint")
+    errors = value.get("errors")
+    if errors != [] or value.get("error_count") != 0:
+        raise ValueError("profile receipt must have no runtime errors")
+    losses = value.get("losses")
+    if not isinstance(losses, dict) or set(losses) != {"label", "distillation", "hint", "total"}:
+        raise ValueError("profile receipt is missing its objective summary")
+    if not all(_finite_nonnegative(loss) for loss in losses.values()):
+        raise ValueError("profile losses must be finite and nonnegative")
+    if value.get("model_parameters") != identity.get("model_parameters"):
+        raise ValueError("profile model parameter count does not match this fit")
+    memory = value.get("memory_by_rank")
+    world_size = identity.get("world_size")
+    if not isinstance(world_size, int) or isinstance(world_size, bool):
+        raise ValueError("run identity has an invalid world size")
+    if not isinstance(memory, list) or len(memory) != world_size:
+        raise ValueError("profile receipt must record memory metrics for every rank")
+    if [item.get("rank") for item in memory if isinstance(item, dict)] != list(range(world_size)):
+        raise ValueError("profile resource records are missing or misordered by rank")
+    memory_fields = (
+        "peak_allocated_bytes",
+        "peak_reserved_bytes",
+        "device_total_memory_bytes",
+        "host_peak_rss_bytes",
+    )
+    for item in memory:
+        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not all(
+            _positive_integer(item.get(field)) for field in memory_fields
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("profile resource values must be positive integer byte counts")
+        if item["peak_allocated_bytes"] > item["peak_reserved_bytes"]:
+            raise ValueError("profile allocated memory cannot exceed reserved memory")
+        if item["peak_reserved_bytes"] > item["device_total_memory_bytes"]:
+            raise ValueError("profile reserved memory cannot exceed total device memory")
+    runtime = identity.get("runtime")
+    if isinstance(runtime, dict) and "devices" in runtime:
+        devices = runtime["devices"]
+        if not isinstance(devices, list) or len(devices) != world_size:
+            raise ValueError("run identity must bind one runtime device per rank")
+        for rank, (device, item) in enumerate(zip(devices, memory, strict=True)):
+            if (
+                not isinstance(device, dict)
+                or device.get("rank") != rank
+                or device.get("total_memory_bytes") != item["device_total_memory_bytes"]
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("profile device memory does not match the runtime identity")
+    if value.get("peak_memory_bytes") != max(item["peak_allocated_bytes"] for item in memory):
+        raise ValueError("profile aggregate allocated memory does not match per-rank values")
+    if value.get("peak_reserved_bytes") != max(item["peak_reserved_bytes"] for item in memory):
+        raise ValueError("profile aggregate reserved memory does not match per-rank values")
+    return file_sha256(path)
+
+
+def _positive_integer(value: object) -> bool:
+    """Accept only positive Python integer counters, excluding booleans."""
+    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value > 0
+
+
+def _finite_nonnegative(value: object) -> bool:
+    """Accept finite nonnegative numeric receipt values, excluding booleans."""
+    return (
+        isinstance(value, (int, float))
+        and not isinstance(value, bool)
+        and math.isfinite(value)
+        and value >= 0
+    )

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from wnn.data import SEQUENCE_LENGTH, WARMUP, SequenceFile
+from wnn.evaluation import paired_component_moments
+from wnn.gmetric import GlobalAccumulator, _merge_moments
+from wnn.splits import file_sha256, load_campaign_split
+from wnn.training.sequence_cache import validate_export_schema, validate_producer
+
+
+def score_export(root: Path, split_manifest: Path, predictions: Path, output: Path) -> None:
+    """Score every held-out row once with the canonical pooled official metric."""
+    split = load_campaign_split(split_manifest, root)
+    manifest_path = predictions / "manifest.json"
+    if manifest_path.stat().st_size > 32_000_000:
+        raise ValueError("prediction manifest exceeds bounded metadata size")
+    meta = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
+    if meta.get("schema") != "sequence-predictions-v1" or meta.get("complete") is not True:
+        raise ValueError("score requires a completed held-out prediction export")
+    if meta["split_sha256"] != split.sha256:
+        raise ValueError("prediction split hash mismatch")
+    validate_export_schema(meta, "evaluation")
+    fitting = [("train", g) for g in split.train_groups] + [
+        ("valid", g) for g in split.valid_groups
+    ]
+    validate_producer(meta["producer"], split.sha256, fitting)
+    members = [(entry["split"], entry["row_group"]) for entry in meta["sequences"]]
+    expected = [("valid", group) for group in split.evaluation_groups]
+    if len(set(members)) != len(members) or set(members) != set(expected):
+        raise ValueError("held-out prediction coverage is incomplete or duplicated")
+    source = SequenceFile(root / "datasets/valid.parquet")
+    accumulator = GlobalAccumulator()
+    centered_by_component: dict[int, np.ndarray] = {}
+    component_map = {(s, g): c for s, g, c in split.components}
+    for entry in meta["sequences"]:
+        path = predictions / entry["file"]
+        if path.parent.resolve() != predictions.resolve() or path.is_symlink():
+            raise ValueError("prediction file escapes export root")
+        if file_sha256(path) != entry["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError("prediction hash mismatch")
+        values = np.load(path, mmap_mode="r", allow_pickle=False)
+        if values.dtype != np.float32 or values.shape != (SEQUENCE_LENGTH, 2 + meta["hint_dim"]):
+            raise ValueError("prediction shape/dtype mismatch")
+        if not np.isfinite(values).all():
+            raise ValueError("nonfinite prediction export")
+        seq = source.read(entry["row_group"])
+        if seq.scored is None or seq.targets is None:
+            raise ValueError("evaluation labels/mask unavailable")
+        mask = seq.scored.copy()
+        mask[:WARMUP] = False
+        accumulator.add(
+            seq.targets, values[:, :2], mask, group=component_map[("valid", entry["row_group"])]
+        )
+        if mask.any():
+            moments, _ = paired_component_moments(
+                seq.targets[None], values[None, :, :2], values[None, :, :2], mask[None]
+            )
+            component = component_map[("valid", entry["row_group"])]
+            previous = centered_by_component.get(component, np.zeros((2, 6), dtype=np.float64))
+            centered_by_component[component] = np.stack(
+                [_merge_moments(previous[k], moments[0, k]) for k in range(2)]
+            )
+    receipt = {
+        "score": accumulator.result(),
+        "split_sha256": split.sha256,
+        "predictions_manifest_sha256": file_sha256(manifest_path),
+        "producer": meta["producer"],
+        "sequences": len(members),
+        "component_raw_sums": {str(k): v.tolist() for k, v in accumulator.groups.items()},
+        "component_centered_moments": {
+            str(k): v.tolist() for k, v in centered_by_component.items()
+        },
+        "interpretation": "Exposed fold; fixed endpoint, not checkpoint selection or public score.",
+    }
+    with output.open("x") as stream:
+        json.dump(receipt, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
+        stream.write("\n")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    """Grade an immutable endpoint export without importing or executing a model."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--data-root", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--split-manifest", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--predictions", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    score_export(args.data_root, args.split_manifest, args.predictions, args.output)

+"""Strict-FP32 CUDA update boundary with isolated optimizer timing."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_distributed import DistributedContext, all_ranks_true
+
+
+def finish_update(
+    model: torch.nn.Module,
+    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
+    scheduler: torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR,
+    context: DistributedContext,
+    gradient_clip: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, float]:
+    """Agree on finite gradients, measure preclip norm, step, and validate parameters."""
+    gradient_flags = [
+        torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all()
+        for parameter in model.parameters()
+        if parameter.grad is not None
+    ]
+    gradients_finite = bool(torch.stack(gradient_flags).all()) if gradient_flags else False
+    if not all_ranks_true(gradients_finite, context):
+        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite gradients detected consistently across torchrun ranks")
+    norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
+        model.parameters(), gradient_clip, error_if_nonfinite=False
+    )
+    if not all_ranks_true(bool(torch.isfinite(norm)), context):
+        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite preclip gradient norm detected across torchrun ranks")
+    started = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+    finished = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+    started.record()
+    optimizer.step()
+    finished.record()
+    scheduler.step()
+    parameter_flags = [torch.isfinite(parameter).all() for parameter in model.parameters()]
+    parameters_finite = bool(torch.stack(parameter_flags).all()) if parameter_flags else False
+    if not all_ranks_true(parameters_finite, context):
+        raise FloatingPointError("nonfinite model parameter detected after optimizer update")
+    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    return norm.detach(), started.elapsed_time(finished) / 1000.0

+"""Focused tests for bounded rolling attention backend semantics."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+from torch.nn.attention import SDPBackend, sdpa_kernel
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention import CausalTransformerBlock, _rotate
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention_backends import LocalCausalAttention
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention_capabilities import attention_backend_capabilities
+from wnn.training.sequence_attention_masks import (
+    _additive_window_mask,
+    _relative_window_mask,
+    _window_mask,
+)
+
+
+def _legacy_bounded_math(
+    query: Tensor,
+    key: Tensor,
+    value: Tensor,
+    query_start: int,
+    key_start: int,
+    context_rows: int,
+) -> Tensor:
+    """Independent reference for the pre-selector FP32 math implementation."""
+    outputs = []
+    for query_offset in range(0, query.shape[-2], 256):
+        query_end = min(query_offset + 256, query.shape[-2])
+        absolute_start = query_start + query_offset
+        absolute_end = query_start + query_end
+        first_key = max(0, absolute_start - (context_rows - 1) - key_start)
+        end_key = min(key.shape[-2], absolute_end - key_start)
+        key_offsets = torch.arange(first_key, end_key, device=query.device)
+        query_positions = torch.arange(absolute_start, absolute_end, device=query.device)
+        key_positions = key_offsets + key_start
+        allowed = (query_positions[:, None] - key_positions[None, :] >= 0) & (
+            query_positions[:, None] - key_positions[None, :] < context_rows
+        )
+        with sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.MATH):
+            outputs.append(
+                F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+                    query[..., query_offset:query_end, :],
+                    key[..., first_key:end_key, :],
+                    value[..., first_key:end_key, :],
+                    attn_mask=allowed[None, None, :, :],
+                    dropout_p=0.0,
+                    is_causal=False,
+                )
+            )
+    return torch.cat(outputs, dim=-2)
+
+
+def test_default_math_is_numerically_identical_to_previous_fp32_path() -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(17)
+    query = torch.randn(2, 3, 513, 8, dtype=torch.float32)
+    key = torch.randn(2, 3, 517, 8, dtype=torch.float32)
+    value = torch.randn_like(key)
+    expected = _legacy_bounded_math(query, key, value, 2048, 2044, 32)
+    default = LocalCausalAttention()(query, key, value, 2048, 2044, 32)
+    explicit = LocalCausalAttention("math")(query, key, value, 2048, 2044, 32)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(default, expected, rtol=0.0, atol=0.0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(explicit, expected, rtol=0.0, atol=0.0)
+
+
+def test_relative_mask_is_exact_for_causal_rolling_window() -> None:
+    expected = torch.tensor(
+        [
+            [True, True, True, False, False],
+            [False, True, True, True, False],
+            [False, False, True, True, True],
+        ]
+    )
+    actual = _window_mask(3, 5, past_rows=2, context_rows=3, device=torch.device("cpu"))[0, 0]
+    assert torch.equal(actual, expected)
+
+    query_index = torch.arange(3)[:, None]
+    key_index = torch.arange(5)[None, :]

+def _write_cache(

+        precision_mode,
+        compile_blocks,
+        attention_backend,
+    )
+    entries = []

+    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))

+    with pytest.raises((ValueError, OSError, EOFError)):

+"""Focused CPU tests for optional in-place Transformer block compilation."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from torch import nn
+
+from wnn.training.sequence_compile import compile_transformer_blocks
+
+
+class _CompileProbe(nn.Module):
+    """Record compile requests without invoking a compiler or model forward."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.projection = nn.Linear(3, 3)
+        self.compile_options: dict[str, object] | None = None
+
+    def compile(self, **kwargs: object) -> None:
+        self.compile_options = kwargs
+
+
+def test_disabled_compilation_is_an_in_place_no_op() -> None:
+    block = _CompileProbe()
+    before = tuple(block.state_dict())
+
+    result = compile_transformer_blocks(nn.ModuleList([block]), enabled=False)
+
+    assert result is False
+    assert block.compile_options is None
+    assert tuple(block.state_dict()) == before
+
+
+def test_enabled_compilation_uses_in_place_fullgraph_default_inductor() -> None:
+    blocks = nn.ModuleList([_CompileProbe(), _CompileProbe()])
+    before = tuple(blocks.state_dict())
+
+    result = compile_transformer_blocks(blocks, enabled=True)
+
+    assert result is True
+    assert all(
+        block.compile_options
+        == {
+            "backend": "inductor",
+            "mode": "default",
+            "fullgraph": False,
+            "dynamic": None,
+        }
+        for block in blocks
+    )
+    assert tuple(blocks.state_dict()) == before
+
+
+def test_unsupported_block_fails_before_mutating_any_block() -> None:
+    first = _CompileProbe()
+    unsupported = _CompileProbe()
+    unsupported.compile = None  # type: ignore[method-assign]
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="block 1 does not support torch.compile"):
+        compile_transformer_blocks(nn.ModuleList([first, unsupported]), enabled=True)
+
+    assert first.compile_options is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("enabled", [0, 1, None, "true"])
+def test_enabled_flag_requires_a_boolean(enabled: object) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="enabled must be a bool"):
+        compile_transformer_blocks(nn.ModuleList([_CompileProbe()]), enabled=enabled)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

+def _strict_optimizer(matrix: nn.Parameter, vector: nn.Parameter) -> MuonAdamW:
+    groups: list[dict[str, object]] = [
+        {
+            "params": [matrix],
+            "param_names": ["blocks.0.qkv.weight"],
+            "role": "muon_qkv",
+            "group_name": "muon_qkv",
+            "muon": True,
+            "blocks": 1,
+            "betas": (0.95, 0.95),
+            "weight_decay": 0.01,
+            "strict_fp32": True,
+        },
+        {
+            "params": [vector],
+            "param_names": ["output_head.bias"],
+            "role": "adamw_no_decay",
+            "group_name": "adamw_no_decay",
+            "muon": False,
+            "weight_decay": 0.01,
+            "betas": (0.9, 0.95),
+            "strict_fp32": True,
+        },
+    ]
+    return MuonAdamW(
+        groups,
+        lr=0.002,
+        betas=(0.9, 0.95),
+        eps=1e-8,
+        ns_steps=2,
+        ns_eps=1e-7,
+        strict_fp32=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _reference_orthogonalize(gradient: torch.Tensor, steps: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Compute the declared Newton-Schulz polynomial independently for update checks."""
+    a, b, c = 3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315
+    value = gradient / (gradient.norm() + 1e-7)
+    for _ in range(steps):
+        gram = value @ value.mT
+        value = a * value + (b * gram + c * gram @ gram) @ value
+    return value
+
+
+def test_sequence_muon_groups_split_qkv_and_own_every_trainable_parameter() -> None:
+    model = build_sequence_model(_transformer_config())
+    optimizer = build_sequence_muon_optimizer(model, _muon_config())
+    groups = optimizer.param_groups
+    by_role = {str(group["role"]): group for group in groups}
+
+    assert {"muon_qkv", "muon_hidden"}.issubset(by_role)
+    qkv = by_role["muon_qkv"]
+    assert qkv["blocks"] == 3
+    assert qkv["param_names"] == ["blocks.0.qkv.weight", "blocks.1.qkv.weight"]
+    assert all(parameter.shape[0] == 3 * parameter.shape[1] for parameter in qkv["params"])
+    assert by_role["muon_hidden"]["param_names"] == [
+        "blocks.0.attention_output.weight",
+        "blocks.0.feedforward_in.weight",
+        "blocks.0.feedforward_out.weight",
+        "blocks.1.attention_output.weight",
+        "blocks.1.feedforward_in.weight",
+        "blocks.1.feedforward_out.weight",
+    ]
+
+    owners = [parameter for group in groups for parameter in group["params"]]
+    trainable = [parameter for parameter in model.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad]
+    assert len(owners) == len(trainable)
+    assert {id(parameter) for parameter in owners} == {id(parameter) for parameter in trainable}
+    assert all(isinstance(group["param_names"], list) for group in groups)
+    assert all(group["optimizer_group_schema"] == "wnn.sequence-muon-group.v1" for group in groups)
+    assert all(group["group_name"] == group["role"] for group in groups)
+    assert by_role["adamw_matrix"]["param_names"] == [
+        "input_projection.weight",
+        "output_head.weight",
+    ]
+    assert by_role["adamw_matrix"]["weight_decay"] == pytest.approx(0.01)
+    assert by_role["adamw_no_decay"]["weight_decay"] == 0.0
+    assert by_role["adamw_matrix"]["betas"] == (0.9, 0.95)
+    assert qkv["betas"][0] == pytest.approx(0.95)

+def test_strict_newton_schulz_keeps_every_matmul_fp32(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    observed: list[tuple[torch.dtype, torch.dtype]] = []
+    original_matmul = torch.Tensor.__matmul__
+
+    def record_matmul(left: torch.Tensor, right: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        observed.append((left.dtype, right.dtype))
+        return original_matmul(left, right)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.Tensor, "__matmul__", record_matmul)
+    output = orthogonalize(torch.eye(4, dtype=torch.float32), steps=3, strict_fp32=True)
+
+    assert output.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert len(observed) == 9
+    assert all(left == right == torch.float32 for left, right in observed)
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="float32 input"):
+        orthogonalize(torch.eye(4, dtype=torch.bfloat16), strict_fp32=True)

+    vector = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([0.3, -0.2], dtype=torch.float32))
+    matrix_gradient = torch.tensor([[0.5, -0.4], [0.1, 0.2]], dtype=torch.float32)
+    vector_gradient = torch.tensor([0.6, -0.3], dtype=torch.float32)
+    matrix.grad = matrix_gradient.clone()
+    vector.grad = vector_gradient.clone()
+    optimizer = _strict_optimizer(matrix, vector)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("architecture", ["gru", "transformer"])
+def test_bf16_streaming_keeps_fp32_state_and_updates(
+    architecture: str, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    """Carry two chunks through BF16 forward/backward with FP32 master updates."""
+    # Pure BF16 exercises dtype boundaries without changing process-wide cuBLAS
+    # policy after CUDA initialization. bf16_bf16x9 real-shape profiles run in
+    # separate fresh processes with the environment fixed before import.
+    monkeypatch.delenv(EMULATION_ENV, raising=False)
+    model = build_sequence_model(
+        {
+            "architecture": architecture,
+            "hidden": 64,
+            "layers": 2,
+            "heads": 2,
+            "context_rows": 16,
+            "dropout": 0.0,
+            "checkpoint_blocks": False,
+            "hint_dim": 0,
+            "precision_mode": "bf16",
+            "attention_backend": "efficient" if architecture == "transformer" else "math",
+            "compile_blocks": False,
+        }
+    ).cuda()
+    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)
+    state = None
+    for _ in range(2):
+        values = torch.randn(2, 17, 112, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+        with forward_context("bf16", "cuda"):
+            prediction, _, state = model(values, state)

+            for parameter in model.parameters()
+        )

+        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+    assert all(parameter.dtype == torch.float32 for parameter in model.parameters())
+    assert all(
